songs.title: endarO mahAnubhAvu
songs.summary: Tyagaraja's salutation to all the great souls — the devotees, sages and musicians who have realised God through love, music and knowledge.

lines.text: endarO mahAnubhAvu-landariki vandanamu
lines.meaning: There are so many great souls — my salutations to every one of them.

lines.text: canduru varNuni anda candamunu hrdayAra-
lines.meaning: Those who behold the beauty of the moon-hued Lord in the lotus of their heart

lines.text: vindamuna jUci brahmAnandamanu bhavincu vAr-
lines.meaning: and experience supreme bliss —

lines.text: sAma gAna lOla manasija lAvaNya dhanya mUrdhanyul
lines.meaning: the blessed foremost ones who delight in Sama chanting, lovely as Manmatha —

lines.text: mAnasa vana cara vara sancAramu salipi mUrti bAguga pogaDanE vAr-
lines.meaning: those who let the mind roam freely in the forest of the heart and praise His form well —

lines.text: saraguna pAdamulaku svAntamanu sarOjamunu samarpaNamu sEyu vAr-
lines.meaning: those who readily offer the lotus of their heart at His feet —

lines.text: patita pAvanuDanE parAtparuni gurinci paramArthamagu nija mArgamutOnu
lines.meaning: those who, along the true path to the Supreme who purifies the fallen,

lines.text: bADucunu sallApamutO svara layAdi rAgamula deliyu vAr-
lines.meaning: sing, converse, and know the ragas with their svara and laya —

lines.text: hari guNa maNimaya saramulu galamuna shObhillu bhakta kOTulilalO telivitO
lines.meaning: devotees who wear Hari's virtues like jewelled garlands, and with wisdom,

lines.text: celimitO karuNa galgu jagamellanu sudhA drSTicE brOcu vAr-
lines.meaning: affection and compassion protect the whole world with a nectar-like gaze —

lines.text: hoyalu mIra naDalu galgu sarasuni sadA kanula jucucunu pulaka
lines.meaning: those who always gaze on the graceful Lord of charming gait,

lines.text: sharIrula I Ananda payOdhi nimagnula I mudambunanu yashamu galavAr-
lines.meaning: thrilled in body, immersed in an ocean of bliss, renowned for that joy —

lines.text: parama bhAgavata mauni vara shashi vibhAkara sanaka sanandana
lines.meaning: the great devotees and sages, the moon and the sun, Sanaka and Sanandana,

lines.text: digIsha sura kimpuruSa kanaka kashipu suta nArada tumburu
lines.meaning: the guardians of the directions, gods, Kimpurushas, Prahlada son of Hiranyakashipu, Narada and Tumburu,

lines.text: pavanasUnu bAlacandra dhara shuka sarOjabhava bhUsuravarulu
lines.meaning: Hanuman son of the Wind, Shiva who wears the crescent moon, Shuka, Brahma and the best of Brahmins,

lines.text: parama pAvanulu ghanulu shAshvatulu kamala bhava sukhamu sadAnubhavulu gAka
lines.meaning: the supremely pure, the great, the eternal, ever enjoying bliss — and besides them,

lines.text: nI mEnu nAma vaibhavambulanu nI parAkrama dhairyamula shAnta mAnasamu nIvulanu
lines.meaning: those who know your form, your name and glory, your valour, courage and serene mind,

lines.text: vacana satyamunu raghuvara nIyeDa sadbhaktiyu janincakanu durmatamulanu kalla
lines.meaning: the truth of your word, O Raghuvara, and how devotion to you overturns false doctrines —

lines.text: jEsinaTTi nImadi neringi santasambunanu guNa bhajanA-nanda kirtanamu jEyu vAr-
lines.meaning: and who, knowing your heart, joyfully sing kirtanas of your virtues —

lines.text: bhAgavata rAmAyaNa gItAdi shruti shAstra purAnamu marmamulanu shivAdi sanmatamula
lines.meaning: those who know the secrets of the Bhagavata, Ramayana, Gita, Vedas, Shastras and Puranas, and the teachings of Shiva and others,

lines.text: gUDhamulan muppadi mukkOTi surAntarangamula bhAvamula nerigi bhava rAga layAdi
lines.meaning: and the inner feelings of the thirty-three crore gods, and the joy of bhava, raga and laya,

lines.text: saukhyamucE cirAyuvula galigi niravadhi sukhAtmulai tyAgarAptulaina vAr-
lines.meaning: who live long in endless bliss and are dear to Tyagaraja —

lines.text: prEma muppiri gonu vELa nAmamu dalacEvAru rAmabhaktuDaina tyAgarAjanutuni nija dAsulaina vAr-
lines.meaning: those who utter the Name as love wells up, true servants of Rama praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: jagadAnanda kAraka
songs.summary: A Sanskrit garland of epithets for Rama, recounting his qualities and deeds; the first of Tyagaraja's Pancharatna kritis.

lines.text: jagadAnanda kAraka jaya jAnaki prANa nAyaka
lines.meaning: O source of the world's joy, victory to you, beloved lord of Janaki's life!

lines.text: gaganAdhipa satkulaja rAja rAjEshvara suguNAkara surasEvya bhavya dAyaka sadA sakala
lines.meaning: Born in the noble Solar race, king of kings, abode of virtues, served by the gods, ever the giver of good — (you who) all

lines.text: amara tAraka nicaya kumuda hita paripUrNA naga sura surabhUja
lines.meaning: a moon to the lily-like hosts of gods and stars, perfect one; a mountain and wish-tree to the gods,

lines.text: dadhi payOdhi vAsa haraNa sundaratara vadana sudhAmaya vacO
lines.meaning: the cow of plenty; dweller on the milk ocean; with the most handsome face; whose speech is nectar,

lines.text: brnda gOvinda sAnanda mA varAjarApta shubhakar A nEka
lines.meaning: Govinda, ever joyful, consort of Lakshmi, beyond age, giver of good fortune, the one and the many,

lines.text: nigama nirajAmrutaja pOSakA nimiSavairi vArida samIraNa
lines.meaning: nourisher of Brahma born of the lotus; the wind that scatters the clouds of the gods' enemies,

lines.text: khaga turanga satkavi hrdAlayA gaNita vAnarAdhipa natAnghri yuga
lines.meaning: rider of Garuda; dwelling in the hearts of true poets; whose feet are worshipped by countless monkey chiefs,

lines.text: indra nIlamaNi sannibhApa ghana candra sUrya nayanApramEya vA-
lines.meaning: lustrous as a sapphire, with sun and moon for eyes, immeasurable,

lines.text: gIndra janaka sakalEsha subhra nAgEndra shayana shamana vairi sannuta
lines.meaning: father of Brahma, lord of all, pure, reclining on the serpent king, praised by Shiva,

lines.text: pAda vijita mauni shApa sava paripAla vara mantra grahaNa lOla
lines.meaning: whose foot freed the sage's wife from her curse; protector of the sacrifice; eager to receive the sacred mantra,

lines.text: parama shAnta citta janakajAdhipa sarOjabhava varadAkhila
lines.meaning: supremely serene, lord of Janaki, giver of boons to Brahma, (giver of) all

lines.text: shrSTi sthityantakAra kAmita kAmita phaladA samAna gAtra sha-
lines.meaning: cause of creation, preservation and dissolution, granter of every wish, of incomparable form,

lines.text: cIpati nutAbdhi mada harAnurA garAga rAjita kathA sArahita
lines.meaning: praised by Indra; who humbled the ocean's pride; radiant with love; the essence of the epic,

lines.text: sajjana mAnasAbdhi sudhAkara kusuma vimAna surasAripu karAbja
lines.meaning: a moon to the ocean of good men's minds; rider of the Pushpaka chariot; enemy of the gods' foes; whose lotus hands

lines.text: lAlita caranAva guNA suragaNa mada haraNa sanAtanA januta
lines.meaning: are caressed (by Lakshmi); refuge of the virtuous; humbler of the gods' pride; eternal one, praised

lines.text: OmkAra panjara kIra pura hara sarOja bhava kEshavAdi rUpa vAsavaripu janakAntaka kalA
lines.meaning: the parrot in the cage of Om; whose forms are Shiva, Brahma and Vishnu; slayer of Ravana,

lines.text: dharApta karuNAkara sharaNAgata janapAlana sumanO ramaNa nirvikAra nigama sAratara
lines.meaning: dear to Shiva; compassionate; protector of those who surrender; delight of the good; changeless; essence of the Vedas,

lines.text: karadhrta sharajAlA sura madApa haraNa vanIsura surAvana
lines.meaning: bearer of a quiver of arrows; destroyer of the demons' pride; protector of Brahmins and gods,

lines.text: kavIna bilaja mauni krta caritra sannuta shrI tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: whose deeds are sung by Valmiki; praised by Tyagaraja,

lines.text: purANa puruSa nrvarAtmajA shrita parAdhIna kara virAdha rAvaNa
lines.meaning: the ancient Person, son of a king, devoted to those who seek refuge, slayer of Viradha and Ravana,

lines.text: virAvaNA nagha parAshara manOharA vikrta tyAgarAja sannuta
lines.meaning: sinless one who captivated Parashara's heart, praised by Tyagaraja,

lines.text: agaNita guNa kanaka cEla sAla viDalanAruNAbha samAna caraNApAra
lines.meaning: of countless virtues, clad in gold, who pierced the sala trees, with feet radiant as the dawn, of boundless

lines.text: mahimAdbhuta su-kavijana hrtsadana sura munigaNa vihita kalasha nIra
lines.meaning: wondrous greatness, dwelling in the hearts of good poets, worshipped by gods and sages with sacred water,

lines.text: nidhijA ramaNa pApa gaja nrsimha vara tyAgarAjAdhinuta
lines.meaning: beloved of Lakshmi, a Narasimha to the elephant of sin, praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: duDuku gala nannE dora
songs.summary: A long confession: Tyagaraja lists the faults of a life lost to wealth, flattery and pleasure, and asks who but Rama could save such a person.

lines.text: duDuku gala nannE dora koDuku brOcurA entO
lines.meaning: Which lord will save a wayward one like me? How many (are my faults)!

lines.text: kaDu durviSayA krSTuDai-gaDiya gaDiyaku ninDAru
lines.meaning: Drawn by wicked pleasures, sunk in them every moment —

lines.text: shrI vanitA hrtkumudAbjA vAngmAnasa gOcara
lines.meaning: O sun to the lotus heart of Lakshmi, beyond the reach of word and mind!

lines.text: sakala bhUtamula andu nI vaiyuNDaga madilEka pOyina
lines.meaning: Forgetting that you dwell in all beings,

lines.text: ciruta prAyamu nADe bhajanAmrta rasavihIna kutarkuDaina
lines.meaning: from childhood devoid of the nectar of bhajan, a mere quibbler,

lines.text: para dhanamula koraku nOrula madini karaga-baliki kaDupu nimpa diriginaTTi
lines.meaning: who wandered flattering others to melt their hearts, for their wealth, to fill my belly,

lines.text: tanamadini bhuvini saukhyapu jIvanamE anucu sadA dinamulu gaDipE
lines.meaning: spending all my days thinking worldly comfort is life itself,

lines.text: telayani naTaviTa kSUdrulu vanitalu sva vashamautakupadEshinci santasilli
lines.meaning: advising ignorant actors, rogues, mean men and women to win them over, and rejoicing in it,

lines.text: svaralayambu lerungakanushIlAtmuDai su-bhaktulaku samanamanu
lines.meaning: ignorant of svara and laya, of crooked nature, counting myself equal to true devotees,

lines.text: druSTiki sArambagu lalanA sadanArbhaka sEnAmita dhanAdulanu dEvadi dEva
lines.meaning: trusting the pleasures of the eye — women, home, children, servants and endless wealth — O God of gods,

lines.text: nera nammitini gAkanI padAbja bhajanambu maracina
lines.meaning: I trusted them wholly and forgot the worship of your lotus feet,

lines.text: cakkani mukha kamalambunu sadA nA midilO smaraNa lEkanE durmadAndha-
lines.meaning: never remembering your lovely lotus face in my heart, blinded by arrogance,

lines.text: janula kOri paritApamulacE dagili nogili durvisaya durAsalanu rOyalEka
lines.meaning: seeking out wicked people and suffering, unable to shake off evil desires,

lines.text: satata maparAdhinai capala cittuDanaina
lines.meaning: always erring, fickle of mind,

lines.text: mAnavatanu durlabha manucu nEnci paramAnanda mondaleka mada matsara
lines.meaning: not realising human birth is rare, never attaining supreme bliss, a slave to pride, jealousy,

lines.text: kAma lObha mOhamulaku dAsuDai mOsabOti gAka modaTi kulajuDagucu bhuvini
lines.meaning: desire, greed and delusion, deceived — though born in a noble family,

lines.text: shUdula panulu salpucunu uNTinigAka nArAdamulu kOri sArahIna matamulanu sAdhimpa dArumAru
lines.meaning: doing lowly deeds, chasing worthless creeds and going astray,

lines.text: satulakai konnALLAstikai sutulakai konnALLu dhana tatulakai tirigiti nayya tyAgarAjApta ituvaNTi
lines.meaning: I wandered some days for women, some for property, some for sons, some for heaps of money — O friend of Tyagaraja, (who will save) such a one?

songs.title: sAdhincenE
songs.summary: Tyagaraja playfully complains that Krishna/Rama has had his way: the Lord taught the right path, accepted his worship, yet still did not come near.

lines.text: sAdhincenE O manasA
lines.meaning: He has had his way, O mind!

lines.text: bOdhincina sanmArga vacanamula bonku jEsi tA baTTina paTTu
lines.meaning: Making false the words of the good path he himself taught, he held firm to his own resolve.

lines.text: samayAniki dagu mATa lADanE
lines.meaning: Speaking words to suit the moment,

lines.text: dEvaki vasudEvula negincinaTu
lines.meaning: as when he delighted Devaki and Vasudeva,

lines.text: rangEshuDu sadgangA janakuDu sangIta sAmpradAyakuDu
lines.meaning: Lord Ranganatha, father of the holy Ganga, master of the tradition of music,

lines.text: gOpi jana manOratha mosanga lEkanE geliyu jEsE vADu
lines.meaning: who, without fulfilling the gopis' heart's desire, made sport of them,

lines.text: vanitala sadA sokka jEyucunu mrokka jEsE paramAtmu-Dadiyu gAka
lines.meaning: the Supreme who ever enchants women and makes them bow — and more,

lines.text: yashOda tanayuDancu mudambunanu muddu beTTa navvucuNDu hari
lines.meaning: Hari, who smiled as Yashoda kissed him lovingly as her son,

lines.text: parama bhakta vatsaluDu suguNa pArAvaruNDa janma mana ghUDi kali
lines.meaning: who loves his devotees, an ocean of virtues, who removes the troubles of birth and of Kali —

lines.text: bAdhalu dIrcu vADanucu nE hrdambujamuna jUcu cuNDaga
lines.meaning: while I held him in my lotus heart, thinking so,

lines.text: harE rAmachandra raghukulEsha mrdu subhASa shESa shayana
lines.meaning: (I prayed) 'Hari! Ramachandra, lord of the Raghus, of gentle speech, reclining on Shesha,

lines.text: para nAri sOdara aja virAjaturaga rAjarAjanuta nirAmaya pAghana
lines.meaning: who sees others' wives as sisters, praised by Brahma and the king of kings, flawless and pure,

lines.text: sarasIruha daLAkSa anucu vEDukonna nannu tA brOvakanu
lines.meaning: lotus-eyed one' — even as I pleaded so, he did not protect me.

lines.text: shrI venkaTEsha suprakAsha sarvAnnata sajjana mAnasa nikEtana
lines.meaning: Lord of Venkata, radiant, highest of all, dwelling in the minds of the good,

lines.text: kanakAmbara dhara lasan-makuTa kuNDala virAjita harE anucu
lines.meaning: wearing golden robes, a shining crown and earrings — Hari! — so

lines.text: nE pogaDaga tyAgarAja gEyuDu mAnavEndraDaina rAmacandruDu
lines.meaning: I praised him; Ramachandra, sung by Tyagaraja, best of men,

lines.text: sadbhaktula naData liTla nenE amarikagA nA pUja konenE
lines.meaning: told me 'this is how true devotees live', and graciously accepted my worship;

lines.text: aluga vaddananE vimukhulatO jEra bOku mananE veta galigina
lines.meaning: he told me 'do not be angry', 'do not keep company with those averse to God',

lines.text: tALukommananE damashamAdi sukha dAyakuDagu shrI
lines.meaning: 'bear sorrow when it comes'; yet he, the giver of calm and self-control,

lines.text: tyAgarAja nutuDu centa rAkanE
lines.meaning: the Lord praised by Tyagaraja, did not come near me.

songs.title: kana kana rucirA
songs.summary: The more one sees Rama, the more beautiful he is; Tyagaraja recalls Dhruva, Sita and Hanuman, and calls Shiva and the sages as witnesses to Rama's charm.

lines.text: kana kana rucirA kanaka vasana ninnu
lines.meaning: The more I see you, the more delightful you are, O you clad in gold —

lines.text: dina dinamuna manasuna canuvuna ninnu (kana)
lines.meaning: day after day, (seeing) you in my mind with affection.

lines.text: pAlugAru mOmuna shrIyapAra mahima danaru ninnu (kana)
lines.meaning: Your milk-white face, with boundless glory and grace —

lines.text: kalakalamanu mukhakala galigina sIta kulukucu nOra kannulanu jUcE ninnu
lines.meaning: Sita, her face radiant, glancing at you shyly from the corner of her eyes —

lines.text: bAlArkAbha sucEla maNimaya mAlAlankrta kandhara
lines.meaning: clad in garments bright as the rising sun, your neck adorned with jewelled garlands,

lines.text: sarasijAksa varakapOla surucira kirITadhara santatambu manasAraga
lines.meaning: lotus-eyed, with fine cheeks and a shining crown — always, to my heart's content.

lines.text: sapatni mAtayau surucicE karNa shUlamaina mATa vInula
lines.meaning: When Suruchi, his stepmother, spoke words that pierced like a spear,

lines.text: jurukkana tALaka shrI harini dhyAninci sukhimpaga lEdA adu
lines.meaning: did not Dhruva, unable to bear it, meditate on Hari and find bliss? So too

lines.text: mrdamada lalAma shubhaniTala vara jaTAyu mOkSa phalada pavamAna
lines.meaning: with a musk mark on your fair brow, who gave liberation to the noble Jatayu — when the son

lines.text: sutuDu nIdu mahima delpa sIta delisi valaci sokkalEdA ArAti ninnu
lines.meaning: of the Wind told of your greatness, did not Sita, learning it, love you and lose her heart?

lines.text: sukhAspada vimukhAmbudhara pavana vidEha mAnasa vihArApta
lines.meaning: Abode of bliss, wind to the clouds of the averse, dear one who roams the mind of Janaka,

lines.text: surabhUja manita guNAnka cidAnanda! khaga turanga dhrta rathAnga
lines.meaning: wish-tree to the worthy, marked by virtues, pure bliss, rider of Garuda, holder of the discus,

lines.text: parama dayAkara karuNArasa varuNAlaya bhayApaharA shrI raghupatE
lines.meaning: supremely kind, ocean of compassion, dispeller of fear, O Lord of the Raghus —

lines.text: kAminci prEmamIra karamula nIdu pAda kamalamula baTTukonu
lines.meaning: one who, with overflowing love, clasps your lotus feet in his hands

lines.text: vADu sAkSi rAma nAma rasikuDu kailAsa sadanuDu sAkSi
lines.meaning: is witness; Shiva of Kailasa, who delights in Rama's name, is witness;

lines.text: mariyu nArada parAshara shuka shaunaka purandara nagajA dharaja
lines.meaning: and Narada, Parashara, Shuka, Shaunaka, Indra, Parvati and Sita

lines.text: mukhyulu sAkSi gAdA sundarEsha sukha kalashAmbudhi vAsA shritulakai
lines.meaning: and the great ones are witness — O beautiful lord, dweller in the ocean of bliss, for those who seek refuge

lines.text: satatamu prEma pUrituDagu tyAgarAjanuta mukhajita kumudahita varada ninnu
lines.meaning: ever full of love, praised by Tyagaraja, whose face outshines the moon, giver of boons — (the more I see) you.

songs.title: nagumOmu ganalEni
songs.summary: Tyagaraja pleads with Rama to come and protect him, unable to bear not seeing his smiling face, and wonders who is to blame for the delay.

lines.text: nagumOmu ganalEni nAjAli telisi nanu brOvaga rAdA shrI raghuvara nI
lines.meaning: Knowing my anguish at not seeing your smiling face, won't you come to protect me, O Sri Raghuvara?

lines.text: nagarAjadhara nIdu paraivAra lella ogibOdhana jEsE vAralu gArE yiTu luNDudure
lines.meaning: O bearer of the mountain, aren't your attendants the ones who give you good counsel? Would they leave you like this?

lines.text: khagarAju nI yAnati vini vEga canalEdO gaganAni kilaku bahu dUrambaninAdO
lines.meaning: Did Garuda, king of birds, not set out at once on hearing your command? Or did he say the earth is too far from the heavens?

lines.text: jagamEle paramAtma evaritO moraliDudu vaga jUpaku tALanu nannElukOra tyAgarAjanuta nI
lines.meaning: O Supreme Being who rules the world, to whom else can I appeal? Don't show indifference — I cannot bear it. Take me as your own, O one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: banTu rIti kOlu
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks Rama for a soldier's post in his court; his armour, badge and sword are the thrill of devotion, the mark of a devotee, and Rama's name.

lines.text: banTu reeti kOlu viyavaiyya raama
lines.meaning: O Rama, grant me service in your court in the manner of a soldier —

lines.text: tuNTa viNTi vaani modalaina madaa-
lines.meaning: (the service of one who) strikes down Manmatha, wielder of the sugarcane bow,

lines.text: dula goTTi nela goola jEyu nija
lines.meaning: and pride and the other inner enemies, and fells them to the ground — that true service.

lines.text: rOmaanca manu ghana kancukamu
lines.meaning: The thrill of devotion as my mighty armour,

lines.text: raama bhaktuDanu mudra biLLayu
lines.meaning: the badge proclaiming me Rama's devotee,

lines.text: raama naama manu vara khaDga mivi
lines.meaning: and the fine sword that is Rama's name — these

lines.text: raajillu naiyya tyaagaraajuni kE
lines.meaning: shine on this Tyagaraja, O Lord.

songs.title: marugElarA O
songs.summary: Why does Rama hide himself? Tyagaraja has realised that Rama is everything, and can think of no one else.

lines.text: marugElarA O rAghavA
lines.meaning: Why this veil, O Raghava?

lines.text: marugEla carAcara ruPa parAtpara sUrya sudhAkra lOcana
lines.meaning: Why hide, you whose form is all that moves and is still, highest of the high, whose eyes are the sun and moon?

lines.text: anni nIvanucu natarangamuna dinnagA vEDaki telisi koNTinayya
lines.meaning: Searching deep within, I have firmly realised that you are everything.

lines.text: ninnE gani madi nennajAla norula nannu brOvavayya tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: Seeing only you, I cannot think of others; protect me, O one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: nidhicAla sukhamA
songs.summary: Tyagaraja's answer when called to the royal court: is wealth happiness, or service in Rama's presence?

lines.text: nidhicAla sukhamA rAmuni sannidhi sEva sukhamA nijamuga balku manasA
lines.meaning: Is wealth the greater happiness, or service in Rama's presence? Tell me truly, O mind.

lines.text: dadhi navanIta kSIramulu ruciyO dAsharathi dhyAna bhajana sudhArasamu ruciyO
lines.meaning: Are curd, butter and milk tastier, or the nectar of meditating on and singing of Dasharatha's son?

lines.text: dama shamamanu gangA snAnamu sukhamA kardama durviSaya kUpa snAnamu sukhamA
lines.meaning: Is bathing in the Ganga of self-control and calm happier, or bathing in the muddy well of base pleasures?

lines.text: mamata bandhana yuta narastuti sukhamA surapati tyAgarAja nutuni kIrtana sukhamA
lines.meaning: Is praise of men bound by attachment happier, or kirtanas on the Lord praised by Tyagaraja?

songs.title: rAma nannu brOvarA
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks Rama, who shines in everything from an ant to Brahma, why he hesitates to protect him.

lines.text: rAma nannu brOvarA vEmakO lOkAbhi
lines.meaning: O Rama, protect me — why do you hesitate, O Lord of the worlds?

lines.text: cimalO brahmalO shiva kEshavAdulalO prEma mIra melugu cuNDe birudu vAhincina sItA
lines.meaning: You who shine lovingly in the ant and in Brahma, in Shiva and Keshava — who bear that very title, Lord of Sita,

lines.text: meppulakai kannatAvu-nappu baDaga virravIgi tappu panulu lEka unDE tyAgarAja vinuta sItA
lines.meaning: I do not strut about seeking praise; I live without wrongdoing — protect me, Lord of Sita, praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: entamuddO enta
songs.summary: On the indescribable charm of Rama, and on those who wear the garb of devotees while chasing pleasures.

lines.text: entamuddO enta sogasO evarivalla varNimpa tagunE
lines.meaning: How charming, how beautiful you are! Who could describe it?

lines.text: enta vAralaina gAni-kAnta cintA krAntulai nAru
lines.meaning: However great they may be, they fall into worry and longing over women,

lines.text: attamIda kanu-lAsaku dAsulai satta bhAgavata vEsu lairi
lines.meaning: and, slaves to the desire for pleasures, they put on the guise of true devotees.

lines.text: dutta pAlu ruci deliyu sAmyamE dhUrINuDau tyAgarAjanutuDu
lines.meaning: Can a ladle know the taste of the milk it holds? (Such are they) — while the Lord praised by Tyagaraja is foremost.

songs.title: shObhillu saptaswara
songs.summary: A meditation on the seven notes as deities who dwell in the body, the Vedas and the hearts of the wise.

lines.text: shObhillu saptasvara sundarula bhajimpavE manasA
lines.meaning: Worship, O mind, the beautiful deities of the seven notes, who shine forth

lines.text: nAbhi hrt-kaNTha rasana nAsadulu andu
lines.meaning: in the navel, heart, throat, tongue, nose and other places,

lines.text: dhara rksAmAdulalO vara gAyatri hrdayamuna
lines.meaning: in the Rig and Sama Vedas and the rest, in the heart of the sacred Gayatri,

lines.text: sura bhUsura mAnasamuna shubha tyAgarAjuni eDa
lines.meaning: in the minds of gods and Brahmins, and in Tyagaraja himself.

songs.title: manasA eTulOrtunE
songs.summary: Tyagaraja scolds his own mind for not listening to his advice to worship Rama instead of keeping bad company.

lines.text: manasA eTulOrtunE nA manavini cEkonavE
lines.meaning: O mind, how am I to bear with you? Won't you heed my plea?

lines.text: dinakara kula bhUSaNi dInuDavai bhajana cEsi
lines.meaning: When I asked you to worship the jewel of the Solar race humbly

lines.text: dinamu gaDupu manina nIvu vinavadEla guNavihIna
lines.meaning: and spend your days so, why don't you listen, you worthless one?

lines.text: kalilO rAjasa tAmasa guNamula galavAri celimi
lines.meaning: In this Kali age, keeping company with people of restless and dull nature,

lines.text: galasi melasi tiruguchu mari kAlamu gaDapaka nE
lines.meaning: mingling and roaming with them — instead of wasting time,

lines.text: sulabhamugA kaDatEranu sUcanalanu teliya jEyu
lines.meaning: I can cross (this ocean) easily: the hints that make this known —

lines.text: ilanu tyAgarAja mATa vinavadEla guNavihIna
lines.meaning: Tyagaraja's words — why don't you listen, you worthless one?

songs.title: sAmaja vara gamanA
songs.summary: A Sanskrit hymn to Krishna as the master of music born of the Sama Veda, who delights in playing the flute.

lines.text: sAmaja vara gamana sAdhu hrt sArasAbja pAla kAlatita vikhyAta
lines.meaning: O you of graceful elephant-like gait, sun to the lotus hearts of the good, beyond time, renowned one,

lines.text: sAma nigamaja sudhAmaya gAna vicakSaNa guNashIla dayAlavAla mAm pAlaya
lines.meaning: master of nectar-like music born of the Sama Veda, of noble character, abode of compassion — protect me.

lines.text: vEda shirOmaNi mAtruja saptasvara nAdAcala dIpa svIkrta
lines.meaning: You who embraced the seven notes born of the crown of the Vedas, the lamp on the mountain of nada,

lines.text: yAdavakula muraLi vAdana vinOda mOhanAkara tyAgarAja vandanIya
lines.meaning: born in the Yadava clan, delighting in playing the flute, enchanting one, worshipped by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: manasulOni marmamu
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks Rama to understand the secret in his heart: he has no one but Rama.

lines.text: manasulOni marmamu delusukO mAna rakSaka marakatAnga nA
lines.meaning: Know the secret in my heart, O protector of honour, emerald-hued one,

lines.text: inakulApta nIvEgAni vErevaru lEru Ananda hrdaya
lines.meaning: dear one of the Solar race — apart from you I have no one, O blissful heart.

lines.text: munupu prEmagala doravai sadA canuvu nElanado goppa gAdayyA
lines.meaning: Long ago you were a loving lord; why deny me that affection now? Is that greatness?

lines.text: kani karambutO nIvELa nA karamu baTTu tyAgarAja vinuta
lines.meaning: When will you take my hand in yours, O one praised by Tyagaraja?

songs.title: enduku peddala
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks Rama why he won't grant him the wisdom of the great ones — knowledge of the Vedas, Vedanta and the science of music.

lines.text: enduku peddala vale buddhi iyavu endu bOdu nayyA rAmayyA
lines.meaning: Why won't you give me wisdom like that of the elders? Where would it go, O Ramayya?

lines.text: andarivale dATidATi vadariti andarAni paNDAye gadarA
lines.meaning: Like everyone else I overstepped again and again and babbled, and became a fruit beyond reach.

lines.text: vEda shAstra tattvArthamu tElisi bhEda rahita vEdAntamunu dElisi
lines.meaning: (Wisdom) to know the truth and meaning of the Vedas and Shastras, and Vedanta that sees no difference,

lines.text: nAda vidya marmambulanu dElisi nAtha tyAgarAjanuta nijamuga
lines.meaning: and to know the secrets of the science of nada — truly, O Lord praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: swara rAga sudhA
songs.summary: Devotion steeped in svara and raga is itself liberation; music without knowledge, or worship without a pure mind, is empty.

lines.text: svara rAga sudhA rasayuta bhakti svargApavargamurA O manasA
lines.meaning: Devotion steeped in the nectar of svara and raga is heaven and liberation, O mind.

lines.text: paramAnandamE kamalamupai baka bhEkamu celagEmi manasA
lines.meaning: It is supreme bliss itself — what can the crane and the frog beside the lotus know of it, O mind?

lines.text: mUlAdhAra nAda merugutE mudamagu mOkSamurA
lines.meaning: Knowing the nada that rises from the Muladhara is joyful liberation;

lines.text: kOlAhala sapta svara grahamula gurutE mOkSamurA O manasA
lines.meaning: knowing the resounding seven svaras and their home notes is liberation, O mind.

lines.text: bahu janmamulaku paini jnAniyai baraguTa mOkSamurA
lines.meaning: Becoming a knower after many births is liberation;

lines.text: sahaja bhaktitO rAga jnAna sahitudu muktudurA O manasA
lines.meaning: one who has knowledge of raga with natural devotion is liberated, O mind.

lines.text: maddaLa tALa gatula teliyakanE mardincuTa sukhamA
lines.meaning: Is it joy to pound the drum without knowing the rhythms of tala?

lines.text: shuddha manasu lEka pUja jEyuTa sUkura vrittirA O manasA
lines.meaning: Worship without a pure mind is a pig's way of life, O mind.

lines.text: rajata girIshuDu nagajaku delpu svarArNava marmamulu
lines.meaning: The secrets of the ocean of svaras that Shiva of the silver mountain told Parvati —

lines.text: vijayamu gala tyAgarAju-DErugE vishvAsinci delusukO O manasA
lines.meaning: victorious Tyagaraja knows them; trust and learn them, O mind.

songs.title: eduTa nilicitE
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks Rama what he would lose by appearing before him, and protests against his indifference.

lines.text: eduTa nilicitE nIdu sommulEmi bOvurA
lines.meaning: If you stood before me, what of yours would be lost?

lines.text: nuduTi vrAta gAni maTTumIranu nA taramA telisi mOsabOdunA
lines.meaning: Could I go beyond what is written on my forehead? Would I knowingly be deceived?

lines.text: sarAsariga jUturA nAdu yavasarAla deliyumu varAlaDuga jAlarA
lines.meaning: Look on me fairly; understand my needs; I cannot keep asking for boons.

lines.text: sakala dEvarAya manavi vinarA aghahara sundarAkAra nA
lines.meaning: O king of all gods, hear my plea, destroyer of sin, of handsome form, my

lines.text: vidEhajA ramaNa dEva brOvaga nidE samaya manya dEvatala vEDadE
lines.meaning: Lord, beloved of Videha's daughter — this is the time to protect me; I won't beg other gods.

lines.text: manasu teliyadEmi rAghava idETi shauryamu padEpadE nA
lines.meaning: Don't you know my mind, Raghava? What heroism is this, again and again, toward me?

lines.text: tarAna dorakani parAku nAyeDanu rAma jEsitE surAsurulu metturA
lines.meaning: If you show me this unheard-of indifference, Rama, would gods and demons praise you?

lines.text: ipuDu I harAmi tanamElara bhakta tyAgarAjanuta nA
lines.meaning: Why this callousness now, O Lord praised by your devotee Tyagaraja?

songs.title: bhakti bicchamiyyavE bhAvukamagu sAttvika
songs.summary: Tyagaraja begs Rama for pure devotion, without which all learning is like adorning a corpse.

lines.text: bhakti biccamiyyavE bhAvukamagu sAttvika
lines.meaning: Grant me the alms of devotion, auspicious and pure —

lines.text: mukti kakhila shaktiki trimUrtula katimElmi rAma
lines.meaning: devotion that is the root of liberation and all power, greater even than the Trimurtis, O Rama.

lines.text: prAnamu lEni vAniki bangAru pAga cuTTi Ani vajra bhUSaNa muramandu beTTu rIti jAnalaku
lines.meaning: Like wrapping a golden turban and diamond ornaments on one who has no life — so it is for the learned (without devotion);

lines.text: purANAgama shAstra vEda japa prasanga trANa galgi yEmi bhakta tyAgarAjanuta rAma
lines.meaning: what use are Puranas, Agamas, Shastras, Vedas and japa without it? O Rama, praised by your devotee Tyagaraja.

songs.title: OrajUpu chUcEDi nyAyamA
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks Rama whether it is fair to look at him askance.

lines.text: OrajUpu chUcEdi nyAyamA O ragUttamA nIvaNTi vAniki
lines.meaning: Is it fair to look at me askance, O best of the Raghus, for one like you?

lines.text: nirajAkSa manu nI dAsulaku nI kETi vAvulu delpavE
lines.meaning: Tell me, what bond do you have with your servants who call you lotus-eyed?

lines.text: mAna mincukaina nIku tOcalEka pO-yina vaina mEmi puNya rUpamA
lines.meaning: Did it not occur to you at all to protect my honour? What is that to you, O embodiment of virtue?

lines.text: dIna rakSaka shrta mAnava san-tAna gAnalOla tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: Protector of the lowly, who delights in the music of those who seek refuge, praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: nAda  tanumanisham
songs.summary: A salutation to Shiva, whose very body is nada (musical sound), and from whose five faces the seven notes arose.

lines.text: nAda tanumanisha shankaram namAmi mE manasA shirasA
lines.meaning: With mind and head bowed, I salute Shankara, whose body is nada, always —

lines.text: mOdakarA nigamOttama sAmavEda sAram vAram vAram
lines.meaning: the giver of joy, the essence of the Sama Veda, best of the Vedas — again and again;

lines.text: sadyOjAtAdi panca vaktraja sarigamapadhani vara saptasvara
lines.meaning: who delights in the art of the seven notes sa ri ga ma pa dha ni, born of his five faces beginning with Sadyojata,

lines.text: vidyAlOlam vidaLitakAlam vimala hrdaya tyAgarAjapAlam
lines.meaning: who vanquished Death, pure of heart, protector of Tyagaraja.

songs.title: sangIta gnAnamu
songs.summary: Musical knowledge without devotion does not lead to the right path.

lines.text: sangIta jnAnamu bhakti vinA sanmArgamu galadE manasA
lines.meaning: O mind, can knowledge of music without devotion lead to the right path?

lines.text: bhrngi naTEsha samIraja ghaTaja matanga nAradAdulu pAsincu
lines.meaning: (The music) worshipped by Bhringi, Nataraja, Hanuman, Agastya, Matanga, Narada and others —

lines.text: nyAya anyAyamu delusunu jagamula mayamani delusunu durguNa
lines.meaning: one with devotion knows right from wrong, knows that the worlds are illusion,

lines.text: kAyajAdi SaD-ripula jayincu kAryamu delusunu tyAgarAjuniki
lines.meaning: and knows how to conquer the six inner enemies beginning with desire — so it is for Tyagaraja.

songs.title: dhyAnamE varamaina
songs.summary: Meditation on Rama is the true holy bath; ritual dips cannot wash away inner impurity.

lines.text: dhyAnamE varamaina gangA snAnamE manasA
lines.meaning: Meditation is the true bath in the Ganga, O mind.

lines.text: vAna nITa munuga munuga lOni vancana drOhamanu kara bOnA
lines.meaning: However often you dip in rainwater, will the inner stains of deceit and treachery wash away?

lines.text: paradhana nArImaNulanu dUri paranindala parahimsala mIri
lines.meaning: Shunning others' wealth and women, rising above slander and harm to others,

lines.text: dharanu velayu shrI rAmuni kOri tyAgarAju telusukonna rAma
lines.meaning: longing for Sri Rama who shines on earth — this is the Rama Tyagaraja came to know.

songs.title: rAma nI samAnamevaru
songs.summary: Who can equal Rama — with a devoted wife and brothers whose every word is honey?

lines.text: rAma nI samAnamevaru raghu vamshOddhAraka (samAnamevaru nI samAnamevaru)
lines.meaning: O Rama, who is your equal, uplifter of the Raghu race?

lines.text: bhAma maruvampu molaka bhaktiyanu panjarapu ciluka
lines.meaning: Your wife is like a tender shoot of the marjoram, a parrot in the cage of devotion;

lines.text: paluka palukulaku tEnelOluku mATalADu sOdarugala
lines.meaning: and you have brothers whose every word drips honey —

lines.text: hari tyAgarAja kula vibhUSaNa mrdu bhASaNa
lines.meaning: O Hari, jewel of Tyagaraja's family, of gentle speech.

songs.title: cakkani rAja
songs.summary: Why wander in side lanes when the royal road of devotion to Rama is there?

lines.text: cakkani rAja mArgamu lunDaga sandula dUranela O manasA
lines.meaning: When there's a fine royal highway, why wander in the lanes, O mind?

lines.text: cikkani pAlu mIgada unDaga chIyanu gangA sAgara mElE
lines.meaning: When rich milk and cream are at hand, why drink brackish water?

lines.text: kanTiki sundarataramagu rUpamE mukkaNTi nOTa celagE nAmamE tyAgarAjintanE
lines.meaning: The form most beautiful to the eye, the name that shines on the lips of three-eyed Shiva, on which Tyagaraja meditates,

lines.text: nelakonnadi daivamE iTuvaNTi shrI sAkEta rAmunimuni bhaktiyanE
lines.meaning: devotion to Sri Rama of Saketa, the God who dwells within — (that is the royal road).

songs.title: pakkala nilabaDi
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks Sita and Lakshmana to tell him the joy of standing beside Rama and serving him.

lines.text: pakkala nilabaDi golicE muccaTa bAga delpa rAdA
lines.meaning: Won't you tell me well the joy of standing beside him and serving him?

lines.text: cukkala rAyani gEru mOmugala sudati sItamma saumitri rAmuni kiru
lines.meaning: O Sita, whose face outshines the moon, and Saumitri — on either side of Rama,

lines.text: tanuvucE vandana monarincucunnArA canuvuna nAma kIrtana sEyucunnArA
lines.meaning: do you bow to him with your body? Do you sing his name with love?

lines.text: manasuna dalaci mE maraciyunnArA nenerunci tyAgarAjunitO harihari mIriru
lines.meaning: Do you hold him in your mind and forget yourselves? Tell Tyagaraja kindly, you two.

songs.title: mitri bhAgyamE
songs.summary: Lakshmana's fortune is the greatest fortune — he serves Rama closely and sees him in his true nature.

lines.text: mitri bhAgyamE bhAgyamu saumitri bhAgyamE bhAgyamu
lines.meaning: Lakshmana's fortune is fortune indeed — Saumitri's fortune is the true fortune;

lines.text: citra ratnamaya shESadalpamandu sItApatini yunici yucu sau
lines.meaning: seating the Lord of Sita on the wondrous jewelled bed of Shesha (and serving him) —

lines.text: bAguga vinta rAgamula nAlApamu sEyaga mEnu pulakarincaga
lines.meaning: as Rama sang wonderful ragas in alapana, his body thrilled with joy;

lines.text: tyAgarAja nutuDanu shrI rAmuni tatvArthamu pogaDi jUcu sau
lines.meaning: praising and beholding the true essence of Sri Rama, praised by Tyagaraja — (that is) Saumitri's fortune.

songs.title: viDamu sEyavE
songs.summary: A scene of service: betel is offered to Rama while Lakshmana and Shatrughna attend on him.

lines.text: viDamu sEyavE nannu viDa nADakavE
lines.meaning: Offer the betel roll — do not forsake me.

lines.text: puDami tanaya cEti manci maDupalanucu dalaci talaci
lines.meaning: Thinking again and again of the fine betel rolls from the hand of the Earth's daughter,

lines.text: rAjamAnyuDau saumitri ratana tamma paDiga baTTitEjarilla nilicinADu dEvadEva
lines.meaning: Saumitri, honoured by kings, and his younger brother stand radiant holding the golden spittoon, O God of gods;

lines.text: jAjikAyulu elakulu jApatri vakka lAkulu rAjarAjavara tyAgarAju prEmatO nosangE
lines.meaning: nutmeg, cardamom, mace, areca nut and betel leaves — Tyagaraja offers them with love, O best of kings.

songs.title: mOkshhamu galadA
songs.summary: There is no liberation for those without realisation, devotion and knowledge of music; nada is the path.

lines.text: mOkSamu galadA bhuvilO jIvanmuktulu gAni vAralaku
lines.meaning: Is there liberation on earth for those who are not liberated while living,

lines.text: sAkSAtkAra nI sadbhakti sangIta jnAna vihInulaku
lines.meaning: for those without direct realisation, true devotion to you, and knowledge of music?

lines.text: prANanAla sam-yOgamu valla praNava nAdamu sapta svaramulai bAraga
lines.meaning: From the union of breath and inner fire, the pranava nada arises and becomes the seven svaras —

lines.text: vINA vAdana lOluDau shivamanO vidha merugaru tyAgarAja vinuta
lines.meaning: they do not know the mind of Shiva who delights in playing the veena, O one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: telisi rAma
songs.summary: Chant Rama's name knowing its meaning: words like Rama, Arka and Aja have lowly and exalted meanings, and only the right understanding helps.

lines.text: telisi rAma cintanatO nAmamu sEyavE O manasA
lines.meaning: Knowing its meaning, chant the name with thought of Rama, O mind —

lines.text: talapu lanni nilipi nimiSamaina tAraka rUpuni nija tatvamulanu
lines.meaning: stilling all thoughts, even for a moment, (knowing) the true nature of the saving form.

lines.text: rAmAyaNa capalakSula pEru kAmAdula pOru vAru vIru
lines.meaning: 'Rama' is also a word for fickle-eyed women — for those who think so, the fight with desire goes on;

lines.text: rAmAyaNa brahmamunaku pEru AmAnava jananArtulu dIru
lines.meaning: 'Rama' is the name of the Brahman of the Ramayana — knowing that, the sorrows of birth end.

lines.text: akramanucu jilleDu taru pEru markaTa buddhu leTla dIru
lines.meaning: 'Arka' is a name for the milkweed plant — how will monkey minds (that think so) be cured?

lines.text: arkuDanucu bhAskaruniki pEru kutarkamanu andhakAramu dIru
lines.meaning: 'Arka' is a name for the Sun — knowing that, the darkness of false reasoning ends.

lines.text: ajamanucu mESamunaku pEru nija kOrika lElA gIDEru
lines.meaning: 'Aja' is a word for a goat — (thinking so,) how will true longing be fulfilled?

lines.text: ajuDani vAgIshavaruniki pEru vijayamu galgunu tyAgarAja nutuni
lines.meaning: 'Aja' is a name for Brahma, lord of speech — victory comes (from knowing) the one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: kaddanuvAriki
songs.summary: Will the elders' saying — that God is truly there for those who truly seek — be proven today?

lines.text: kaddanuvAriki kaddu kaddani morala nIDu peddala mATalu nEDabaddhamaunO
lines.meaning: 'For those who truly seek, he is truly there' — will the elders' words be proven today?

lines.text: addampu cekkillacE muddugAru mOmu jUDa buddhi galiginaTTi mA vadda ravadEmirA
lines.meaning: Why don't you come to us, who long to see your lovely face with mirror-bright cheeks?

lines.text: niddura nirAkarinci mudduga tambura baTTi shuddhamaina manasucE susvaramutO
lines.meaning: Giving up sleep, lovingly holding the tambura, with a pure mind and true pitch,

lines.text: baddu tappaka bhajiyincE bhakta pAlanamu sEyu taddaya shAlivi nIvE tyAgarAja sannuta
lines.meaning: those who worship you without fail — you are the compassionate one who protects such devotees, praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: dAsharathI
songs.summary: Tyagaraja wonders how he could ever repay his debt to Rama, who made his songs known far and wide.

lines.text: dAsharathI nI rNamu dIrpa nA taramA parama pAvana nAma
lines.meaning: O son of Dasharatha, can I ever repay my debt to you, O one of most holy name?

lines.text: AshadIra dUra dEshamulanu prakAshimpa jEsina rasika shirOmaNi
lines.meaning: O crown of connoisseurs, who made (my songs) shine in far-off lands to my heart's content!

lines.text: bhaktilEni kavijAla varEnyulu bhAva meruga lErani kalilOna jani
lines.meaning: Seeing that, in the Kali age, even the best of poets without devotion cannot grasp the true feeling,

lines.text: bhukti mukti galgunani kIrtanamula bOdhincina tyAgarAja karArcita
lines.meaning: you taught through kirtanas that worldly and spiritual fulfilment both come (through devotion) — you who are worshipped by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: endu dAginADO
songs.summary: Where is Rama hiding? He came for Prahlada and Sugriva — why not now for his devotee?

lines.text: endu dAginADO IDaku rA nannEDu daya vaccurA O manasA
lines.meaning: Where is he hiding? Will he take pity and come here today, O mind?

lines.text: enduku capalamu vinavE nA manavini mundaTivale bhaktula pOSincuTak-
lines.meaning: Why this fickleness? Hear my plea — (he who used) to nurture devotees as before —

lines.text: alanADu kanakakashipu niNDAru calamu jEsi sutuni sakala bAdhala beTTaga madini
lines.meaning: once, when Hiranyakashipu in hatred inflicted every torment on his own son,

lines.text: tALaka nishcaludaina prahlAdu kOraku kambamu lOpala nuNDaga lEdA yArIti nEd-
lines.meaning: was he not inside the pillar for steadfast Prahlada, who could not bear it? How, then, (not) now?

lines.text: munu vArivAha vAhana tanayudu madamuna ravijuni cAla goTTuTa jUchi manasu tALajAla
lines.meaning: Earlier, when Indra's son (Vali) in pride beat Sugriva, son of the Sun — unable to bear the sight,

lines.text: lEka prEmamuna pAlanamu sEya tALa taruvu maruguna nilvaga lEdA yArIti nEd-
lines.meaning: did he not stand behind the palmyra tree to lovingly protect him? How, then, (not) now?

lines.text: toli janmamula nADu jEsina duSkarmamula nanaganu sEya nAru satrulanu baTTi pODisEya
lines.meaning: To destroy the evil deeds of past births and to seize and crush the six inner enemies,

lines.text: nadiyugAka ilalO cancala virahita nijabhakta janulanu tyAgarAjuni rakSimpa nE
lines.meaning: and moreover to protect steadfast true devotees in this world, and Tyagaraja — (where is he hiding?)

songs.title: rAju veDale
songs.summary: A description of Lord Ranganatha of Srirangam setting out in a royal procession.

lines.text: rAju veDale jUtAmurArE kastUri ranga
lines.meaning: The King goes in procession — come and see, Kasturi Ranga!

lines.text: tEjinekki samastarAju lUDigamu jEya tEjarillu navaratnapu divya bhUSaNamu liDi ranga
lines.meaning: Mounted on a horse, with all kings serving him, wearing radiant ornaments of the nine gems — Ranga!

lines.text: kAvEri tIramunanu pAvanamagu rangapurini shrI velayu citta vidhilO vETkaga rAga
lines.meaning: In holy Srirangam on the banks of the Kaveri, coming in splendour along the Chitra street,

lines.text: sEvanu gAni surulu virulacE pUjincaga bhAvincu tyAgarAju bADaga vaibhOga ranga
lines.meaning: as the gods worship him with flowers and Tyagaraja sings, imagining it — Ranga in all his glory.

songs.title: kOTinAdalu
songs.summary: When ten million holy rivers are present at Dhanushkoti (Rama's feet), why wander to pilgrimages?

lines.text: kOTinAdulu dhanuskOTilO nuNDaga ETiki tirigEdavE O manasA
lines.meaning: When ten million rivers are in Dhanushkoti, why do you wander, O mind?

lines.text: sUTiga shyAmasundara mUrtini mATi mATiki jUcE mahArAjulaku
lines.meaning: For the great ones who directly behold the dark, handsome form again and again —

lines.text: ganga nUpurambunanu janincanu rangani kAvEri gani rajillanu
lines.meaning: the Ganga was born from his anklet; the Kaveri shines beside Ranganatha;

lines.text: pongucu shrI raghunAthuni prEmatO bogadE tyAgarAju manavi vinavE
lines.meaning: overflowing with love, Tyagaraja praises Sri Raghunatha — hear his plea.

songs.title: Emi jEsitE
songs.summary: What use are wealth, rituals, fame or learning without Rama's grace?

lines.text: Emi jEsitE nEmi shrI rAma svAmi karuNa lEni vArilalO
lines.meaning: What does it matter what one does, if one lacks the grace of Lord Sri Rama,

lines.text: kAma mOha dAsulai shrI rAmuni kaTTu teliyani vArilalO
lines.meaning: among those who, slaves to desire and delusion, do not know the ways of Sri Rama?

lines.text: immu kaligitE nEmi illAliki sommu beTTite Emi kamma
lines.meaning: What if one has comforts? What if one adorns one's wife with jewels? What if

lines.text: viltu kElini delisi Emi tammi kantiv ni karuNalEni vArilalO
lines.meaning: one knows the play of Manmatha's bow? — among those without the grace of the lotus-eyed one.

lines.text: savamu jEsitE nEmi kalimini putrOtsavamu galigitE nEmi bhuvilOnanya
lines.meaning: What if one performs sacrifices? What if, with wealth, one celebrates the birth of sons? What if one takes

lines.text: bIja janituni goni Emi shivakara shrI rAmuni dayalEni vArilalO
lines.meaning: on another's child as one's own? — among those without the grace of auspicious Sri Rama.

lines.text: meDagaTTitE nEmi anduna lAndaru jODu gaTTitE nEmi cEDiyalanu
lines.meaning: What if one builds mansions? What if many there marry? What if one knows how to

lines.text: meppinca delisitE nEmi IDulEni rAmuni dayalEni vArilalO
lines.meaning: please women? — among those without the grace of peerless Rama.

lines.text: rAjyamElitE nEmi bahujanulalO pUjyulaitE nEmi Ajya pravAhamutO
lines.meaning: What if one rules a kingdom? What if one is revered among many? What if, with streams of ghee,

lines.text: nannamiDitE nEmi pUjyuDaina rAmuni dayalEni vArilalO
lines.meaning: one feeds rice (to many)? — among those without the grace of revered Rama.

lines.text: guruvu tAnaitE nEmi kaNTiki mEnu guruvai tOcitE nEmi vara
lines.meaning: What if one becomes a guru? What if one looks weighty to the eye? What if

lines.text: mantramanyula-kupadEshincatE nEmi vara tyAgarAja nutuni dayalEni vArilalO
lines.meaning: one teaches great mantras to others? — among those without the grace of the Lord praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: kaligiyunTEgadA
songs.summary: Only what is destined comes to pass; Tyagaraja recalls how the great devotees were blessed.

lines.text: kaligiyuNTEgadA galgunu kAmita phaladAyaka
lines.meaning: Only if it is destined will it come to pass, O granter of wishes.

lines.text: kalini ingita mErugaka ninnADukoNTi calamu cEyaka nA talanu cakkani vrAta
lines.meaning: Not understanding the ways of the Kali age, I blamed you; it comes only if good fortune is written on my head.

lines.text: bhAgavatAgrEsarulagu nArada prahlAda parAshara rAmadAsulu
lines.meaning: The foremost devotees — Narada, Prahlada, Parashara and Ramadasa —

lines.text: bAguga shrI raghu rAmuni padamula bhakti jEsina rIti tyAgarAjunikipuDu
lines.meaning: the way they worshipped Sri Raghurama's feet so well — (if it is destined) for Tyagaraja now, (it will come).

songs.title: nanu pAlimpa
songs.summary: Tyagaraja greets Rama, who has walked all the way to protect him, and describes his form.

lines.text: nanu pAlimpa naDaci vaccitivO nA prANanAtha
lines.meaning: Have you walked all the way here to protect me, O lord of my life?

lines.text: vanaja nayana mOmunu jUcuTa jIvanamani nenaru nA manasu marmamu telisi
lines.meaning: O lotus-eyed one, knowing the secret of my heart — that seeing your face is my very life —

lines.text: surapati nIla maNinibha tanuvutO nuramuna mutyapu sarula cayamutO
lines.meaning: with a body like the sapphire of Indra, with strings of pearls on your chest,

lines.text: karamuna shara kOdaNDa kAntitO dharani tanayatO tyAgarAjArcita
lines.meaning: with the gleam of the arrow and Kodanda bow in your hand, with the Earth's daughter — O one worshipped by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: mOhana rAma
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks the enchanting Rama to speak sweetly to him, and describes how gods took animal forms to serve him.

lines.text: mOhana rAma mukhajita sOma mudduga balkumA
lines.meaning: Enchanting Rama, whose face outshines the moon, speak to me sweetly.

lines.text: mOhana rAma modaTi daivamA mOhamu nIpai monasi yunnAdira
lines.meaning: Enchanting Rama, first among gods, my love for you has blossomed.

lines.text: dhara manujAvatAra mahima vini sura kinnara kimpurusha vidyAdhara surapati vidhi
lines.meaning: Hearing of the glory of your incarnation as a man on earth, the gods, kinnaras, kimpurushas, vidyadharas, Indra, Brahma,

lines.text: vibhAkara candrAdulu-karagucu prEmatO vara mruga pakSi vAnara tanuvulacE girini
lines.meaning: the sun, the moon and others melted, and with love, in the forms of beasts, birds and monkeys, on the mountain

lines.text: velayu sItAvara cirakAlamu guri maimaraci sEvinciri vara tyAgarAja varadAkhila jagan
lines.meaning: they long served you, O shining Lord of Sita, forgetting themselves — O giver of boons to Tyagaraja, Lord of the whole world.

songs.title: evarUrA ninnu vinA
songs.summary: Who is our refuge except Rama? Tyagaraja pleads against Rama's delay and coolness.

lines.text: evarUrA ninnu vinA gati mAku
lines.meaning: Who is there, other than you, as our refuge?

lines.text: savana rakSaka nityOtsava sItApati
lines.meaning: Protector of the sacrifice, ever festive, Lord of Sita!

lines.text: rAdA nAdupai nI daya vinarAdA muravairi gAdA daya balka
lines.meaning: Won't your grace come upon me? Won't you listen? Aren't you the enemy of Mura? Won't you speak kindly?

lines.text: rAdA idi mariyAd nAtO vAdamA nE bhEdamA mAku
lines.meaning: Is this proper toward me? Is it a quarrel? Is there any difference between us?

lines.text: rAka nannEca nyAyamA parAkA nEnaNTE hEyamA rAma rAka-
lines.meaning: Is it right to tease me by not coming? Is it indifference, or am I loathsome to you, Rama?

lines.text: shashimukha nI kAshinciti sAku mA puNya shlOkamA mAku
lines.meaning: O moon-faced one, I have longed for you — enough now, O one of holy fame, for us.

lines.text: shrIshAri ganArAtivi nA dAsa teliyaka bOtivi ApagEshArcita
lines.meaning: Lord of Lakshmi, enemy of demons, you went away without knowing your servant; O one worshipped by Shiva,

lines.text: pAlitEsha nA prakAshamA sva prakAshamA mAku
lines.meaning: protector of all, my light, self-luminous one, for us —

lines.text: rAjA bigu nIkElarA tyAgarAjArcita tALajAlarA rAja I jAlamu
lines.meaning: O king, why this stiffness? Worshipped by Tyagaraja — I cannot bear this delay, O king;

lines.text: sEya rAja brOva sankOcamA sura bhUjamA mAku
lines.meaning: do you hesitate to protect me, O king, our wish-fulfilling tree?

songs.title: bhavanuta nA
songs.summary: A tender song inviting Rama to rest in the devotee's heart and recover from all his labours for his devotees.

lines.text: bhavanuta nA hrdayamuna ramimpumu baDalika dIra
lines.meaning: O one praised by Shiva, rest in my heart, so your weariness may pass.

lines.text: bhava tAraka nAtO bahu balkina baDalika dIra kamala sam
lines.meaning: Saviour from worldly bondage — so the weariness of talking at length with me may pass, O lotus-(eyed one),

lines.text: pavanasuta priya tanakai dirigina baDalika dIra
lines.meaning: dear to Hanuman — so the weariness of wandering for his sake may pass,

lines.text: bhavanamu jEri nanu vErapincina baDalika dIra kamala sam
lines.meaning: so the weariness of coming to my house and testing me may pass, O lotus-(eyed one),

lines.text: varamagu naivEdyamulanu jEyani baDalika dIra
lines.meaning: so the weariness of my not offering you fine food may pass,

lines.text: paravalEka saripOyinaTTADina baDalika dIra kamala sam
lines.meaning: so the weariness of acting as though it didn't matter may pass, O lotus-(eyed one),

lines.text: prabala jEsi nanu brOcEdavanukonna-baDalika dIra
lines.meaning: so the weariness of resolving to protect me mightily may pass,

lines.text: prabhuvu nIvu tyAgarAjuniki baDalika dIra kamala sam
lines.meaning: you are Tyagaraja's lord — so your weariness may pass, O lotus-(eyed one).

songs.title: nI daya rAdA
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks why Rama's compassion has not come to him, when he has no other protector.

lines.text: nI daya rAda
lines.meaning: Won't your compassion come to me?

lines.text: kadanE vArevaru kalyANarAma
lines.meaning: Who is there to say otherwise, O Kalyana Rama?

lines.text: nannu brOcuvarilanu nADE teliya ina vamsha nI kinta tAmasamA
lines.meaning: Long ago I knew there was none else to protect me — O scion of the Solar race, why such delay?

lines.text: anniTikinadhikAruDani nE bogaDitE mannincitE nIdu mahimaku takkuva
lines.meaning: If I praise you as master of all and you forgive me, would that lessen your greatness?

lines.text: rAma rAma rAma tyAgarAja hrtsadana nAmadi tallaDillE nyAyamA vEgamE
lines.meaning: Rama, Rama, Rama, dweller in Tyagaraja's heart — is it fair that my mind is in turmoil? Come quickly.

songs.title: sItamma mAyamma
songs.summary: Tyagaraja names Rama's family as his own: Sita and Rama his parents, the great devotees his brothers and kin.

lines.text: sItamma mAyamma shrI rAmuDu mA taNDri
lines.meaning: Sita is our mother; Sri Rama is our father.

lines.text: vAtAtmaja saumitri vainatEya ripu mardana dhAta bharatAdulu sOdraulu mAku O manasa
lines.meaning: Hanuman son of the Wind, Saumitri, Garuda, Shatrughna, Bharata and the others are our brothers, O mind.

lines.text: paramEsha vashiSTha parAshara nArada shaunaka suka surapati gautama lambOdara guha sanakAdulu
lines.meaning: Shiva, Vasishtha, Parashara, Narada, Shaunaka, Shuka, Indra, Gautama, Ganesha, Guha, Sanaka and the others,

lines.text: dharaija bhAgavatA-grEsaru levvarO vArellaru vara tyAgarAjuniki parama bAndhavulu manasA
lines.meaning: and whoever are the foremost devotees on earth — all of them are Tyagaraja's dearest kin, O mind.

songs.title: rAma bhakti sAmrAjyam
songs.summary: The kingdom of devotion to Rama: rare to attain, beyond description, known only by experience.

lines.text: rAma bhakti sAmrAjyam EmAnavula kabbenO manasA
lines.meaning: The empire of devotion to Rama — which fortunate men attain it, O mind?

lines.text: AmAnavula sandarshana matyanta brahmANDamE
lines.meaning: The very sight of such people is supreme bliss itself.

lines.text: ilAgani vivarimpa lEnu cAla svAnubhava vEdyamE
lines.meaning: I cannot describe it as 'it is like this' — it is known only through one's own experience,

lines.text: lIlA shrSTa jagatrayamE kOlAhala tyAgarAja nutuDaku
lines.meaning: (devotion) to the Lord who created the three worlds in play, praised by Tyagaraja amid the joyous music.

songs.title: giripai nelakonna
songs.summary: Tyagaraja describes a vision of Rama on the hill, served by his attendants, who promised to protect him.

lines.text: giripai nelakonna rAmuni guri tappaka kanTi
lines.meaning: I saw clearly Rama dwelling on the mountain,

lines.text: parivArulu virisuraTulachEbaDi visaruchu gosaruchu sEvimpaga
lines.meaning: as his attendants served him, fanning with flower fans and fly-whisks.

lines.text: pulakAnkituDai AnandASruvula nimpuchu mATalADavalenani
lines.meaning: Thrilled, my eyes filling with tears of joy, longing to speak with him,

lines.text: kalavarinchagani padi pUTalapai gAchedananu tyAgarAja vinutuni
lines.meaning: I saw, as in a dream, the Lord praised by Tyagaraja, who said 'In ten days I will protect you'.

songs.title: vandanamu raghunandana
songs.summary: A string of salutations and loving reproaches to Rama, ending with his name as the daily discipline.

lines.text: vandanamu raghunandana sEtu bandhana bhakta candana rAma
lines.meaning: Salutations, delight of the Raghus, builder of the bridge, cool sandal-paste to devotees, O Rama.

lines.text: shrIdamA nAtO vAdamA nE bhEdamA idi mOdamA rAma
lines.meaning: Lord of Lakshmi, is this a quarrel with me? Am I apart from you? Does this please you, Rama?

lines.text: shrI rAma hrccaramA brOva bhAramA rAya bAramA rAma
lines.meaning: Sri Rama, who moves in the heart, is protecting me a burden? Is it too heavy for a king, Rama?

lines.text: viNTini nammu koNTini sharraNaNtini rammaNTini rAma
lines.meaning: I heard of you, I trusted you, I said 'refuge', I said 'come', Rama.

lines.text: Odanu bhakti vIDanu orula vEDanu nIvADanu rAma
lines.meaning: I won't swerve, I won't leave devotion, I won't beg others — I am yours, Rama.

lines.text: kammani viDa mimmani varamu kommani paluka rammani rAma
lines.meaning: I said 'give me fragrant betel', I said 'grant me a boon', I said 'come and speak', Rama.

lines.text: nyAyamA nIku dAyamA inka hEyamA munigEyamA rAma
lines.meaning: Is it fair? Is this your inheritance? Am I so despicable? Is this what the sages sang of you, Rama?

lines.text: cUDumi kApADumi mammu pODimigaA gUDumi rAma
lines.meaning: Look at me, protect me, unite with us in splendour, Rama.

lines.text: kSEmamu divya dhAmamu nitya nEmamu rAma nAmamu rAma
lines.meaning: Well-being, the divine abode, the daily discipline — is the name of Rama, Rama.

lines.text: vEgarA karuNa sAgarA shrI tyAgarAja hrdayAgArA rAma
lines.meaning: Come quickly, ocean of compassion, dweller in Sri Tyagaraja's heart, Rama.

songs.title: ennaga manasuku
songs.summary: What use are eyes, body, hands and tongue that are not used to see, embrace, worship and praise the Lord?

lines.text: ennaga manasuku rAni pannagashAAyi sogasu pannuga ganugonani
lines.meaning: Eyes that do not fully behold the beauty of the serpent-reclining Lord, beyond the mind's grasp —

lines.text: kannulElE kannu lElE kaNTi minnulElE
lines.meaning: why have eyes, why have eyes, why their sparkle?

lines.text: mOhamutO nIlavAri vahana kAntini gErina shrI harini gattukonani
lines.meaning: A body that does not lovingly embrace Sri Hari, whose radiance surpasses the dark rain cloud —

lines.text: dEhamElE dEhamElE I gEhamElE
lines.meaning: why a body, why a body, why this house?

lines.text: sarasija malle tulasi viruvAji pArijAta virulacE bUjincani
lines.meaning: Hands that do not worship him with lotus, jasmine, tulasi, viruvaji and parijata flowers —

lines.text: karamulElE karamulElE I kApuramulElE
lines.meaning: why hands, why hands, why this household life?

lines.text: mAlimitO tyAgarAju nElina rAmamUrtini lAlinci pogaDani
lines.meaning: A tongue that does not cherish and praise the form of Rama, who ruled Tyagaraja with love —

lines.text: nAlikElE nAlikElE sUtra mAlikElE
lines.meaning: why a tongue, why a tongue, why a rosary?

songs.title: uyyAlalUga vaiyya
songs.summary: A lullaby inviting Rama to swing on the swing as gods, sages and devotees sing to him.

lines.text: uyyAlalUgavayya shrI rAma
lines.meaning: Swing on the swing, Sri Rama,

lines.text: sayyAta pATalanu sat-sArvabhauma
lines.meaning: (listening to) bedtime songs, O true emperor.

lines.text: kamalajAdyakhila surulu ninu koluva vimalulaina munIndrulu
lines.meaning: As Brahma and all the gods serve you, as pure sages

lines.text: dhyAnimpa kamanIya bhAgavatulu guNa kIrtanamulu nAlApambula sEyaga
lines.meaning: meditate on you, and lovely devotees sing your virtues and alapanas,

lines.text: nAradAdulu merayacu nutiyimpa sAramulu bAga vinucu ninnu
lines.meaning: as Narada and others praise you resplendently, as you listen to their essence,

lines.text: nammuvArala sadA brOcucu vEda sAra saphalanu jUcucu shrI rAma
lines.meaning: ever protecting those who trust you, beholding the fruit of the Vedas' essence, Sri Rama,

lines.text: nava mOhanangulaina sura satulu vivaramuga bADaga nI bhAgyamA
lines.meaning: as celestial women of fresh charm sing in detail — such is your fortune!

lines.text: navaratna maNTapamuna tyAgarAja vinutAkrti bUnina shrI rAma
lines.meaning: In the hall of nine gems, Sri Rama, who took the form praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: shrI raghuvara
songs.summary: A prayer to Rama, the immeasurable, lover of music, praised by Narada.

lines.text: shrI raghuvara-apramEya mAmava
lines.meaning: O Raghuvara, immeasurable one, protect me.

lines.text: shrI raghukula jalanidhi sOma shrI rAma pAlaya
lines.meaning: Moon to the ocean of the Raghu race, Sri Rama, protect me.

lines.text: sArasa hita kulAbja bhrnga sangIta lOla
lines.meaning: Bee to the lotus of the Solar race, lover of music,

lines.text: virOcana kulEshvara svara layAdi mUrcanOllAsita nArada vinuta
lines.meaning: lord of the Solar race, praised by Narada who delights in svara, laya and murchana,

lines.text: shrI bhAskara kulAdri dIpa shrI bhAgavata vinuta sucaraNa
lines.meaning: lamp on the mountain of the Solar race, whose holy feet are praised by great devotees,

lines.text: sItA nAtha (bhAgadEya) tyAgarAjanuta nIla sutApta suguNAbharaNa
lines.meaning: Lord of Sita, praised by Tyagaraja, dear friend of the monkey chiefs, adorned with virtues.

songs.title: mA jAnaki
songs.summary: Tyagaraja tells Rama that it was Sita, by holding his hand, who made him great: she let him have the glory of slaying Ravana.

lines.text: mA jAnaki ceTTa baTTaga maharAja vaitivi
lines.meaning: By taking the hand of our Janaki, you became a great king.

lines.text: rAja rAjavara rAjIvAkSa vinu rAvaNAdiyani rAjillu kIrtiyu
lines.meaning: Best of kings, lotus-eyed one, listen: the fame that shines — 'he slew Ravana and others' —

lines.text: kAnakEgi yAjnA mIraka mAyAkara munici shikhi centanE yuNDi dAnavuni
lines.meaning: going to the forest, never disobeying your command, she left her illusory form and stayed within the fire;

lines.text: ventanE cani yashOkatani mUlanuNDi vAni mATalaku gOpaginci kaNTa vidhiyincakanE
lines.meaning: she followed the demon, stayed at the foot of the Ashoka tree, burned at his words, yet did not destroy him with a glance —

lines.text: yuNDi shrI nAyaka yashamu nIkE kalgajEya lEdA tyAgarAja paripAla
lines.meaning: staying so, did she not make the glory yours alone, O Lord of Lakshmi, protector of Tyagaraja?

songs.title: evarimATa
songs.summary: Whose words have you heeded, Rama, that you will not come? Tyagaraja believed you were the devotees' servant and true to your word.

lines.text: evarimATa vinnAvO rAvO indu lEvO bhaLi bhaLi
lines.meaning: Whose words did you listen to? Won't you come? Are you not here? Bravo, bravo!

lines.text: avanilO nArsEya paurusEya mandi cOdya meruga lEnayya
lines.meaning: I cannot understand this puzzle — people on earth speak of your humanity and valour.

lines.text: bhakta parAdhInuDanucu parama bhAgavatula vyakta rUpuDai palikina muccaTa-
lines.meaning: That you are subservient to your devotees — the words of great devotees who saw your manifest form —

lines.text: yuktamanuchu uNTi shakti gala mahAdEvuDu nIvani santOSamuna
lines.meaning: I believed them true; I was happy, thinking you the all-powerful great God,

lines.text: nuNTi satta cittuDagu tyAgarAjanuta satya sandhuDanukoNTi nilalO
lines.meaning: and I took you, praised by pure-minded Tyagaraja, to be true to your word on this earth.

songs.title: O rangashAyi
songs.summary: Tyagaraja calls on Ranganatha of Srirangam: when called, won't you answer and come?

lines.text: O rangashAyi pilacitE O yanucu rA rAdA
lines.meaning: O Ranganatha, reclining one, when I call, won't you answer 'O' and come?

lines.text: sAranga varuDu jUci kailAsAdhipuDu gAlEdA
lines.meaning: Did not Shiva, by beholding you, become lord of Kailasa?

lines.text: bhUlOka vaikuNTham idiyani nIlOna nIvE yuppongi
lines.meaning: Thinking 'this is Vaikuntha on earth', you are swelling with joy within yourself;

lines.text: shrI lOluDai yuNTe mA cintadire dennaDo mElOrva
lines.meaning: if you remain lost in Lakshmi like this, when will our worries end?

lines.text: lEni janulalO nE migula nOgili divya rUpamunu mutyAla
lines.meaning: Among people who cannot bear another's good, I suffered greatly; to see your divine form

lines.text: saruLa yuramunu gana vacciti tyAgarAja hrd-bhUSaNa
lines.meaning: and chest adorned with pearl strings I have come, O ornament of Tyagaraja's heart.

songs.title: entani nE
songs.summary: How can one describe the good fortune of Shabari, who served Rama with fruits and attained the highest state?

lines.text: entani nE varNintunu shabarI bhAgyam-
lines.meaning: How can I describe Shabari's good fortune?

lines.text: dAntula vara kAntalu jagamanta nindi uNDagan-
lines.meaning: Though the world is full of noble women of self-control,

lines.text: kanulAra sEvinci kammani phalamula nosagi tanuvu pulakarinca
lines.meaning: she served Rama to her eyes' content, offered him sweet fruits, her body thrilling,

lines.text: pAdayugamulaku mrokka ina kulapati samukhambuna punarAvrtti
lines.meaning: bowed at his feet, and in the presence of the lord of the Solar race attained the state of no return —

lines.text: rahita padamunu bondina tyAgarAjanuturAli puNyamunu
lines.meaning: the merit of that woman, praised by Tyagaraja!

songs.title: kshINamai tiruga
songs.summary: Give up attainments that wane and lead to rebirth; worship of Rama is the path to the lasting abode.

lines.text: kSINamai tiruga janmincu siddhi mAnurA O manasA
lines.meaning: O mind, give up the attainments that wane and lead to rebirth —

lines.text: gIrvANa nATakAlankAra vEda purANa yajna japa tapAdula phalamulu
lines.meaning: the fruits of Sanskrit drama, poetics, Vedas, Puranas, sacrifice, japa and penance.

lines.text: Edi jEsina jagannAthuDu shiramuna hrdayamuna vahinci
lines.meaning: Whatever you do, carry the Lord of the world on your head and in your heart;

lines.text: padilamaina satpadamu nosange bATa tyAgarAja vinutuni bhajana rA
lines.meaning: worship of the one praised by Tyagaraja is the path that grants the true, lasting abode.

songs.title: muripEmu galigegadA
songs.summary: Tyagaraja imagines Rama delighting in having made his home in Tiruvaiyaru (Panchanada) on the Kaveri, a city more beautiful than heaven.

lines.text: munipEmu galgaegadA rAma sanmuninuta karivarada shrI rAma
lines.meaning: Haven't you become proud and happy, Rama, praised by sages, giver of boons to the elephant king, Sri Rama?

lines.text: parama puruSa jagadIsha vara mrdu bhASa suguNa maNikOSa nIku
lines.meaning: O Supreme Person, Lord of the world, of gentle speech, treasury of jewel-like virtues — for you,

lines.text: ItulEni malaya mArutamuce gUDina kAvEri taTamandu mEDala middelatO
lines.meaning: on the banks of the Kaveri, touched by the matchless Malaya breeze, with mansions and terraces,

lines.text: shrngAramu mincu sadanamulalO vEDucu bhUsurala agnihOtrulai vEda ghOSamulace
lines.meaning: in houses shining with beauty, where Brahmins tend the sacred fires and with Vedic chants

lines.text: nutiyimpa jUDa shivuDu gOru yOgyamaina sundaramagu purame dorake nanucu
lines.meaning: praise you — thinking 'I have found a fitting, beautiful city that even Shiva longs for',

lines.text: sakala sugandha rAja sumamulu sa-lalitamagu kOkila nAdambulu shuka mukha sanakAdula
lines.meaning: with every fragrant royal flower, the sweet calls of cuckoos, praised by Shuka, Sanaka and others,

lines.text: nutamaina sura taruvulu galigi nikaTamandu vANi koluva surapati nIlamaNi nibha sharIra
lines.meaning: with wish-fulfilling trees, with Sarasvati serving nearby, O you whose body is like Indra's sapphire,

lines.text: nEDu prakaTamaina navaratna khacita hATaka maNTapa vAsamu galigE nanucu
lines.meaning: today, thinking 'I have a dwelling in a golden pavilion studded with nine gems',

lines.text: I mahilO sogasaina cOLa sImayandu varamaina pancanada puradhamuni centanu
lines.meaning: in this world, in the beautiful Chola country, beside the noble Lord of Panchanada,

lines.text: vAsincuTakai nImadi nEncaga kAmajanaka tyAgarAja sannuta nAma pavana tanaya vidhrta
lines.meaning: having resolved in your heart to dwell, O father of Manmatha, of name praised by Tyagaraja, whose feet Hanuman holds,

lines.text: caraNa kSEmamuga vArdhillunaTTi puramuna sIta bhAma saumitri prakka golicedarani
lines.meaning: in a town that prospers in well-being, with Sita and Saumitri serving at your side.

songs.title: bhavamAna (nI nAmarUpamula) (mangaLam)
songs.summary: A mangalam (closing benediction): eternal victory and auspiciousness to Rama's name and form.

lines.text: nI nAma rUpamulaku nitya jaya mangaLam
lines.meaning: To your name and form, eternal victory and auspiciousness!

lines.text: pavamAna sutuDu baTTu pAdAra vindamulaku
lines.meaning: To the lotus feet held by Hanuman, son of the Wind,

lines.text: navamukta hAramlu naTiyuncE yuramunaku
lines.meaning: to the chest adorned with fresh pearl necklaces,

lines.text: naLinArigEru ciru navvugala mOmunaku
lines.meaning: to the face with a gentle smile that outshines the moon,

lines.text: pankajAkSi nelakonna anga yugamunaku
lines.meaning: to your side, where lotus-eyed Sita is seated,

lines.text: prahlAda nAradAdi bhaktulu pogaDakuNTE
lines.meaning: to you whom Prahlada, Narada and other devotees praise,

lines.text: rAjIva nayana tyAgarAjDdi vinutamaina
lines.meaning: to the lotus-eyed one praised by Tyagaraja and others — (victory and auspiciousness).

songs.title: mElukO dayAnidhi
songs.summary: A morning song waking Rama at sunrise, with offerings ready and sages and kings waiting to serve.

lines.text: mElukO dayAnidhi mElukO dAsharathi
lines.meaning: Wake up, treasure of compassion; wake up, son of Dasharatha.

lines.text: mElukO dayAnidhi mitrOdauamau vELa
lines.meaning: Wake up, treasure of compassion — it is the hour of sunrise.

lines.text: vennapAlu bangAru ginnElenE nuncinAnu tinnaga nAraginci tETa kannulatO nannu brOva
lines.meaning: I have set butter and milk in golden bowls; eat them, and protect me with your clear eyes.

lines.text: nAradAdi munulu sarulu vArija bhavuDindu kalAdharuDu nI sannidhi nE kOri koluvu gAcinru
lines.meaning: Narada and the sages, Brahma and Shiva who wears the moon wait to serve in your presence.

lines.text: rAjAdi digrAjulella vaccinAru rAja teliya tyAgarAja vinuta nannu brOva
lines.meaning: Kings and the guardians of the directions have all come, O king; praised by Tyagaraja, protect me.

songs.title: kshIrasAgara shayana
songs.summary: Tyagaraja recalls how Vishnu rushed to save Gajendra, Draupadi and Ramadasa, and asks why he must remain in worry.

lines.text: kSIrasAgara shayana nannu cintala beTTa valEna rAma
lines.meaning: O you who recline on the ocean of milk, must you keep me in worry, Rama?

lines.text: vAraNa rAjunu brOvunu vEgamE vaccinadi vinnAnurA rAma
lines.meaning: I have heard how swiftly you came to save the king of elephants, Rama.

lines.text: nArImaNiki jIra liccinadi nADE nE vinnAnurA dhIruDau rAmadAsuni bandhamu dIrcinadi vinnAnurA
lines.meaning: I heard how you gave garments to the jewel among women long ago; I heard how you freed brave Ramadasa from prison.

lines.text: nIrajAkSikai nIradhi dATina nI kIrtini vinnAnurA tArakanAma tyAgarAjanuta dayatO nElukOra rAma
lines.meaning: I have heard of your fame in crossing the ocean for lotus-eyed Sita; O one whose name saves, praised by Tyagaraja, rule me with compassion, Rama.

songs.title: vinAyakuni valEnu
songs.summary: A prayer to Kamakshi of Kanchipuram to protect the singer as lovingly as she protects her son Vinayaka.

lines.text: vinAyakuni valEnu brOvavE ninu vInA vElpulavaramma
lines.meaning: Protect me as you protect Vinayaka; who among the gods is like you, Mother?

lines.text: anAtha rakSaki shrI kAmAkSi sujanAgha mOcani shankari janani
lines.meaning: Protector of the helpless, Sri Kamakshi, remover of the sins of the good, Shankari, Mother!

lines.text: nArAdhamulakunu varAlosaga nuNDa rAmulai bhUsurAdi dEvatulu
lines.meaning: Even as you grant boons to the lowliest of men, Brahmins and gods praise you;

lines.text: rAyadini jendarAdu daya jUDa rAdA kAncIpurAdi nAyaki
lines.meaning: can I not attain (your grace)? Won't you look on me with compassion, O queen of Kanchipura?

lines.text: pitAmahuDu jana hitArthamai ninnu tE teliya vEDa tALimi gala
lines.meaning: For the good of the world, Brahma prayed to you; though you are patient,

lines.text: avatArametti ikanu tAmasamu sEya tALa jAlamu natArti hAriNi
lines.meaning: you took incarnation — I cannot bear any more delay, O remover of the sorrows of those who bow.

lines.text: birAna dayacE girAlu mAkuniki rAjEsi brOcu rAjadhari
lines.meaning: Quickly, with compassion, grant us lasting fortune and protect us, O sovereign one,

lines.text: tyAgarAjuni hrdaya sarOja mElina murAri sOdari parAshakti nanu
lines.meaning: sister of Vishnu, who rules the lotus of Tyagaraja's heart, Parashakti — (protect) me.

songs.title: nAdupai balikEru
songs.summary: Tyagaraja answers those who speak ill of him: he never sought wealth, power or flattery, only Rama's worship.

lines.text: nAdupai balikEru narulu vEdasannuta bhavamu vEru jEsiti nanucu
lines.meaning: People speak ill of me, O one praised by the Vedas, saying I broke up the family.

lines.text: panca sara janaka prapancamuna gala sukhamu mancuvale nanucu madi nencitini
lines.meaning: I did think that the pleasures of Manmatha's world melt away like snow;

lines.text: gAni pancukoni dhana mularjincukoni sariyevvarancu mari gatiyu lEdanucu balkitinA
lines.meaning: but did I divide and hoard wealth and say 'who is my equal', or that there is no other refuge?

lines.text: dinamu nityOtsavamuna kAsa jenditi nA manasuna illu okaTiyani yuNTigAni
lines.meaning: I longed for daily festive worship of you; in my mind the household was one;

lines.text: anudinamu nOrula mElanu jUci tALalEkanu reNDu sEyavale nanucu balkitinA
lines.meaning: did I, unable to bear others' prosperity day after day, say it must be split in two?

lines.text: prANamE pAtiyani mAnamE mElaNTi gAni shrI rAma paramAnanda jaladhi
lines.meaning: I held my life cheap and honour high, O Sri Rama, ocean of supreme bliss;

lines.text: shrInAtha kulamulO lEni dArani baTTi jAnEDudaramu nimpa norula pogaDitinA
lines.meaning: did I take a path unknown in the Lord's lineage, and flatter others to fill my belly?

lines.text: AjAnubhAyua shrI jAnakIpati payOkSa shrI tyAgarAjanuta caraNa
lines.meaning: Long-armed Lord of Janaki, lotus-eyed, whose feet Tyagaraja praises,

lines.text: I jagatilO ninnu pUjincuvAri navyAjamuna brOcu surAja nI vADaina
lines.meaning: who protects without pretext those who worship you in this world — good king, I am yours.

songs.title: rAma kathA
songs.summary: Drinking the nectar of the Ramayana story is equal to ruling a kingdom; it grants every goal of life.

lines.text: rAma kathA sudhArasa pAnam oka rAjyamu cEsunE
lines.meaning: Drinking the nectar of Rama's story is like ruling a kingdom —

lines.text: bhAmAmaNi jAnaki saumitri bharatAdulatO bhUmi velayu sItA
lines.meaning: (the story of) Sita, jewel among women, with Saumitri, Bharata and the rest, shining on the earth.

lines.text: dharmAddakhila phaladamE manasA dhairyAnanda saukhya nikEtanamE
lines.meaning: It grants all the fruits beginning with dharma, O mind; it is the home of courage, bliss and happiness;

lines.text: karma bandha jvalanAbdhi nAvamE kaliharamE tyAgarAja vinutuDagu
lines.meaning: it is the boat across the burning ocean of karma's bonds; it destroys the evils of Kali — (the story of) the Lord praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: alakalalla
songs.summary: How Vishvamitra must have rejoiced to see young Rama's curls dance as he defeated Maricha and broke Shiva's bow.

lines.text: alakalalla lADaga gani yA rANmuni yeTu pongenO
lines.meaning: Seeing his curls swaying, how that great sage must have rejoiced!

lines.text: celuchu mIraganu mArIcuni mada manacuvEla
lines.meaning: When, surpassing in brilliance, he crushed Maricha's pride,

lines.text: muni kanu saiga delisi shivadhanuvunu viricE
lines.meaning: when, understanding the sage's glance, he broke Shiva's bow —

lines.text: samayamuna tyAgarAja vinutuni mOmuna ranjillu
lines.meaning: at that moment, (seeing the curls) shining on the face of the one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: nAdasudhA rasambilanu
songs.summary: Rama is the nectar of nada in human form; his bow, its strings and arrows are the elements of music.

lines.text: nAdasudhA rasambilanu narAkrti yAyE manasA
lines.meaning: The nectar of nada has taken a human form here on earth, O mind —

lines.text: vEda purAnAgama shAstrAdula-kAdhAramaina
lines.meaning: (nada) that is the foundation of the Vedas, Puranas, Agamas and Shastras.

lines.text: svara mUlArunnokaTi ghaNTalu vara rAgamu kOdaNDamu dura naya
lines.meaning: The seven svaras are its bells; the noble raga is the Kodanda bow; the dura, naya and

lines.text: dEshyamu triguNamu nirata gati sharamurA sarasa sangati sandarbhamu
lines.meaning: deshya styles are its three strings; the steady gait is its arrow; the graceful sangatis and phrases

lines.text: gala giramUlurA dhara bhajana bhAgyamurA tyAgarAju sEvincu
lines.meaning: are its words — the fortune of worship on earth, which Tyagaraja serves.

songs.title: cAla kallalADu
songs.summary: Tyagaraja teases Rama for his broken promises: what joy does he get from telling so many lies?

lines.text: cAla kallalADu konna saukhyamEmirA
lines.meaning: What happiness do you gain by telling so many lies?

lines.text: k lamu bOnu mATa nilucunu kalyANarAma nAtO
lines.meaning: Time passes, but words remain, Kalyana Rama — with me,
