lines.text: tallitaNDri nE nuNDa takkina bhayamEla yani palum ru nI vennO bAsalu jEsi
lines.meaning: 'When I am your mother and father, why fear?' — how many promises you made;

lines.text: ilalO sarivAralalO ententO brOcucuNDi peddalat balki meppinci tyAgarAjunitO
lines.meaning: and among your equals on earth you boasted of protecting so many, winning the elders' praise — (yet) with Tyagaraja (you lie).

songs.title: upacAramulanu
songs.summary: Tyagaraja offers Rama the royal services — a jewelled umbrella, chamara whisks and a fragrant fan — fit only for him.

lines.text: upacAramulanu cEkonavayya uragarAja shayana
lines.meaning: Accept these offerings of service, O you who recline on the king of serpents.

lines.text: capala kOTi nibhAmbara dhara shrI jAnakIpati daya cEsi nADu
lines.meaning: Clad in garments like ten million flashes of lightning, Lord of Janaki, have mercy —

lines.text: kapaTa nATaka sUtra dhArivai kAmita phalamu losagE rAma
lines.meaning: you who direct the drama of illusion and grant the fruits we desire, Rama;

lines.text: aparimita navaratnamulu poDigina aparanji gODugu nIkE tagunayya
lines.meaning: a golden umbrella set with countless gems — it befits only you.

lines.text: merupu tigala rItini merasE karaku bangAru kAda lamarina
lines.meaning: Gleaming like lightning, with a golden handle,

lines.text: sharadindu dhyuti samAnamau cAmara yugamulu nIkE tagunayya
lines.meaning: a pair of chamaras bright as the autumn moon — they befit only you.

lines.text: jAjulu sampangulu mruvamu vira kuruvEru vAsanalanu virAja
lines.meaning: Fragrant with jasmine, champaka, marjoram and kuruveru,

lines.text: mAnamagu vyajanamu tyAgarAja vinuta nIkE tagunayya
lines.meaning: a splendid fan — O one praised by Tyagaraja, it befits only you.

songs.title: raksha bettarE
songs.summary: An arati song: perform the protective rite for the Lord, Lakshmi's beloved, who loves music.

lines.text: rakSa bettarE doraku
lines.meaning: Perform the protective rite (arati) for the Lord,

lines.text: vakshastalamu pai velayu lakshmi ramanuniki
lines.meaning: for the beloved of Lakshmi, who shines on his chest;

lines.text: sItA karamuni baTTi celigina doraku vAtAtmajuniki
lines.meaning: for the Lord who shone holding Sita's hand; for the Lord who is won over

lines.text: ceyi vashamaina doraku puru-hUtAdula rakSimpa bAhu juDaina
lines.meaning: by Hanuman, son of the Wind; for the Lord whose arms protect Indra and the others;

lines.text: doraku sangItapriya tyAgarAja gEyuDaina dorakEshvarya
lines.meaning: for the Lord who loves music, sung by Tyagaraja, the lord of all glory.

songs.title: tanayuni brOva
songs.summary: Does the mother come to the child, or the child go to the mother? Tyagaraja asks Rama to come to him.

lines.text: tanayuni brOva janani vaccunO talli vadda bAluDu bOnO
lines.meaning: Does the mother come to protect her child, or does the child go to the mother?

lines.text: ina kulOttama I rahasyamunu erigimpumu mOmunu ganupimpumu
lines.meaning: Best of the Solar race, explain this secret to me, and show me your face.

lines.text: vatsamu veNTa dhEnuvu canunO vAridamunu gani pairulu cununO
lines.meaning: Does the cow follow the calf? Does the cloud go looking for the crops?

lines.text: matsya kaNTiki viTuDu vEDalunO mahini tyAgarAja vinuta rammu delpumu
lines.meaning: Does the lover go to the fish-eyed beloved? O one praised by Tyagaraja, come and tell me.

songs.title: lAvaNya rAma
songs.summary: Tyagaraja longs to see beautiful Rama to his eyes' content.

lines.text: lAvaNya rAma kannulAra jUDavE ati
lines.meaning: O beautiful Rama, let me see you to my eyes' content —

lines.text: shrI vanita citta kumuda sItakara shatAnanyaja
lines.meaning: moon to the lily of Lakshmi's heart, incomparable one.

lines.text: nI manasu nI sogasu nI dinusu vErE tAmasa mATa deivamEla tyAgarAjanuta divya
lines.meaning: Your mind, your beauty, your splendour are unique — why harsh words, O God praised by Tyagaraja, divine one?

songs.title: heccarikagA
songs.summary: A processional song: 'Come with care, Rama!' — describing Rama's jewels and the gods and devotees who receive him.

lines.text: heccarikagA rArA hE rAmacandra heccarikagA rArA hE suguNasAndra
lines.meaning: Come with care, O Ramachandra; come with care, O ocean of virtues,

lines.text: pacca viltuni ganna pAlita surEndra
lines.meaning: father of Manmatha, protector of Indra.

lines.text: kanakamayamau makuTa kAnti merayaganu ghanamaina kuNDala yugambulu
lines.meaning: As the gleam of your golden crown shines and your great earrings

lines.text: gadalaganu ghanamaina nUpura yugambu ghallalanu sanakAdulella kani santasillagunu
lines.meaning: sway, and your fine anklets jingle, Sanaka and the others rejoice to see you;

lines.text: ANimutyAla sarulalla lADaganu vAni patIndru liru varusa pogaDaganu mANikya
lines.meaning: as strings of pearls sway, as attendants in two rows sing your praise, on the ruby

lines.text: sOpAnamandu mellaganu vIAa palkula vinucu vEDka cellaganu
lines.meaning: steps, slowly, listening to the veena's speech, enjoying the festivity —

lines.text: ninnu jUDavaccu bhagini karambu ciluka manasu ranjilla nI mahimalanu baluka
lines.meaning: as the parrot in the hand of your sister, come to see you, sings your glories to delight the mind,

lines.text: minuvAsulella virulanu cAla jiluka ghana tyAgarAju kanukona muddu guluka
lines.meaning: as the gods shower flowers — come, brimming with charm, for great Tyagaraja to behold.

songs.title: dorakunA iTuvanTi sEva
songs.summary: Can such service be had? A rich picture of Vishnu on the swinging serpent bed, worshipped by gods and sages, and rocked by Tyagaraja.

lines.text: dorakunA iTuvanTi sEva
lines.meaning: Can such service be had?

lines.text: dorukunA alpa tapa monarincina bhUsura varulakunaina surulakaina
lines.meaning: Can even great Brahmins with little penance, or even the gods, obtain it?

lines.text: tumburu nAradulu suguna kIrtanambula nAlApamu sEyagA ambarIsa mukhyulu
lines.meaning: As Tumburu and Narada sing kirtanas of his virtues with alapana, as Ambarisha and the foremost

lines.text: nAmamu sEyaga jAjulapai callaga bimbAdharulagu suravara yali vENulu nATyamu
lines.meaning: chant his name and shower jasmine, as celestial women with bimba-red lips dance to flutes,

lines.text: lADagA ambuja bhava pAkAru lirugadaLa nanvaya birudAvalini pogaDagA ambara
lines.meaning: as Brahma, Indra and others on both sides praise his lineage and titles, as celestial

lines.text: vAsa satulu kara kankaNambulu ghallani visaraga mani hArambulu gadalaga
lines.meaning: women wave fans, their bangles jingling, their jewelled necklaces swaying,

lines.text: nUcE phani talpambuna nelakonna harini ganuga
lines.meaning: to see Hari reclining on the swinging serpent bed —

lines.text: marakata maNi sannibha dEhambuna merugu kanaka cElamu shObhilla caraNa
lines.meaning: with golden robes shining on his emerald-hued body, the radiance

lines.text: yuga nakhAvali kAntulu canduru pillalanu gEra vara nUpuramu vEluga karayugamuna
lines.meaning: of the nails of his feet outshining young moons, his anklets gleaming, on his hands

lines.text: vajrapu bhUSaNamulu meraya uramuna muktAhAramulu mariyu nucitamaina makara
lines.meaning: diamond ornaments sparkling, on his chest pearl necklaces, and fine makara-shaped

lines.text: kuNDalambulu ciru navvulu gala vadanambuna munguru laddampu kapOlamu muddu
lines.meaning: earrings; his face with a gentle smile; curls; mirror-bright cheeks; lovely

lines.text: guriyu divya phAlambuna tilakamu merayu bhuvi lAvaNya nidhini kana
lines.meaning: the tilaka shining on his divine forehead — to behold the treasure of beauty on earth;

lines.text: tAmasa guNa rahita munulaku pogaDa taramu gAkane bhramasi nilvaga shrImat
lines.meaning: as sages free of dark qualities stand bewildered, unable to praise him enough,

lines.text: kanakapu toTlapaini celuvonda koluvuNDaga kAmita phala dAyakiyau sIta kAntuni
lines.meaning: as he holds court gracefully on the golden cradle — beholding Sita's lord, the granter of wishes,

lines.text: kani upponga rAmabhrahma tanayuDau tyAgarAju tA bADucu nUcaga rAmuni
lines.meaning: overflowing with joy, Tyagaraja, son of Ramabrahmam, sings and rocks Rama,

lines.text: jagaduddhAruni suraripu bhImuni triguNAtItuni pUrNa kAmuni cinmaya rUpuni
lines.meaning: uplifter of the world, terror of the gods' enemies, beyond the three gunas, all-fulfilled, pure consciousness,

lines.text: sadguNa dhAmuni kanulAra madini kanugona
lines.meaning: abode of good qualities — to behold him to the eyes' content and in the heart.

songs.title: nA jIvadhAra
songs.summary: Rama is the support of Tyagaraja's life, the light of his eyes and the fruit of all his worship.

lines.text: nA jIvAdhAra nA nOmu phalamA
lines.meaning: Support of my life, fruit of my vows,

lines.text: rAjIva lOcana rAjarAja shirOmaNi
lines.meaning: lotus-eyed one, crown jewel of the kings of kings,

lines.text: nA cUpa prakAshamA nA nAsika parimaLamA
lines.meaning: light of my sight, fragrance to my nose,

lines.text: nA japavarNa rUpamA nADu pUjAsumamA tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: the form of the syllables of my japa, the flower of my daily worship, praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: kanugoNTini
songs.summary: Tyagaraja rejoices: today he has seen Sri Rama, served by his brothers, Hanuman and Sugriva.

lines.text: kanugoNTini shrI rAmuni nEDu (kanulAra nA kAmitambu dhIra)
lines.meaning: I have seen Sri Rama today — my wish fulfilled to my eyes' content.

lines.text: ina kulamandu impu gAnu buTTina ilalOna sItA nAyakuni nEDu
lines.meaning: Sita's lord, born gracefully in the Solar race on this earth — today,

lines.text: bharata lakSmaNa shatrughnUlu koluva pavamAna sutuDu pAdamula baTTu
lines.meaning: as Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna serve him, as the Wind's son holds his feet,

lines.text: dhIrulaina sugrIva pramukhulu vinuta sEya tyAgarAjanutuni nEDu
lines.meaning: as Sugriva and the brave chiefs praise him — the one praised by Tyagaraja, today.

songs.title: intakannAnandam
songs.summary: What bliss could be greater than losing oneself in singing of Rama until one becomes one with him?

lines.text: intakannAnandam Emi O rAma rAma
lines.meaning: What bliss is there greater than this, O Rama, Rama —

lines.text: santa janula kella sammatiyuNTE gAni
lines.meaning: the bliss that all true saints agree upon?

lines.text: ADucu nAdamuna pADucu EDutara vEDucu manasuna gUDiyuNDEdi cAlu
lines.meaning: Dancing, singing in nada, weeping and pleading, staying united with you in the mind — that is enough.

lines.text: shrI hari kIrtanacE dEhAdi indriya samUhamulu maraci sOhamainad E cAlu
lines.meaning: Through singing Sri Hari's praise, forgetting body and senses, becoming 'I am He' — that is enough.

lines.text: nI japamulu vELa nI jagamulu nIvai rAjillunayya tyAgarAjanuta carita
lines.meaning: When I chant you, the worlds themselves shine as you, O one of glorious story, praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: tOli janmamuna
songs.summary: Tyagaraja reflects that his suffering is the fruit of past-life misdeeds, and wonders whether the Name can still prevail.

lines.text: toli janmamuna jEyu duDuku delisenu rAma
lines.meaning: I have come to know the mischief I did in a past birth, Rama.

lines.text: phalamEmO (nI mahima) aracEti puNTi kaddamu valena
lines.meaning: Its result is plain — does a sore on one's palm need a mirror to be seen?

lines.text: rAgi pairula centa ramyamau vari molaka rAjillu nErcu naTarA
lines.meaning: Can a fine paddy shoot flourish among millet plants?

lines.text: nAgashayanA tyAgarAja pApamutOnu nAma puNyamu celagunA nEnu
lines.meaning: O one reclining on the serpent, can the merit of the Name shine through Tyagaraja's sins?

songs.title: Ela nI dayarAdu (bAla kanakamaya)
songs.summary: Why won't Rama show mercy? This is no time for indifference — followed by a cascade of epithets in praise of Rama.

lines.text: Ela nI dayarAdu parAku jEsE vELa samayamu gAdu
lines.meaning: Why won't your mercy come? This is not the time for indifference.

lines.text: bAla kanakamaya cEla sujana paripAla shrI ramAlOla vidhrta sharajAlaA
lines.meaning: Clad in pure gold, protector of the good, beloved of Lakshmi, bearer of arrows,

lines.text: shubada karunAlavAla ghananIla navya vana mAlikA bharaNa (Ela)
lines.meaning: giver of good, abode of compassion, dark as a rain cloud, wearing a fresh forest garland — (why?)

lines.text: rArA dEvAdi dEva! rArA mahAnubhAva rArA rAjIvanEtra raghuvara putrA
lines.meaning: Come, God of gods! Come, great one! Come, lotus-eyed son of the Raghus!

lines.text: sAratara sudhA pUra hrdaya parivAra jaladhi gambhIra danuja samhAra
lines.meaning: Heart full of the finest nectar, deep as the ocean, surrounded by kin, slayer of demons,

lines.text: madana sukumAra budha janavihAra sakala shrutisAra nAdupai
lines.meaning: tender as Manmatha, who dwells among the wise, essence of all the Vedas — (show mercy) on me.

lines.text: rAjAdhirAja muni pUjitapAda ravirAjalOcana sharaNya ati lAvaNya
lines.meaning: King of kings, whose feet the sages worship, with eyes like the sun, refuge of all, most beautiful,

lines.text: rAjadharanuta virAjaturaga sura rAja vandita pAda-aja janaka dina-
lines.meaning: praised by Shiva, rider of Garuda, whose feet Indra worships, father of Brahma,

lines.text: rAjakOTi samatEja danuja gajarAja nicaya mrgarAja jalajamukha
lines.meaning: radiant as ten million suns, a lion to the herds of demon elephants, lotus-faced,

lines.text: yAgarakSaNa parama bhAgavatArcita yOgIndra su-hrdbhAvita Adyanta
lines.meaning: protector of the sacrifice, worshipped by great devotees, held in the hearts of great yogis, without beginning

lines.text: rahita nAgashayana vara nAgavarada punnAga sumadhara sadAgha-
lines.meaning: or end, reclining on the serpent, giver of boons to the elephant king, wearing punnaga flowers, ever

lines.text: mOcana sadA gatija dhrta padAgamAnta cara rAgarahita shrI tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: the remover of sin, whose feet the Wind's son holds, abiding at the end of the Vedas, free of attachment, praised by Sri Tyagaraja.

songs.title: ilalO praNatArti
songs.summary: Addressed to Shiva of Tiruvaiyaru: who named you 'remover of the sorrows of those who bow', if you show me no mercy?

lines.text: ilalO pranatArti haruDanucu pErevaradirE shankaruDani nIk-
lines.meaning: Who on earth gave you the name 'remover of the sorrows of those who bow', Shankara?

lines.text: dalaci karagi cirakAlamu madamula daNDa miDina nAyeDa daya lEdAyE
lines.meaning: I have long thought of you, melted, and prostrated before you — have you no mercy on me?

lines.text: karacaraNa yugamu nosalu bhujamulu dharani sOka mrokkaga lEdA
lines.meaning: Did I not bow down with hands, feet, forehead and arms touching the ground?

lines.text: sharaNanucunu moraliDa lEdA pancanadIsha tyAgarAjanuta nIk-
lines.meaning: Did I not cry out 'refuge'? O Lord of Panchanada, praised by Tyagaraja — (who named you so)?

songs.title: baDalika dIra
songs.summary: After recounting Rama's labours — the forest, the deer, Ravana, Lanka — Tyagaraja invites him to rest.

lines.text: baDalika dIra pavvaLincavE
lines.meaning: Lie down and rest, so your weariness may pass.

lines.text: saDalani duritamunu tEgagOsi-sArvabhauma sAkEtarAma
lines.meaning: You have cut away unrelenting sins, O emperor, Rama of Saketa.

lines.text: pankajAsanuni paritApamu kani pankajAptakula pativai velasi pankajAkSito vanamuna kEgi
lines.meaning: Seeing Brahma's distress, you shone forth as lord of the Solar race, went to the forest with lotus-eyed Sita,

lines.text: jinkanu vadhiyinci manku rAvaNuni madamu nanaci nishshankuDagu vibhISaNuniki
lines.meaning: slew the deer, crushed wicked Ravana's pride, and to fearless Vibhishana

lines.text: bangAru lanka nosagi surula brOcina niSkaLanka! tyAgarAjanuta rAma
lines.meaning: gave golden Lanka and protected the gods — O spotless one, Rama praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: nannu viDaci
songs.summary: Don't leave me, Rama: finding you is like shade in scorching heat, a pearl from the deep sea, or buried treasure.

lines.text: nannu viDaci kadalakuraa-
lines.meaning: Don't leave me and go away —

lines.text: raamayyavadalakuraa
lines.meaning: Ramayya, don't leave me.

lines.text: ninnu baasi yara
lines.meaning: Apart from you

lines.text: nimishamOrvanuraa
lines.meaning: I cannot bear even a moment.

lines.text: taramu gaanu yeNDavELa kalpa-
lines.meaning: It is like finding, in unbearable summer heat,

lines.text: taruneeDa dorikinaTlaaya eevELa
lines.meaning: the shade of the wish-fulfilling tree — at this moment;

lines.text: abdhilO munigi SvAsamu baTTi
lines.meaning: like diving into the sea, holding one's breath,

lines.text: ANi mutyamu gannaTlAya SRI ramaNa!
lines.meaning: and finding a flawless pearl, O Lord of Lakshmi;

lines.text: vasudhanu ghananamu cEsi dhana-
lines.meaning: like digging deep into the earth

lines.text: bhANDa mabbina rIti kanukoNTi dAsi
lines.meaning: and finding a pot of treasure — so I found you, (I your) servant;

lines.text: vaDalu tagiliyunna vELa goppa-
lines.meaning: like, when heatstroke strikes, great

lines.text: vaDagaNDlu gurisinatlAya I vELa
lines.meaning: cool hailstones pouring down — at this moment.

lines.text: bAgugA nannElukOrA vara-
lines.meaning: Rule over me well, O

lines.text: tyAgarAjanuta! I tanuvu nIdErA (sompu)
lines.meaning: one praised by Tyagaraja — this body is yours.

songs.title: rAga ratna mAlikace
songs.summary: Tyagaraja's garland of a hundred ragas (songs), in which Hari delights — a jewel to cross the ocean of life.

lines.text: rAga ratna mAlikacE ranjillunaTa hari shata
lines.meaning: Hari delights in the jewelled garland of ragas, (these hundred songs).

lines.text: bAga sEvinci sakala bhAgyamandudamu rArE
lines.meaning: Come, let us serve him well and attain all good fortune.

lines.text: naigama SaDAstra purANAgamamArtha sahitamata yOgivarulu Anandamu nondEdu sanmArga maTa
lines.meaning: It is the true path, carrying the meaning of the Vedas, six Shastras, Puranas and Agamas, in which great yogis find bliss;

lines.text: bhAgavatOttamulu gUDi pADE kIrtanamulaTa tyAgarAju kaDatEra tArakamaNi cEsina shata
lines.meaning: they are kirtanas sung by great devotees together — the hundred songs Tyagaraja made as a jewel to cross over.

songs.title: dwaitamu sukhamA
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks the all-witnessing Consciousness: is duality bliss, or non-duality?

lines.text: dvaitamu sukhamA advaitamu sukhamA
lines.meaning: Is duality bliss, or is non-duality bliss?

lines.text: caitanyamA vinu sarvasAkSi vistAramu-gAnu delupumu nAtO
lines.meaning: O Consciousness, witness of all, listen, and tell me fully.

lines.text: gagana pavana tapana bhuvanAdyavanilO nagadha rAja shivEndrAdi surulalO
lines.meaning: In the sky, wind, sun, earth and the rest, in Shiva, Indra and the gods, and the lord of mountains,

lines.text: bhagavadbhakta varAgrEsharulalO bAga ramincE tyAgarAjArcita
lines.meaning: in the foremost devotees of the Lord — you who delight in them all, worshipped by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: jO jO rAmA
songs.summary: A lullaby for Rama.

lines.text: jO jO rAma Ananda ghana
lines.meaning: Lullaby, Rama, cloud of bliss.

lines.text: jO jO dasharatha bAla rAma jO jO bhUja lOla rAma
lines.meaning: Lullaby, Rama, child of Dasharatha; lullaby, Rama, beloved of the Earth's daughter.

lines.text: jO jO raghukula tilaka rAma jO jO kuTila tarAlaka rAma
lines.meaning: Lullaby, Rama, jewel of the Raghu race; lullaby, Rama of curly locks.

lines.text: jO jO nirguNa rUpa rAma jO jO suguna kalpa rAma
lines.meaning: Lullaby, Rama, beyond attributes; lullaby, Rama, wish-tree of virtues.

lines.text: jO jO ravi shashi nayana rAma jO jO phaNivara shayana rAma
lines.meaning: Lullaby, Rama, with the sun and moon for eyes; lullaby, Rama reclining on the serpent king.

lines.text: jO jO mrdudhara bhASa rAma jO jO manjuLa vESa rAma
lines.meaning: Lullaby, Rama of gentle speech; lullaby, Rama of lovely attire.

lines.text: jO jO tyAgarAjArcita rAma jO jO bhakta samAja rAma
lines.meaning: Lullaby, Rama worshipped by Tyagaraja; lullaby, Rama, beloved of the devotees.

songs.title: shAntamu lEka
songs.summary: Without peace of mind there is no happiness — not even for those with family, wealth, learning or ritual merit.

lines.text: shAntamu lEka saukhyamu lEdu sArasadaLa nayana
lines.meaning: Without peace of mind there is no happiness, O lotus-eyed one,

lines.text: dAntunikaina vEdAntunikaina
lines.meaning: even for the self-controlled, even for a master of Vedanta.

lines.text: dAra sutulu dhana dhAnyamu luNDina sAreju japa tapa sampada galgina
lines.meaning: Though one has wife, children, wealth and grain, though one has the riches of japa and penance,

lines.text: Agaama shAtramulanniyu jaDivina bAguga sakala hrd-bhAvamu delisina
lines.meaning: though one has studied all the Agamas and Shastras, though one knows well the feelings of every heart,

lines.text: yAgAdi karmamulanniyu jEsina bhAgavatulanucu bAguga bEraina
lines.meaning: though one has performed every ritual such as sacrifices, though one is well known as a devotee —

lines.text: rAjAdhi rAja shrI rAghava tyAgarAja vinuta sAdhu rakSaka tanakupa
lines.meaning: O king of kings, Sri Raghava, praised by Tyagaraja, protector of the good — (there is no happiness without peace).

songs.title: mAkElarA vicAramu
songs.summary: Why should we worry? Rama holds the strings of the world's puppet-play and makes all dance in step.

lines.text: mAkElarA vicAramu maruganna shrI rAmacandrA
lines.meaning: Why should we worry, O Sri Ramachandra, our refuge?

lines.text: sAkEta rAjakumArA sadbhakta mandAra shrIkarA
lines.meaning: Prince of Saketa, wish-tree to true devotees, bestower of fortune!

lines.text: jata gUrci nATaka sUtramunu jagamella meccaga karamuna niDi
lines.meaning: Gathering all together, holding the strings of the puppet-play in your hand as the world admires,

lines.text: gati tappaka yAdincEdavu summi nata tyAgarAja giriSha vinuta
lines.meaning: you make them dance without missing a step — praised by Tyagaraja who bows to you, and by Shiva.

songs.title: evarani
songs.summary: Whom did the great ones take you to be — Shiva, Vishnu, Brahma or the Supreme? 'Rama' holds the life of both the Shiva and Narayana mantras.

lines.text: evarani nirNayincirirA ninnETlArAdhincirirA naravarul-
lines.meaning: Whom did the great men decide you to be? How did they worship you?

lines.text: shivuDanO mAdhavauDanO kamala bhavuDanO para bramhanO nIn-
lines.meaning: As Shiva, as Madhava, as lotus-born Brahma, or as the Supreme Brahman?

lines.text: shiva mantramunaku mAjivamu mAdhava mantramunaku rAjivamu I
lines.meaning: 'Ma' is the life of the Shiva mantra; 'Ra' is the life of the Madhava mantra —

lines.text: vivaramu delisina ghanulaku mrokkEda vitaraNa guNa tyAgarAja vinuta nin-
lines.meaning: I bow to the great ones who know this secret, O generous one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: sukhi evarO
songs.summary: Who is truly happy? The one who lives by truth, serves all, sees no difference among gods, and sings Rama's name.

lines.text: sukhi evarO rAma nAma sukhi evarO
lines.meaning: Who is truly happy? Who is happy in Rama's name?

lines.text: sukhi evarO sumukhi evarO akhila sAramagu tAraka nAma
lines.meaning: Who is happy, who is blessed — through the saving name, the essence of all?

lines.text: satyamu tappaka sakala lOkulaku bhrtyuDai daiva bhEdamu lEka
lines.meaning: One who never swerves from truth, serves all beings, and sees no difference among gods,

lines.text: nityamaina susvarapu gAnamutO nirantaramu tyAgarAjanuta rAma
lines.meaning: and who always sings with eternal, tuneful music — O Rama praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: shrI nArada nAda
songs.summary: A hymn to the sage Narada, master of the veena and of nada.

lines.text: shrI nArada nAda sarasIruha bhrnga shubhAnga
lines.meaning: O Sri Narada, bee to the lotus of nada, of auspicious form,

lines.text: dIna mAna rakSaka jagadIsha bhEshankEsha
lines.meaning: protector of the honour of the lowly, (dear to) the Lord of the world,

lines.text: vEda janitavara vInA vAdana tatvagjna khEdakara tritApa rahita khEcara vinuta
lines.meaning: master of the truth of playing the noble veena born of the Vedas, free of the three afflictions, praised by the celestials,

lines.text: yAdava kulajApta sadA mOda hrdaya munivarya shrIda tyAgarAja vinuta shrIkara mAm pAlaya
lines.meaning: dear friend of the one born in the Yadava clan, ever joyful, best of sages, bestower of fortune, praised by Tyagaraja — protect me.

songs.title: paramAtmuDu velugu
songs.summary: Understand how the Supreme Self shines in everything — in gods and men, the elements, all creatures, the good and the bad.

lines.text: paramAtmuDu veluga muccaTa bAga delusukOrE
lines.meaning: Understand well the wonder of how the Supreme Self shines.

lines.text: hariyaTa haruDaTa surulaTa narulaTa akhilANDa kOTulaTa andarilO
lines.meaning: Whether Hari or Hara, gods or men, or countless universes — in all of them,

lines.text: gaganAnIla tEjO jAla bhUmayamagu mrga khaga naga taru kOTulalO
lines.meaning: in sky, wind, fire, water and earth, in countless beasts, birds, mountains and trees,

lines.text: suguNamulO viguNamulO satatamu sAdhu tyAgarAjAdi AshritulalO
lines.meaning: in the virtuous and the wicked, and always in Tyagaraja and all who seek refuge.

songs.title: appa rAma bhakti
songs.summary: How great is devotion to Rama! Without it, would Sita, Lakshmana, Bharata, Shabari or Hanuman have done what they did?

lines.text: appa! rAmabhakti yentO gopparA; mA
lines.meaning: Ah! How great is devotion to Rama!

lines.text: trippaTalanu dIrci kaNTi reppavalEnu gAcu mA
lines.meaning: It ends our wanderings and guards us as the eyelid guards the eye.

lines.text: lakSmI dEvI valacunA? lakSmanuNDu golucunA?
lines.meaning: (Without it) would Lakshmi love him? Would Lakshmana serve him?

lines.text: sUkSmabuddhi gala bharatuDu jUcijUci solasunA? mA
lines.meaning: Would subtle-minded Bharata gaze and gaze at him and swoon?

lines.text: shabari yengili niccunA? candradharuDu meccunA?
lines.meaning: Would Shabari offer him fruit she had tasted? Would Shiva, who wears the moon, praise him?

lines.text: abalasvayamprabhaku daivamacala padavi niccunA? mA
lines.meaning: Would God grant the ascetic Svayamprabha the immovable state?

lines.text: kapi vAridhi dATunA kaliki rOta gaTunA
lines.meaning: Would a monkey cross the ocean? Would (Krishna) let a cowherd girl tie him to a mortar?

lines.text: aparAdhi tyAgarAjukAnandamu heccunA? mA
lines.meaning: Would the sinner Tyagaraja's bliss keep growing?

songs.title: shiva shiva shiva enarAdA
songs.summary: Tyagaraja urges the listener to chant Shiva's name and live a disciplined life of worship and good company.

lines.text: shiva shiva shiva enarAdA (Ori)
lines.meaning: Can't you say 'Shiva, Shiva, Shiva'?

lines.text: bhavabhaya bAdhala naNacukO rAdA
lines.meaning: Can't you crush the troubles and fears of worldly life?

lines.text: kAmAdula dega kOsi parabhAmala parula dhanamula rOsi
lines.meaning: Cutting off desire and the rest, shunning others' wives and others' wealth,

lines.text: pAmaratvamu eDabAsi ati nEmamutO bilvArcana jEsi
lines.meaning: leaving behind base ways, worshipping with bilva leaves with great discipline,

lines.text: sajjana gaNmaula gAnci Ori muj-jagadiShvarulani mati nenci
lines.meaning: seeking the company of good people, regarding them as lords of the three worlds,

lines.text: lajjAdula dolaginca tana hrjjalamunanu tA pUjinci
lines.meaning: casting off shame and the like, worshipping Him in the lotus of your own heart,

lines.text: Agamamula nutiyinci bahu bAgulEni bhAsalu cAlinci
lines.meaning: praising the Agamas, giving up idle talk,

lines.text: bhAgvatulalO pOSinci Ori tyAgarAja sannutuDani enci
lines.meaning: thriving among devotees, holding Him praised by Tyagaraja in your thoughts — (say Shiva).

songs.title: sundaratara dEham
songs.summary: A Sanskrit hymn saluting Rama of most beautiful form, with a long garland of his qualities.

lines.text: sundaratara dEham vandEham rAmam
lines.meaning: I salute Rama, of most beautiful form,

lines.text: kunda radanamApta kumuda shashankam kandarpa shata kOTi kAntimati niSkaLankam
lines.meaning: with teeth like jasmine buds, moon to the lilies of his dear ones, flawless, radiant as countless Manmathas,

lines.text: patita jana pAvanam paripAlita bhuvanam shruti nikara sadanam shubhakara vadanam
lines.meaning: purifier of the fallen, protector of the worlds, abode of all the Vedas, of auspicious face,

lines.text: yativara jIvanam ibharAja pAlanam ditija mada damanam dIna janAvanam
lines.meaning: the life of great ascetics, protector of the elephant king, crusher of the demons' pride, saviour of the humble,

lines.text: nava durva daLa nIlam nandita amara jAlam avanata sura pAlam adbhuta lIlam bhavabhaya
lines.meaning: dark as a fresh blade of durva grass, delighting the hosts of gods, protector of the gods who bow, of wondrous play,

lines.text: haraNa kAlam bhakta jana vatsalam shivam advaitam amalam shrImad kanakAbha cElam
lines.meaning: death to the fear of worldly life, loving to his devotees, auspicious, non-dual, pure, in radiant golden garments,

lines.text: Agama sancAram akhila lOkAdhAram vAgAdhipa kumAram vara vIra vIra (vIrAdhivIram)
lines.meaning: moving through the Agamas, support of all worlds, dear to Brahma, hero of heroes,

lines.text: rAgAdi samhAram rAghavam udAram tyAgarAja hrd-sancAram kAruNya pArAvAram
lines.meaning: destroyer of attachment and the like, Raghava, generous, moving in Tyagaraja's heart, ocean of compassion.

songs.title: shObAnE
songs.summary: A song of auspiciousness (shobhanam) asking Rama for protection.

lines.text: shObAnE
lines.meaning: Auspiciousness!

lines.text: vadana dyuti jita sOma vasudha mAnasa kAma mada mAnava gaNa bhIma mAm pAhi shrI rAma
lines.meaning: Your radiant face outshining the moon, desired by the earth, terror to the proud — protect me, Sri Rama.

lines.text: janaka suta hrd-ramaNa jamadagnija mada haraNa praNatAkhAnala vruNa pAhi mAm muni sharaNa
lines.meaning: Delight of Janaka's daughter, who humbled Parashurama's pride, fire to the sins of those who bow, refuge of sages — protect me.

lines.text: vikalita mOha pAsha vidhu kOTi samkAsha bhagavAn sakalAdhIsha pAhi pApa vinAsha
lines.meaning: Who cut the noose of delusion, radiant as ten million moons, Lord and master of all — protect me, destroyer of sin.

lines.text: vara tyAgarAjanuta vArija sambhava tAta parama kalyANa yuta pAhi mAm shubha carita
lines.meaning: Praised by noble Tyagaraja, father of the lotus-born, supremely auspicious — protect me, O one of holy deeds.

songs.title: tEra tIyaga rAdA
songs.summary: Sung at Tirupati when the curtain was drawn before the deity: Tyagaraja asks Venkateshvara to remove the curtain of jealousy within him.

lines.text: tera tIyaga rAdA lOni tirupati venkaTaramaNa matsaramunu
lines.meaning: Won't you remove the curtain within me, Tirupati Venkataramana — the curtain of jealousy?

lines.text: parama puruSa dharmAdi mOkSamula pAra dOlu cunnadi nAlOni
lines.meaning: O Supreme Person, it is driving away dharma and the other aims, even liberation, from within me.

lines.text: matsyamu Akali goni gAlamucE magnamaina rIti nunnadi
lines.meaning: It is like a hungry fish caught on the hook;

lines.text: accamaina dIpa sannidhi marugaDDabaDi ceraci naTTunnadi
lines.meaning: like a screen fallen before a clear lamp, hiding its light;

lines.text: iravondaga bhujiyuncu samayamuna Iga dagulu rIti nunnadi
lines.meaning: like a fly falling (into the food) while one eats contentedly;

lines.text: hari dhyAnamu sEyuvELa cittamu antyaju vADaku bOyi naTTunnadi
lines.meaning: when I meditate on Hari, my mind wanders off to an outcast's street;

lines.text: vAguramani teliyaka mrga gaNamulu vacci tagulu rIti nunnadi
lines.meaning: it is like deer coming and getting caught, not knowing it is a net.

lines.text: vEgamE nI matamu anusarincina tyAgarAjanuta mada matsaramanu
lines.meaning: Quickly — (remove) the curtain of pride and jealousy from Tyagaraja, who follows your path.

songs.title: graha balam
songs.summary: What power do the planets have? Rama's grace is the only power.

lines.text: graha balam Emi shrI rAmAnugraha balamE balamu
lines.meaning: What is the power of the planets? Sri Rama's grace alone is power.

lines.text: graha balam Emi tEjOmaya vigrahamunu dhyAnincu vAriki nava
lines.meaning: What power do the planets have over those who meditate on His radiant form?

lines.text: graha pIDala panca pApamulanAgrahamulu gala kAmAdi ripula
lines.meaning: The torments of the nine planets and the five great sins — for one who worships Hari, subduer

lines.text: nigrahamu sEyu harini bhajincu tyAgarAjuniki rasikA grEsarulaku
lines.meaning: of the fierce enemies like desire — (are nothing) for Tyagaraja and the foremost of connoisseurs.

songs.title: sujana jIvana
songs.summary: A prayer to Rama, life of the good, adorned with virtues.

lines.text: sujana jIvana rAma suguNa bhUSaNa
lines.meaning: Rama, life of the good, adorned with virtues,

lines.text: bhujaga bhUSaNArcita budha janAvanatmaja vandita shrta candana dasha turanga mAmava
lines.meaning: worshipped by Shiva who wears serpents, protector of the wise, revered by Hanuman, sandal-paste to those who seek refuge, son of Dasharatha — protect me.

lines.text: cAru nEtra shrI kaLAtra shrI ramya gAtra tAraka nAma sucaritra dasharatha putra
lines.meaning: Lovely-eyed, consort of Lakshmi, of beautiful form, of saving name and noble deeds, son of Dasharatha,

lines.text: tArakAdi pAnana dharma pAlaka tAraya raghuvara nirmala tyAgarAja sannuta
lines.meaning: slayer of Taraka and others, protector of dharma — save me, Raghuvara, pure one, praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: sItA kalyANa vaibhOgamE
songs.summary: A celebration of the grandeur of the wedding of Sita and Rama, with a garland of Rama's epithets.

lines.text: sItA kalyANa vaibhOgamE rAma kalyANa vaibhOgamE
lines.meaning: The grandeur of Sita's wedding! The grandeur of Rama's wedding!

lines.text: pavanaja stuti pAtra pAvana caritra ravi sOma pavanEtra ramaNIya gAtra
lines.meaning: Worthy of Hanuman's praise, of holy deeds, with sun, moon and wind as eyes, of lovely form,

lines.text: bhakta jana paripAla bharita sharajAla bhukti muktida lIla bhUdEva pAla
lines.meaning: protector of devotees, bearer of arrows, who in play grants worldly joy and liberation, protector of Brahmins,

lines.text: pAmarA surabhIma paripUrNa kAma shyAma jagadabhi rAma sAkEta dhAma
lines.meaning: terror to the wicked, wholly fulfilled, dark-hued, delight of the world, dweller in Saketa,

lines.text: sarva lOkAdhAra samaraika dhIra garva manasa dUra kanakAgha dhIra
lines.meaning: support of all worlds, peerless in battle, far from the proud, steadfast hero,

lines.text: nigamAgama vihAra nirupama sharIra nagadha vidhAra nata lOkAdhAra
lines.meaning: who roams the Vedas and Agamas, of matchless form, who held up the mountain, support of the worlds that bow,

lines.text: paramEshanuta gIta bhava jalAdhipOta tarani kula samjAta tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: whose songs Shiva praises, the ship across the ocean of worldly life, born in the Solar race, praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: eTula brOtuvO
songs.summary: Tyagaraja confesses his misspent life and wonders how Rama will ever protect him.

lines.text: eTula brOtuvO teliya EkAnta rAmayya
lines.meaning: I don't know how you will protect me, O Ramayya, my only refuge.

lines.text: kaTakaTa nA caritamu karNa kaTOramayya
lines.meaning: Alas, my story is harsh to the ear.

lines.text: vaTTi goDDu rIti bhakSinci tirigiti puTTu lObhulanu poTTakai pogaDiti
lines.meaning: I roamed and fed like a barren bull; I praised born misers to fill my belly;

lines.text: duSTulatO gUDi duSkrtyamulu salpi raTTu jEsina tyAgarAjuni dayatO
lines.meaning: keeping company with the wicked and doing evil deeds — how will you, in compassion, (save) Tyagaraja who made such a mess?

songs.title: nenaruncarA nApaini
songs.summary: Am I not your servant? Tyagaraja asks Rama to show him love and guide him to the shore.

lines.text: nenaruncarA nAApaini cAla nI dAsuDanu kAdA shrI rAma
lines.meaning: Show your love for me — am I not your servant, Sri Rama?

lines.text: sanakAdi yOgi brnda vandya pAda sAkEta vAsa sadbhakta pOSa
lines.meaning: Whose feet are worshipped by Sanaka and the hosts of yogis, dweller in Saketa, nurturer of true devotees,

lines.text: talli tanDri guru deivamu nIvani tarucugAnu ninnu nammiyunna nE
lines.meaning: I have long trusted you as mother, father, guru and God;

lines.text: dallaDillucuNDa dari cUpavEmi tyAgarAja paripAla suguNa shIla
lines.meaning: as I struggle, why don't you show me the shore? Protector of Tyagaraja, of virtuous nature.

songs.title: vara rAga
songs.summary: On those who boast of mastering raga and laya without knowing nada, the divine form of Om.

lines.text: vara rAga layagnulu dAmanucu vaDarE rayA (shrI rAma)
lines.meaning: They boast that they are masters of noble raga and laya, Sri Rama,

lines.text: svara jati murccana bhEdamula svAntamandu deliyaka uNDina
lines.meaning: without knowing in their hearts the distinctions of svara, jati and murchana.

lines.text: dEvOdbhavambagu nAdamula divyamau praNavAkara manE
lines.meaning: Nada born of God, the divine form of the Pranava —

lines.text: dAhamberugani mAnavula tyAgarAjanuta EcEru rAma
lines.meaning: how such men, who never thirst for it, deceive! O Rama praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: sarasa sAmadAna
songs.summary: Rama tried every means — conciliation, gifts, division and punishment — with Ravana; who is a God like him?

lines.text: sarasa sAma dAna bhEda daNDa catura sATi dEva mevarE brOvavE
lines.meaning: Who is a God like you, skilled in conciliation, gifts, division and punishment? Protect me.

lines.text: parama sAmbhava grEsa ruNDagucu balku rAvaNuDu teliyalEka pOtE
lines.meaning: When Ravana, who claimed to be foremost among Shiva's devotees, would not understand,

lines.text: hitavu mATalentO bAgA balkitivi satamu gAnayOdhya niTTu naNTivi
lines.meaning: how many words of good counsel you spoke; you even offered 'Ayodhya is yours';

lines.text: nata sahOdarunE rAju cEsi rAka hatamu jEsitivi tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: you made his brother, who bowed to you, king, and when Ravana did not yield you slew him — O one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: enta vEDukondu
songs.summary: How much must I plead? Why this obstinacy, Rama?

lines.text: enta vEDukondu O rAghava pantamElarA O rAghava
lines.meaning: How much should I plead, O Raghava? Why this obstinacy, O Raghava?

lines.text: cinta dIrcuTa kenta mODirA antarAtma nA centarAka nEn-
lines.meaning: How hard is it to end my worry? O inner Self, if you don't come near me —

lines.text: cittamandu ninnu jUcu saukhyamE uttamambanucu nuppongucunu
lines.meaning: rejoicing, thinking that the bliss of seeing you in my heart is the highest,

lines.text: sattamAtramA cAla nammitini sArvabhauma shrI tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: I trusted you so deeply — will you be a mere bystander? O emperor, praised by Sri Tyagaraja.

songs.title: vidulaku mrokkEda
songs.summary: Tyagaraja bows to the great masters of music, divine and human, who know the secret of nada.

lines.text: vidulaku mrokkEda sangIta kO
lines.meaning: I bow to the masters of music —

lines.text: mudamuna shankara krta sAma nigama vidulaku nAdAtmaka sapta svara
lines.meaning: the masters of the Sama Veda joyfully made by Shankara, (who know) the seven svaras that are nada itself:

lines.text: kamalA gaurI vAgIshvari vidhi garuDa dhvaja shiva nAradulu amarEsha bharata kashyapa
lines.meaning: Lakshmi, Gauri, Sarasvati, Brahma, Vishnu, Shiva, Narada, Indra, Bharata, Kashyapa,

lines.text: caNDIsha AnjanEya guha gajamukhulu su-mrkaNDuja kumbhaja tumburu vara sOmEshvara
lines.meaning: Chandikeshvara, Anjaneya, Guha, Ganesha, Markandeya, Agastya, Tumburu, the noble Someshvara,

lines.text: shArnga dEva nandi pramukhulaku tyAgarAja vandyulaku brahmAnanda sudhAmbudhi marma
lines.meaning: Sharngadeva, Nandi and the foremost ones, revered by Tyagaraja, who know the secret of the ocean of bliss.

songs.title: tuLasi dalamulacE
songs.summary: Tyagaraja will worship Rama's feet with tulasi leaves; he has offered every other flower already.

lines.text: tuLasI daLamulacE santOSamugA pUjintu
lines.meaning: With tulasi leaves I will joyfully worship

lines.text: palumAru cirakAlamu paramAtmunipAdamulanu
lines.meaning: again and again, for ever, the feet of the Supreme Self.

lines.text: sarasIruha punnAga campaka pATala kuruvaka karavIra mallikA sugandha rAja sumamula
lines.meaning: Lotus, punnaga, champaka, patala, kuruvaka, oleander, jasmine and the fragrant royal flowers —

lines.text: dhara nivi oka paryAyamu dharmAtmuni sAkEtapura vAsuni shrI rAmuni vara tyAgarAja nutuni
lines.meaning: these of the earth I have offered once; (now with tulasi I worship) the righteous Sri Rama of Saketa, praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: mEru samAna
songs.summary: Come, let me see you, Rama — steady as Mount Meru, graceful in gait, radiant in beauty.

lines.text: mEru samAna dhIra varada raghuvIra jUtAmu rArA mahA
lines.meaning: Steady as Mount Meru, giver of boons, hero of the Raghus — come, let me see you, great one:

lines.text: sArasAra oyyArapu naDalanu nIrada kAntini nIThivini mahA
lines.meaning: your graceful gait, essence of all essences, your rain-cloud radiance and splendour, great one;

lines.text: alakala muddunu tilakapu tIrunu taLuku jekkulacE danaru memmOmunu
lines.meaning: the charm of your curls, the line of your tilaka, your face lovely with gleaming cheeks,

lines.text: gaLamuna shObhillu kanaka bhUSaNamula daLita durmAnava tyAgarAjArcita
lines.meaning: the golden ornaments shining on your neck — crusher of the wicked, worshipped by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: manasu nilpa
songs.summary: Without the power to still the mind, outward rituals — worship, holy baths, sacrifices, penance — are useless.

lines.text: manasu nilpa shakti lEka pOtE madhura ghaNTa vIrula pUja Emi jEyunu
lines.meaning: If one has no power to still the mind, what will worship with sweet bells and flowers achieve?

lines.text: ghana durmaduDai tA munigitE kAvERi mandAkiNi eTubrOcunu
lines.meaning: If one drowns oneself in arrogance, how can the Kaveri or the Ganga save him?

lines.text: sOmidamma sogasugANDa kOritE sOmayAji svargArhuDaunO
lines.meaning: If the sacrificer longs after beautiful women, does he become worthy of heaven?

lines.text: kAma krOdhuDu tapambOnarcitE gAci rakSincunO tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: If one full of desire and anger does penance, will it protect him? — O one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: ninnE bhajana
songs.summary: Tyagaraja declares that he worships Rama alone and will beg no other.

lines.text: ninnE bhajana sEyu vADanu
lines.meaning: I am one who worships only you.

lines.text: pannagashAyi parulu vEDalEnu
lines.meaning: O you who recline on the serpent, I cannot beg others.

lines.text: snAnAdi japa tapa yOga dhyAna samAdhi sukhaprada
lines.meaning: Giver of the joy of bathing, japa, penance, yoga, meditation and samadhi,

lines.text: sItAnAtha sakala lOka pLalaka tyAgarAja sannuta
lines.meaning: Lord of Sita, protector of all worlds, praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: manavi nAlaginca
songs.summary: Tyagaraja tells his mind the secret of Rama's compassion: he took human form to save those lost in ritual and worldly life.

lines.text: manavi nAlaginca rAdaTE marmamella delpedanE manasA
lines.meaning: Won't you listen to my plea? I will tell you the whole secret, O mind.

lines.text: ghanuDaina rAmacandruni karuNAnta rangamu delisina nA
lines.meaning: I know the compassionate inner heart of great Ramachandra:

lines.text: karmakANDa mata krSTulai bhava gahana cArulai gAsi jendagA
lines.meaning: when people drawn to ritualism wandered in the dense forest of worldly life and suffered,

lines.text: gani mAnavA vAtAruDai kanipinci nADE nadaTa tyAgarAju
lines.meaning: seeing them, he took human form and appeared that very day — so says Tyagaraja.

songs.title: nIdu caraNamulE
songs.summary: Tyagaraja has wholly trusted Rama's feet as his refuge, and asks to be taken in, however it may be.

lines.text: nIdu caraNamulE gatiyani nerata nammina vADanurA rAma
lines.meaning: I am one who has wholly trusted that your feet are my refuge, Rama.

lines.text: vEda vEdAnta vidituDani velayu shrI sarvEshvara rAma
lines.meaning: Lord of all, known through the Vedas and Vedanta, Rama,

lines.text: pApa karmamu niNDurA indu bAdha padanE jAlarA
lines.meaning: my sinful deeds are many; I cannot bear the troubles here;

lines.text: E vaga gAnainanu nannElukO tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: in whatever way, take me as your own, O one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: brOva bhAramA
songs.summary: Is it a burden to protect me? You hold millions of universes and lifted mountains for others.

lines.text: brOva bhAramA raghurAmA bhuvanamella nIvai nannokani
lines.meaning: Is it a burden to protect me, Raghurama — you who have become the whole world — just me alone?

lines.text: shrI vAsudEva anDakOTula gukSiNi yuncakOlEdA nannu
lines.meaning: Sri Vasudeva, do you not hold millions of universes in your belly?

lines.text: kalashAmbudhilO dayatO namarulakai adigAka gOpi
lines.meaning: In the ocean of milk, compassionately, for the gods (you bore the mountain); and besides, for the gopis'

lines.text: kalakai koNDa letta lEdA karuNAkara tyAgarAjuni
lines.meaning: sake, did you not lift a mountain? O compassionate one, (is protecting) Tyagaraja (a burden)?

songs.title: ninnADa nEla
songs.summary: Why blame Rama? Everything comes according to one's own karma, dharma and mind.

lines.text: ninnADa nEla nIrajAkSa shrI rAma
lines.meaning: Why blame you, lotus-eyed Sri Rama?

lines.text: kannavAriki paini kAkasEya nEla
lines.meaning: Why lash out at my parents or anyone else?

lines.text: karmAniki taginaTTu Aryamulu naDicEni dharmAniki taginaTTu daivamu brOcEni
lines.meaning: Events unfold according to karma; God protects according to dharma;

lines.text: cittaniki taginaTTu siddhiyu galgEni viTTAniki taginaTTu vEDuka naDicEni
lines.meaning: fulfilment comes according to the mind; enjoyment comes according to one's merit.

lines.text: satvarUpa ninu sannuti jEsi tatvamu delisina tyAgarAjuniki
lines.meaning: (So it was shown) to Tyagaraja, who praised you, the embodiment of goodness, and knew the truth.

songs.title: mari mari ninnE
songs.summary: Tyagaraja cries out again and again; Rama rushed for the elephant, Dhruva and Prahlada — why not for him?

lines.text: mari mari ninnE moraliDa nI manasuna dayarAdu
lines.meaning: Though I cry out to you again and again, compassion does not enter your heart.

lines.text: kari moravini saraguna cana nIku kAraNam Emi sarvAntaryAmi
lines.meaning: What made you rush at the elephant's cry, O indweller of all?

lines.text: karuNatO dhruvuni kEDuta nilcina katha vinnAnayya suraripu tanayunikai
lines.meaning: I have heard how compassionately you stood before Dhruva; for the son of the gods' enemy (Prahlada)

lines.text: nara mrgamau sUcana lEmayya maraci yunna vana caruni brOcina-mahima
lines.meaning: you became the man-lion without warning; and the greatness of saving the forest-dweller who had forgotten (you) —

lines.text: delupuvayya dharanu velayu tyAgarAja sannuta taramugaA dika nE vinanayya
lines.meaning: tell me, O one praised by Tyagaraja, shining on earth; I can no longer bear just hearing (such stories).

songs.title: shrI rAma pAdamA
songs.summary: A prayer to Rama's feet, which released Ahalya from the curse: bless me the same way.

lines.text: shrI rAma pAdamA nI krpa jAlunE cittAniki rAvE
lines.meaning: O feet of Sri Rama, your grace is enough — come into my heart,

lines.text: vArijabhava sanaka sanandana vAsavAdi nAradAdu lella pUjince
lines.meaning: (you feet) worshipped by Brahma, Sanaka, Sanandana, Indra, Narada and all the others.

lines.text: dArini silayai tApamu tALaka vAramu kannIrunu rAlcaga
lines.meaning: On the path, (Ahalya) had become stone, unable to bear her suffering, shedding tears constantly;

lines.text: shUra ahalyanu jUci brOcitivi A rIti dhanyu sEyavE tyAgarAja bhAgyamA
lines.meaning: valiant one, seeing Ahalya you saved her — in that way make me blessed too, O fortune of Tyagaraja.

songs.title: ennALLu UrakE
songs.summary: How long will you stay silent, Rama? Is there no one to ask you why?

lines.text: ennALLu UrakE induvO jutAmu evaraDigEv ru lEdA shrI rAma
lines.meaning: How long will you stay silent here? Is there no one to question you, Sri Rama?

lines.text: konnALLu sakEtapura mEla lEdA kOrika munulaku gonasAga lEdA
lines.meaning: Did you not rule Saketa for a while? Did you not fulfil the sages' wishes?

lines.text: sati mATala nAlakinci sadbhakta kOTula samrakSincaga lEdA matimantula
lines.meaning: Did you not heed your wife's words and protect countless true devotees? Is not protecting the wise

lines.text: brOchE matamu mAdana lEdA satatamu shrI tyAgarAjanuta nammaga lEdA
lines.meaning: your very creed? Has not Sri Tyagaraja, who always praises you, trusted you?

songs.title: rArA mAyiNTi dAka
songs.summary: Tyagaraja invites Rama to come to his house, describing how he would serve him and forget all his troubles.

lines.text: rArA mAyiNTi dAka raghuvIra sukumAra mrokkErA
lines.meaning: Come, come to our house, valiant and tender hero of the Raghus — I bow to you.

lines.text: rArA dasharatha kumArA nannElukOrA tALAlErA rAma
lines.meaning: Come, son of Dasharatha, take me as your own — I can bear it no longer, Rama.

lines.text: kOrina kOrkulu konasAgakanE nIraja nayana nI dArini gAni
lines.meaning: My wishes unfulfilled, O lotus-eyed one, looking only down your path,

lines.text: vEsAriti gAni sAdhu janAvana svAri vEDali sAmi nEDaina
lines.meaning: I grew weary; protector of good people, you went off on a journey — Lord, at least today (come).

lines.text: prodduna lEci puNyamu tOTi buddhulu jeppi brOtuvugAni muddu-
lines.meaning: Rising at dawn, you would counsel me with good thoughts and protect me; your lovely

lines.text: gAru nI mOmunu jUcucu vadda nilici vAramu pUjincE
lines.meaning: face I would behold, standing near you, worshipping you always.

lines.text: dikku nIvanucu delisi nannu brOva grakkunarAvu karuNanu nIcE
lines.meaning: Knowing that you are my refuge, come quickly in compassion to protect me;

lines.text: jikkiyunnadella maraturA ika shrI tyAgarAjuni bhAgyamA
lines.meaning: I will forget all the troubles I have been caught in — O fortune of Sri Tyagaraja.

songs.title: mArubalka kunna
songs.summary: Why don't you answer me, Rama? Did I worship some seducer or thief?

lines.text: mArubalka kunna vEmirA mA manOramaNa
lines.meaning: Why don't you answer me, O delight of my heart?

lines.text: jAracOra bhajana jEsitinA sAkEta sadana
lines.meaning: Did I worship a seducer or a thief, O dweller in Saketa?

lines.text: dUra bhAramandu nA hrdayAravinda mandu nelakonna
lines.meaning: You who came from afar and settled in the lotus of my heart,

lines.text: dAri nerigi santasilli naTTi tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: knowing the way, and rejoiced — O one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: sogasugA mridanga
songs.summary: Who can charm Rama with beautiful music — perfect rhythm, pure svara, true devotion and the nine rasas? Is Tyagaraja capable of it?

lines.text: sogasugA mrdanga tALamu jatagUrci ninu sokkajEyu dhIruDevvaDO
lines.meaning: Who is the hero who can charm you, keeping beautiful time with the mridanga,

lines.text: nigama shirOttama galgina nija vAkkulatO svara shuddhamutO
lines.meaning: with true words that hold the essence of the Vedas, and with purity of svara,

lines.text: yati vishrama sadbhakti virati drAkSArasa nva rasayuta
lines.meaning: with pauses and rests, true devotion and detachment, with the nine rasas, sweet as grape juice,

lines.text: krticE bhanjiyincE yukti tyAgarAjuni taramA shrI rAma
lines.meaning: worshipping you with compositions — is such skill within Tyagaraja's reach, Sri Rama?

songs.title: bhuvini dAsuDanE
songs.summary: Tyagaraja protests that he never claimed to be Rama's devotee out of greed, and that Rama's feet are his only refuge.

lines.text: bhuvini dAsuDan pErAsacE bonkulADitinA budha manOharA
lines.meaning: Did I, out of greed, falsely claim on earth to be your servant, O delight of the wise?

lines.text: avivEka mAnavula gOrikOri aDDatrOva drokkitinA brOvavE
lines.meaning: Did I take crooked paths, begging thoughtless men? Protect me.

lines.text: cAla saukhyamO kaSTamO nEnu jAli jenditin sarivArilO
lines.meaning: In great joy or sorrow, I have suffered among my peers;

lines.text: pAlamuncina nITamuncina padamulE gati tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: whether you plunge me in milk or in water, your feet alone are my refuge, O one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: nI pada pankajamula
songs.summary: Tyagaraja trusts Rama's lotus feet, recalling how Rama broke Shiva's bow, freed Ahalya, and helped Sugriva.

lines.text: nI pada pankajamula nE nera namminAnu
lines.meaning: I have trusted completely in your lotus feet,

lines.text: bhUpAlula garvambu lanacu koraka paramEshvaru cApamu druncina
lines.meaning: you who broke Shiva's bow to crush the pride of kings;

lines.text: kOpamutO munu tApasi iccina shApamuna ahalya anudinamu
lines.meaning: who ended the anguish of Ahalya, who, cursed long ago in anger by the sage, day after day

lines.text: cAparAti tanutApa morvani Apenu gani paritApamu dIrcina
lines.meaning: lay as a stone, unable to bear her torment;

lines.text: vanaruha tulita nayana sankrandana tanayuni bAdha sahimpani virOcana-
lines.meaning: lotus-eyed one, who could not bear the suffering Indra's son (Vali) caused, and as fear grew in the mind of the Sun's son (Sugriva),

lines.text: sutu madi galigina bhaya megayaga ghana tama dundubhi bEnutala dannina
lines.meaning: kicked away the huge dark skeleton of Dundubhi with your toe;

lines.text: jyAvaranuta jyAjAvara biDau jAvarAja shrta tyAgarAja
lines.meaning: praised by the lord of Parvati, beloved of the Earth's daughter, refuge of Tyagaraja,

lines.text: jyAvarAja rudrA-vanIsura bhavanIya muni jIvana anishamu
lines.meaning: praised by Rudra, protector of Brahmins, life of the sages — always (I trust your feet).

songs.title: nADADina mATa
songs.summary: Tyagaraja reminds Rama of the promise he once made — to protect him well — and asks him not to break it.

lines.text: nADADina mATa nEDu tappu valadu nA taNDri shrI rAma
lines.meaning: Don't break today the word you gave long ago, my father, Sri Rama.

lines.text: EDADi nADuga eDabAyani vAni pODimiga gApADudunani cinna
lines.meaning: 'I will protect well the one who has not left me since he was a child' — (so you said);

lines.text: talaku vaccina bAdha talapAgaku sEtu valaci nammina vAni valalOna dagaludu
lines.meaning: 'trouble aimed at his head will only take his turban; one who trusts me as at the bridge will not be caught in a snare';

lines.text: ila bhakti sAgara mIda jEtunani talabOsi palkitivE tyAgarAjArcita
lines.meaning: 'I will lift him onto the ocean of devotion on this earth' — you vowed this solemnly, O one worshipped by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: bAgAyanayya
songs.summary: How wonderful are the Lord's illusions — he does everything and says 'not I', as he taught Arjuna in the Gita.

lines.text: bAgAyanayya nI mAya lentO; brahmakaina koniyADa taramA (bAgAya)
lines.meaning: How wonderful are your illusions! Can even Brahma praise them fully?

lines.text: I gAradamunu yonarincucunu nE gAdanucu balkuTayu (bAgAya)
lines.meaning: Doing all this mischief, and then saying 'it is not I'!

lines.text: alanAdu kauravula naNaca mana yalari dOsamanu naruni jUci pApa
lines.meaning: That day, to destroy the Kauravas, seeing Arjuna dread the sin,

lines.text: phalamu nIku danaku lEdani cakkaga pAlanamu sEya lEdA? tyAgarAjanuta? (bAgAya)
lines.meaning: did you not protect him well, saying 'the fruit of sin is neither yours nor his'? O one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: kalinarulaku
songs.summary: What use is it to describe the Lord's glories to the people of the Kali age who wear devotion only as a disguise?

lines.text: kalinarulaku mahimalu delipi Emi phalamana lEdA
lines.meaning: Has it not been said: what use is it to tell your glories to the people of the Kali age?

lines.text: ilanu velayu vara vrSabhAdula kaTu kula ruci teliyu candamugA nI
lines.meaning: It is like expecting fine bullocks on earth to know the taste of delicacies.

lines.text: dAra sutulakai dhanamunakai Uru pErulakai bahu pedda tanamukai
lines.meaning: For wives and children, for wealth, for village and fame, for great status,

lines.text: sAreku bhakta vESamu konuvAriki tArakanAma shrI tyAgarAjArcita
lines.meaning: to those who keep wearing the guise of devotees — O saving name, worshipped by Sri Tyagaraja.

songs.title: rAmAbhirAma ramaNIya
songs.summary: A lover's complaint to Rama: I longed for you and grew weary, yet you show no compassion.

lines.text: rAmAbhirAma ramaNIya nAma samAja ripu bhIma sAkEta dhAma
lines.meaning: Rama, delightful one, of lovely name, terror to the enemies of the good, dweller in Saketa.

lines.text: vanaja lOcana nIvu valasi alasiti nI manasuna dayalEdu mallADi phalamEmi
lines.meaning: Lotus-eyed one, I loved you and grew weary; there is no compassion in your heart — what use is my sulking?

lines.text: manasuna celi nIkE marulu konnadi gAni canuvuna ceyi baTTi mammu rakSimpavu
lines.meaning: My heart is infatuated with you alone, yet you don't take our hand affectionately and protect us.

lines.text: kOri kOri ninnu goluvaga nI dAri vErayinadi dhAta vralEmO
lines.meaning: Though I longed and longed to serve you, your path went another way — perhaps it is what Brahma wrote.

lines.text: kamanIya magu pAnpu gAvinciti nandu ramiyimpaka nannu racca jEsEvu
lines.meaning: I made a lovely bed; without delighting in it, you make me a public spectacle.

lines.text: dikku nIvani nEnu dina dinamunu namma yekku takkuvalandu enasEdu guNamEmO
lines.meaning: Day after day I trust that you are my refuge; what merit do you find in counting my highs and lows?

lines.text: nIkE dayabuTTi nIvu brOvavalE rAkEndu mukha tyAgarAja varada shrI
lines.meaning: Compassion must arise in you, and you must protect me, moon-faced one, giver of boons to Tyagaraja.

songs.title: mundu vEnuka
songs.summary: Tyagaraja asks Rama to accompany and guard him on all sides — in front, behind and on either side.

lines.text: mundu vEnuka iru prakkala tODai murakhara-hara rArA
lines.meaning: Come with me in front, behind and on either side, O slayer of Mura and Khara — come.

lines.text: endugAna nI andamuvale raghunandanavEgamE rArA
lines.meaning: Where could one find beauty like yours? Delight of the Raghus, come quickly.

lines.text: caNDa bhAskara kulAbdhi candra kOdaNDapANiyai rArA
lines.meaning: Moon to the ocean of the blazing Solar race, come bearing the Kodanda bow.

lines.text: aNDa golucu saumitri sahituDai yAmiya parAkrama rArA
lines.meaning: Come with Saumitri, who serves at your side, O one of valour, come.

lines.text: O gaja rakSaka O rAjakumAra OmkAra sadana rArA
lines.meaning: O protector of the elephant, O prince, abode of Om, come.

lines.text: bhAgavata priya bAga brOvavayya tyAgarAjanuta rArA
lines.meaning: Dear to devotees, protect me well, praised by Tyagaraja, come.

songs.title: yOcanA kamala
songs.summary: Why this hesitation in protecting me, Rama?

lines.text: yOcanA kamala lOcana nannu brOva
lines.meaning: Why this hesitation, lotus-eyed one, in protecting me?

lines.text: sUcana teliyaka norula yAcana jEtu nanucu nIku dOcana dyuti vijitAyuta virOcana nannu brOva inka
lines.meaning: Does it seem to you that I don't understand hints and that I beg others? O you whose radiance outshines ten thousand suns, protect me now.

lines.text: kEcana nija bhakta nicaya pApa vimOcana gala birudu lella goni
lines.meaning: Some say you bear every title for releasing hosts of true devotees from sin;

lines.text: nannEcana krta vipina cara varAbhi-SEcanA tyAgarAja pUjita
lines.meaning: you tease me — you who crowned the best of the forest-dwellers (Sugriva), worshipped by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: E tAvunarA
songs.summary: Where is your dwelling place, Lord? In the goddesses, the elements, the worlds, or the gods?

lines.text: E tAvunarA nilakaDa nIku enci jUDa nagapaDavu
lines.meaning: Where is your dwelling place? Even searching, I cannot find it.

lines.text: sItA gauri vAgIshvari yanu shrI rUpamulandA gOvindA
lines.meaning: Is it in the forms of Sita, Gauri and Sarasvati, Govinda?

lines.text: bhU kamalArka nila nabhamulandA lOka kOTulandA
lines.meaning: Is it in the earth, moon, sun, wind and sky? In the countless worlds?

lines.text: shrIkaruDagu tyAgarAja karArcita shiva mAdhava brahmAdulayandA
lines.meaning: Or in Shiva, Madhava, Brahma and the rest — O giver of good, worshipped by Tyagaraja's hands?

songs.title: sundari nI divya
songs.summary: Tyagaraja's joy at seeing the divine form of Tripurasundari of Tiruvottiyur at her Friday worship.

lines.text: sundari nI divya rUpamunu jUDa tanaku dorikenamma
lines.meaning: O beautiful one, I have been blessed to see your divine form, Mother.

lines.text: manda gamana kaTAkSa balamO mundaTi pUjAphalamO tripura
lines.meaning: Is it the power of your gentle glance, or the fruit of my past worship, O Tripura?

lines.text: bhuvilO varamau shrImad Adipuramuna nelakonna nI sogasu vini suvivEkulaina
lines.meaning: Hearing of the beauty of you who dwell in noble Adipura on earth, the wise

lines.text: brahmAdi suralu gumpu gUDi kavi vAsarapu sEva kanungona galuguna ani karagucu
lines.meaning: Brahma and the gods gather together, melting, wondering 'will we get to see the Friday worship?' —

lines.text: madilO divi dattaramu baDacu nuNDagA dIna janArti hArini tripura
lines.meaning: while in heaven their minds are restless with longing, O remover of the sorrows of the humble, Tripura,

lines.text: kalilO dIna rakSaki ani sabha galigina tAvuna pogaDudunamma salalita guNa
lines.meaning: I will praise you before the assembly as the protector of the humble in Kali, O one of graceful virtues,

lines.text: karuNa sAgari nI sATi evaramma alasi vaccinduku nA manasu hAyicEndunA ani
lines.meaning: ocean of compassion, who is your equal, Mother? While I waited, wondering if my weary mind would be soothed,

lines.text: uNDaga mari kalakalamani surasatulu varusagA kolucu shukravAramu muddu tripura
lines.meaning: the celestial women serve you in rows, amid a joyful bustle, on the lovely Friday, Tripura —

lines.text: nannu ganna talli nA janmamu nAdu saphala mAyenamma ipuDu ghana
lines.meaning: my mother who bore me, my life is fulfilled today, Mother, now — like

lines.text: daridruniki paikamu vele kanula paNDuvugA vanaja nayana eNDu pairulaku jalamu
lines.meaning: money to the very poor, a feast for the eyes, O lotus-eyed one, like water to withering crops,

lines.text: vale shubha dAyaki kAma janakuni sOdari shrI tyAgarAja manOhari gauri
lines.meaning: giver of good, sister of Vishnu, delight of Sri Tyagaraja's heart, Gauri.

songs.title: vAsudEvayani (Daruvu)
songs.summary: A daru from Tyagaraja's opera Prahlada Bhakti Vijayam, describing the doorkeeper Vasudeva making his grand, swaggering entrance.

lines.text: vAsudEvayani veDalina Itau vAriku nI ganarE
lines.meaning: Look at him who has come out, (named) Vasudeva!

lines.text: vAsavAdi sura pUjituDai vrija nayanauni madini dalcucunu
lines.meaning: Worshipped by Indra and the gods, holding the lotus-eyed Lord in his mind,

lines.text: nIrukavi dOvatulanu gaTTi niDala munanu shrI cUrNamu beTTi
lines.meaning: wearing fine silk dhotis, with sacred powder on his forehead,

lines.text: sAri veDali I saphalO juTTi sAreku bangAru kOlanu baTTi
lines.meaning: coming out in procession into this assembly, holding a golden staff again and again,

lines.text: mATi mATikini mIsamu duvvi manmatha rUpuDu dAnani krovvi
lines.meaning: twirling his moustache again and again, puffed up that he is handsome as Manmatha,

lines.text: dATi dATi paDucunu tA nivvi dambuna balkucu pakapaka navvi
lines.meaning: leaping and stepping, swaggering, speaking proudly, laughing loudly,

lines.text: bAgu mIra naTanamu sEyucunu patita pAvuni tA vEDucunu
lines.meaning: dancing exceedingly well, beseeching the purifier of the fallen,

lines.text: rAga tALa gatulanu pADucunu tyAgarAja sannutuni pogaDucunu
lines.meaning: singing in ragas, talas and rhythms, praising the one praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: shrI gaNapatini
songs.summary: Come and worship Sri Ganapati, who dances in many rhythms with Hari's feet in his heart.

lines.text: shrI gaNapatini sEvimpa rArE shrta mAnavulArA
lines.meaning: Come and serve Sri Ganapati, O people who seek refuge,

lines.text: vAgAdhipati su-pUjala cEkoni bAga natimpucu veDlina
lines.meaning: who, receiving fine worship from Brahma, the lord of speech, set out, bowing well,

lines.text: panasa nArikElAdi jambU phalamula nAraginci ghana tarambagu mahipai padamulu
lines.meaning: having eaten jackfruit, coconut, rose-apple and other fruits, setting his feet heavily on the earth

lines.text: ghallu ghallana nunci anyamu hari caraNa yugamulanu hrdayAmbujamuna nunci
lines.meaning: with a jingling sound, and holding Hari's feet in the lotus of his heart,

lines.text: vinayamunanu tygarAja vinutuDu vividha gatula dittaLAngumani veDalina
lines.meaning: humbly, praised by Tyagaraja, he set out, dancing in various rhythms.

songs.title: gItArthamu
songs.summary: The meaning of the Gita and the bliss of music come together in one place: Hanuman, who holds Rama's feet.

lines.text: gItArthamu sangItAnandamu nI tAvuna jUDarA O manasA
lines.meaning: The meaning of the Gita and the bliss of music — see them together in one place, O mind.

lines.text: sItApati caraNAbujamu niDukonna vAtAtmajuniki bAga dElusurA
lines.meaning: Hanuman, son of the Wind, who holds the lotus feet of Sita's Lord, knows them well.

lines.text: hari hara bhAskara kAlAdi karmamulanu matamula marmamula neringina
lines.meaning: He knows the secrets of the rites and creeds of Hari, Hara, the Sun, Kala and the rest;

lines.text: hari vara rUpuDu harahaya vinutuDu vara tyAgarAja varaduDu sukhirA
lines.meaning: he, the noble monkey, praised by Shiva, granter of boons to noble Tyagaraja — he is truly happy.

songs.title: nannu brOva
songs.summary: Why such delay in protecting me? Rama knows a parent's love — he raised children himself.

lines.text: nannu brOva nIkinta tAmasamA nApai nEramEmi balkumA
lines.meaning: Why such delay in protecting me? Tell me, what is my fault?

lines.text: cinnanADe nI celimi galga kOri cintimpa lEdA shrI rAma
lines.meaning: Since childhood I longed for your friendship — did you not think of me, Sri Rama?

lines.text: nijadAsa varulagu tammulatO nIvu bAga buTTagalEdA
lines.meaning: Were you not born well among brothers who are your true servants?

lines.text: gaja rAja rakSaka tanayulanu kani pencalEdA tyAgarAjanuta
lines.meaning: Protector of the elephant king, did you not see and raise sons? (You know a parent's love) — praised by Tyagaraja.

songs.title: nagumOmu galavAni
songs.summary: A string of praises for Rama, the smiling-faced charmer of the heart, worshipped with understanding.

lines.text: nAgumOmu galavAni nA manOharuni jagamElu shUruni jAnakI varuni
lines.meaning: (I worship) the smiling-faced one, the charmer of my heart, the valiant ruler of the world, beloved of Janaki,

lines.text: dEvAdi dEvuni divya sundaruni shrI vAsudEvuni sItA rAghavuni
lines.meaning: the God of gods, the divinely beautiful, Sri Vasudeva, Sita's Raghava,

lines.text: su-jnAna nidhini sOmasUrya lOcanuni ajnAna tamamunu anacu bhAskaruni
lines.meaning: treasury of true knowledge, whose eyes are moon and sun, a sun that dispels the darkness of ignorance,

lines.text: nirmalAkAruni nikhilAgha haruni dharmAdi mOkhambu dayacEyu ghanuni
lines.meaning: of pure form, remover of all sins, the great one who graciously grants dharma and the other aims up to liberation,

lines.text: bOdhatO palumAru pUjinci nE-rAdhincu shrI tyAgarAja sannutuni
lines.meaning: praised by Sri Tyagaraja — whom I worship again and again with understanding.

songs.title: vAtApi gaNapatim
songs.summary: A prayer to Ganapati enshrined at Vatapi. Dikshitar describes his iconography and his place in the Muladhara chakra, and signs with 'Guruguha' and the raga's name.

lines.text: vAtApi gaNapatim bhajEham vAraNAsyam vara pradam shrI
lines.meaning: I worship Ganapati of Vatapi, the elephant-faced giver of boons,

lines.text: bhUtAdi samsEvita caraNam bhUta bhautika prapancabharaNam vItarAgiNam vinuta yOginam vishvakAram vighna vAraNam
lines.meaning: whose feet are served by the bhutas and others, who sustains the world of the elements, free of attachment, praised by yogis, cause of the universe, remover of obstacles;

lines.text: purA kumbha sambhava munivara prapUjitam trikONa madhyagatam
lines.meaning: worshipped long ago by Agastya, the great sage born of a pot, who dwells at the centre of the triangle,

lines.text: murAri pramukhAdy-upAsitam mUlAdhAra kSEtra sthitam
lines.meaning: worshipped by Vishnu and the other chief gods, who resides in the Muladhara,

lines.text: parAdi catvAri vAgAtmakam praNavasvarUpa vakratuNDam
lines.meaning: the essence of the four levels of speech beginning with Para, the curved-trunked one whose form is Om,

lines.text: nirantaram niTila candragaNDam nijavAmakara vidhrtEkSu daNDam
lines.meaning: who always wears the crescent moon on his forehead, who holds sugarcane in his left hand,

lines.text: karAmbuja pAsha bIjApUram kaluSavidUram bhUtAkAram
lines.meaning: who holds the noose and citron fruit in his lotus hands, far from all impurity, of vast form,

lines.text: harAdi guruguha tOSita bimbam hamsadhvani bhUSita hErambam
lines.meaning: whose form delights Shiva, Guruguha and others — Heramba, adorned by Hamsadhwani.

songs.title: vallabhA nAyakasya
songs.summary: Dikshitar declares himself a devotee of Ganapati, consort of Vallabha, giver of all desires.

lines.text: vallabhA nAyakasya bhaktO bhavAmi vAncitArtha dAyakasya vara mUSika vAhanasya
lines.meaning: I am the devotee of the consort of Vallabha, giver of all one desires, who rides the noble mouse,

lines.text: pallavapada mrdutarasya pAshAnukshAdhitarasya mallikA jAti campaka hArasya maNimlayasya
lines.meaning: whose feet are soft as tender leaves, who holds the noose and goad, who wears garlands of jasmine and champaka, adorned with jewels,

lines.text: vallI vivAha kAraNasya guruguha pUjitasya kAlI kalA mAlini kamalAkSi sannutasya
lines.meaning: who brought about Valli's marriage, worshipped by Guruguha, praised by Kali, Kalamalini and lotus-eyed Lakshmi.

songs.title: shrI mahA gaNapati ravatu mAm
songs.summary: Dikshitar's first composition: a prayer to Mahaganapati of Tiruvarur, describing his form and attributes.

lines.text: shrI mahAgaNapati ravatu mAm siddhi vinAyakO mAtaNgamukha
lines.meaning: May Sri Mahaganapati protect me — Siddhi Vinayaka, the elephant-faced,

lines.text: kAmajanaka vidhIndra sannuta kamalAlaya taTanivAsO kOmaLatara pallava pada kara guruguhAgraja shivAtmaja
lines.meaning: praised by Vishnu, Brahma and Indra, dwelling on the banks of the Kamalalaya tank, with tender leaf-like hands and feet, elder brother of Guruguha, son of Shiva;

lines.text: suvarNAkarSaNa vighnarAjO pAdAmbujO gowra varNa vasana dharO
lines.meaning: king of obstacles who draws gold, lotus-footed, wearing white garments,

lines.text: phAlacandrO narAdivinuta lambOdarO kuvalaya svaviSANa pAshANkushamOdaka
lines.meaning: with the moon on his forehead, praised by men and others, big-bellied, holding the lily, his own tusk, noose, goad and modaka,

lines.text: prakAshakarO bhavajaladhinAvO mUlaprakRiti svabhAva sukhatarO
lines.meaning: radiant, the boat across the ocean of worldly life, blissful in nature as Mula Prakriti,

lines.text: ravisahasra sannibhadEhO kavijananuta mUSikavAhO
lines.meaning: with a body radiant as a thousand suns, praised by poets, who rides the mouse,

lines.text: avanata dEvatAsamUhO avinAsha kaivalya gEhO
lines.meaning: bowed to by hosts of gods, the abode of imperishable liberation.

songs.title: mahAgaNapatim manasA
songs.summary: Dikshitar meditates on Mahaganapati, son of Shiva, lover of poetry, drama and modakas.

lines.text: mahAgaNapatim manasA smarAmi vasiSTha vAmadEvAdi vandita
lines.meaning: I meditate in my mind on Mahaganapati, worshipped by Vasishtha, Vamadeva and others,

lines.text: mahAdEvasutam guruguhanutam mArakOTi prakAsham shAntam
lines.meaning: son of Mahadeva, praised by Guruguha, radiant as ten million Manmathas, serene,

lines.text: mahAkAvya nATakAdi priyam mUSika vAhana mOdaka priyam
lines.meaning: who loves great poems and dramas, who rides the mouse and is fond of modakas.

songs.title: hastivadanAya namOstubhyam
songs.summary: Salutations to the elephant-faced Mahaganapati on his throne, holding his many weapons in his lotus hands.

lines.text: hastivadanAya namOstubhyam hATaka maya maNTapE simhAsana sthitAya
lines.meaning: Salutations to you, elephant-faced one, seated on a throne in a golden pavilion,

lines.text: hasti krtti vasana dharArccita mahA gaNapAya tat-svarUpAya samasta bhaktAnugrahAya mAyA lingita vigrahAya
lines.meaning: the great lord of the ganas, worshipped by Shiva who wears an elephant hide, of that very form, who blesses all devotees, whose form is embraced by Maya,

lines.text: kamalOtpala pAsha shankha cakrEkSu kArmuka vrIhyagra gadAnija
lines.meaning: whose lotus hands hold the lotus, lily, noose, conch, discus, sugarcane bow, ears of paddy, mace, his own

lines.text: viSANamAtulanga ratna kalasha dharaNa karAmbujAya pada
lines.meaning: tusk, the citron and a jewelled pot — to him whose feet

lines.text: pankajAya vimalAya vishvOtpatti sthiti vilayAya karuNAlayAya
lines.meaning: are lotuses, the pure one, cause of the creation, sustenance and dissolution of the universe, abode of compassion,

lines.text: himAdri tanayAnana pankaja hiraNya garbhAya sumanasE
lines.meaning: a sun to the lotus face of the Himalaya's daughter, the good-minded one,

lines.text: umAramaNa kumAra guruguha samAna varaujasE mahasE
lines.meaning: of noble splendour equal to Guruguha, son of Uma's lord — to the radiant one.

songs.title: akhilANDEshvari rakSamAm
songs.summary: A prayer to Akhilandeshvari of Tiruvanaikaval, goddess of all the universes, delighting in music.

lines.text: akhilANDEshvari rakSamAm Agama sampradAya nipuNE shrI
lines.meaning: O Akhilandeshvari, protect me, expert in the tradition of the Agamas,

lines.text: nikhila lOka nityAtmikE vimalE nirmalE shyAmaLE sakala kalE
lines.meaning: eternal soul of all worlds, spotless, pure, dark-hued, embodiment of all arts,

lines.text: lambOdara guruguha pUjitE lambAlakOd-bhAsitE hasitE
lines.meaning: worshipped by Lambodara and Guruguha, shining with long tresses, smiling one,

lines.text: vAg-dEvatArAdhitE varadE vara shaila rAjanutE shAradE
lines.meaning: worshipped by the goddess of speech, giver of boons, praised by the king of mountains, Sharada,

lines.text: jambhAri sambhAvitE janArddananutE jujAvanti rAganutE
lines.meaning: honoured by Indra, praised by Janardana, praised in the raga Jujavanti,

lines.text: jallI maddaLa jhar jhara vAdya nAdamuditE jnAnapradE
lines.meaning: delighting in the sounds of the jalli, maddala and jhar-jhara drums, giver of knowledge.

songs.title: kamalAmbA samrakSatu mAm
songs.summary: The first of Dikshitar's Kamalamba Navavarna kritis, on the goddess of Tiruvarur and the outermost enclosure of the Sri Chakra.

lines.text: kamalAmbA samrakSatu mAm hrt-kamalAnagara nivAsinI
lines.meaning: May Kamalamba protect me, who dwells in Kamalanagara, the lotus of the heart,

lines.text: sumana sArAdhitAbja mukhI sundara manah-priyakara sakhI kamalajAnanda bOdha sukhI kAntAtAra panjara shukI
lines.meaning: lotus-faced one worshipped by the gods, beloved companion of the beautiful-minded one, joyful in the bliss of knowledge, parrot in the cage of the sacred syllable,

lines.text: tripurAdi cakrEshvarI aNimAdi siddhIshvarI nitya kAmEshvarI
lines.meaning: ruler of the chakras beginning with Tripura, mistress of the siddhis beginning with Anima, eternal Kameshvari,

lines.text: kSitipura trailOkya mOhana cakra vartinI prakaTa yOginI
lines.meaning: presiding over the Trailokya Mohana chakra, the outer square of the Sri Chakra, (attended by) the Prakata yoginis,

lines.text: suraripu mahiSAsurAdi marddinI nigama purANAdi samvEdinI
lines.meaning: slayer of Mahishasura and the other enemies of the gods, known through the Vedas and Puranas,

lines.text: tripurEshI guruguha jananI tripura bhanjana ranjani
lines.meaning: ruler of Tripura, mother of Guruguha, delight of Shiva who destroyed the three cities,

lines.text: madhuripu sahOdarI talOdarI tripura sundarI mahEshvarI
lines.meaning: sister of Vishnu, slender-waisted, Tripurasundari, great goddess.

songs.title: kamalAmbAm bhajarE rE mAnasa
songs.summary: A Navavarna kriti on Kamalamba of Tiruvarur and the Sarvashaparipuraka chakra (the second enclosure of the Sri Chakra).

lines.text: kamalAmbAm bhajarE rE mAnasa kalpita mAyA kAryam tyajarE
lines.meaning: Worship Kamalamba, O mind; give up the works of imagined illusion —

lines.text: kamalAvANI sEvita pArshvAm kambujaya grIvAm nata dEvAm kamalApura sadanAm mrdu gadanAm kamanIya radanAm kamala vadanAm
lines.meaning: whose sides are served by Lakshmi and Sarasvati, whose neck surpasses the conch, to whom gods bow, dwelling in Kamalapura, of gentle speech, lovely teeth and lotus face;

lines.text: sarvAshA paripUraka cakra svAminIm parama shiva kAminIm
lines.meaning: ruler of the Sarvashaparipuraka chakra (fulfiller of all desires), beloved of Parama Shiva,

lines.text: dUrvAsArccita gupta yOginIm duhkha dhvamsinIm hamsinIm
lines.meaning: the Gupta yogini worshipped by Durvasa, destroyer of sorrow, the swan,

lines.text: nirvANa nija sukha pradAyinIm nityakalyANIm kAtyAyanIm
lines.meaning: giver of the bliss of liberation, eternally auspicious, Katyayani,

lines.text: sharvANIm madhupa vijaya vENIm sad guruguha jananIm niranjanIm
lines.meaning: Sharvani, whose braid outshines the bees, mother of the true guru Guruguha, untainted,

lines.text: garvita bhaNDAsura bhanjanIm kAmAkarSaNyAdi ranjanIm
lines.meaning: destroyer of the proud Bhandasura, delighted by Kamakarshini and the other shaktis,

lines.text: nirvishESa caitanya rUpiNIm urvI tatvAdi svarUpiNIm
lines.meaning: whose form is pure consciousness beyond attributes, whose form is the principles beginning with earth.

songs.title: bAlagOpAla pAlayAshu mAm
songs.summary: Dikshitar's prayer to Krishna as the child Gopala, recounting his form and his deeds.

lines.text: bAlagOpAla pAlayAshu mAm bhaktavatsala krpA jaladhE hari
lines.meaning: O child Gopala, protect me quickly, loving to devotees, ocean of compassion, Hari,

lines.text: nIla nIrada sharIra dhIratara nIrajakara nirupamAnanda kara lIlayA gOpavESa dhara muraLIdhara shrIdhara dAmOdaravara
lines.meaning: dark as a rain cloud, steadfast, lotus-handed, giver of matchless bliss, who in play took the guise of a cowherd, bearer of the flute, of Lakshmi, noble Damodara;

lines.text: cANUra malla haraNa nipuNatara caraNa nihata shakaTAsura murahara mANikya makuTa hAra valaya
lines.meaning: expert in slaying the wrestler Chanura, who killed Shakatasura with his foot, slayer of Mura, wearing a ruby crown, necklaces and bracelets,

lines.text: dhara mattEbha kumbha bhEdana paTutara vANIshArccita pItAmbharadhara vaijayantI vana mAlA dhara
