lines.meaning: skilled in splitting the brow of the rutting elephant, worshipped by Brahma, clad in yellow silk, wearing the Vaijayanti forest garland,

lines.text: ANavAdi vijaya mAnasAkara apahata kamsAsura nata bhUsura drON karNa duryOdhanAdi hara draupadI
lines.meaning: whose mind triumphs over the impurities beginning with ego, who destroyed Kamsa, (protector of) Brahmins who bow, destroyer of Drona, Karna, Duryodhana and others, (protector of) Draupadi's

lines.text: mAna samrakSaNakara vaiNika gAyaka guruguha nuta pura vairi vihita gOpikA manOhara
lines.meaning: honour, praised by Guruguha, the veena player and singer, worshipped by Shiva, delight of the gopis' hearts.

songs.title: akSayalinga vibhO
songs.summary: A hymn to Shiva as Akshayalinga of Tirukkannapuram/Kizhvelur, lord of countless universes.

lines.text: akSayalinga vibhO svayambhO akhilANDa kOTi prabhO pahi shambO
lines.meaning: O Akshayalinga, all-pervading, self-born, lord of countless universes — protect me, Shambhu.

lines.text: akSara svarUpa amita pratApa ArUDha vrSa vAha jagan mOha dakSa shikSaNa dakSatara sura lakSaNa vidhi vilakSaNa lakSya lakSaNa bahu vicakSaNa shudha bhakSaNa guru kaTAkSa vikSaNa
lines.meaning: Of imperishable form, of boundless valour, rider of the bull, enchanter of the world, chastiser of Daksha, most skilled, bearing divine marks, unlike all creation, the goal and its definition, deeply wise, who drank the poison, whose glance is the guru's grace;

lines.text: badarIvana mUla nAyikA sahita bhadra kALIsha bhakta vihita madana janakAdi dEva mahita
lines.meaning: with the goddess of the Badari forest, lord of Bhadrakali, worshipped by devotees, revered by Vishnu and the gods,

lines.text: mAyAkArya kalanA rahita sadaya guruguha tAta guNAtIta sAdhujanOpEta shankara navanIta hrdaya
lines.meaning: free of the workings of maya, compassionate father of Guruguha, beyond the gunas, surrounded by the good, Shankara, with a heart soft as butter,

lines.text: vibhAta tumburu sangIta hrInkAra sambhUta hEmagiri nAtha sadAshrta kalpaka mahIruha
lines.meaning: radiant, (delighting in) Tumburu's music, born of the syllable Hrim, lord of the golden mountain, wish-tree to those who seek refuge,

lines.text: padAmbuja bhava ratha gaja turaga padAdi samyuta caitrOtsava sadAshiva saccidAnandamaya
lines.meaning: whose lotus feet (are worshipped) by Brahma, celebrated in the Chaitra festival with chariots, elephants, horses and foot soldiers, Sadashiva, of the nature of existence, consciousness and bliss.

songs.title: shrI subrahmaNyAya
songs.summary: Salutations to Subrahmanya, slayer of Taraka and Shurapadma, teacher of the truth, giver of enjoyment and liberation.

lines.text: shrI subrahmaNyAya namastE namastE manasija kOTi kOTi lAvaNyAya dIna sharaNyAya
lines.meaning: Salutations, salutations to Sri Subrahmanya, lovely as countless Manmathas, refuge of the humble,

lines.text: bhUsurAdi samasta jana pUjitAbja caraNAya vAsuki takSakAdi sarpa svarUpa dharaNAya vAsavAdi sakala dEva vanditAya varENyAya dAsa janAbhISta prada dakSatarAgra gaNyAya
lines.meaning: whose lotus feet are worshipped by Brahmins and all people, who took the form of serpents like Vasuki and Takshaka, revered by Indra and all gods, most excellent, foremost among granters of devotees' wishes;

lines.text: tAraka simha mukha shUra padmAsura sam hartrE tApatraya haraNa nipuNa tatvOpadEsha kartrE
lines.meaning: to the destroyer of Taraka, Simhamukha, Shurapadma and other demons, skilled in removing the three afflictions, the teacher of the Truth;

lines.text: vIranuta guruguhAyA jnAna dhvAnta savitrE vijayavallI bhartrE saktyAyudha dhartrE
lines.meaning: to Guruguha, praised by heroes, a sun to the darkness of ignorance, husband of Valli, bearer of the Shakti spear;

lines.text: dhIrAya nata vidhAtrE dEvarAja jAmAtrE bhUrAdi bhuvana bhOktrE bhOga mOkSa pradAtrE
lines.meaning: to the steadfast one to whom Brahma bowed, son-in-law of Indra, enjoyer of the worlds beginning with Bhu, giver of enjoyment and liberation.

songs.title: Ananda naTana prakAsam
songs.summary: Dikshitar takes refuge in Nataraja of Chidambaram, radiant in the dance of bliss.

lines.text: AnandanaTana prakAsham citsabhEsham AshrayAmi shivakAma vallIsham
lines.meaning: I take refuge in the lord of the Chit Sabha, radiant in the dance of bliss, Lord of Shivakamavalli,

lines.text: bhAnukOTi kOTi sankAsham bhukti muktiprada daharAkAsham dInajana samrakSaNa caNam divya patannjali vyAghrapAda darshita kunjitAbja caraNam
lines.meaning: radiant as countless suns, the space in the heart that grants enjoyment and liberation, skilled in protecting the humble, whose raised lotus foot was revealed to Patanjali and Vyaghrapada,

lines.text: shItAmshu gangAdharam nIla kandharam shrI kEdArAdi kSEtrAdhAram
lines.meaning: bearer of the moon and the Ganga, blue-throated, support of the holy places beginning with Kedara,

lines.text: bhUtEsham shArddUla carmAmbaram cidambaram bhUsura tri-sahasra munIshvaram
lines.meaning: lord of all beings, clad in tiger skin, (dweller in) Chidambaram, lord of the three thousand Brahmin sages,

lines.text: vishvEshvaram navanIta hrdayama sadaya guruguha mAdyam vEdavEdyam vItarAgiNam
lines.meaning: lord of the universe, with a heart soft as butter, compassionate, father of Guruguha, known through the Vedas, free of attachment,

lines.text: apramEyAdvaita pratipAdyam sangIta vAdya vinOda tANDavajAta bahutara bhEda cOdyam
lines.meaning: immeasurable, expounded as non-dual, whose many kinds of tandava born of the joy of music and instruments are a wonder.

songs.title: cEtah shrI bAlakrSNam
songs.summary: O mind, worship the child Krishna, whose lotus feet grant every wish.

lines.text: cEtah shrI bAlakrSNam bhaja rE rE cintitArttha prada caraNAravindam mukundam
lines.meaning: O mind, worship Sri Balakrishna, Mukunda, whose lotus feet grant whatever one wishes,

lines.text: nUtana nIrada sadrsha sharIram nanda kishOram pIta vasana dharam kambu kandharam giridharam pUtanAdi samhAram puruSOttamAvatAram shItaLa hrdaya vihAram shrI rukmiNI dAram
lines.meaning: with a body like a fresh rain cloud, young son of Nanda, in yellow robes, with a conch-like neck, who held up the mountain, slayer of Putana and others, incarnation of the Supreme Person, who roams in calm hearts, husband of Sri Rukmini;

lines.text: navanIta gandhavAha vadanam mrdu gadanam naLina patra nayanam vaTa patra shayanam
lines.meaning: whose mouth bears the scent of butter, of gentle speech, with lotus-petal eyes, who lies on a banyan leaf,

lines.text: nava campaka nAsikam atasI suma bhAsakam natEndrAdi lOka pAlakam mrga mada tilakam
lines.meaning: with a nose like a fresh champaka bud, shining like the atasi flower, protector of Indra and the guardians who bow to him, with a musk tilaka,

lines.text: nava tulasI vanamAlam nAradAdi muni jAlam kuvalayAdi paripAlam guruguhanuta gOpAlam
lines.meaning: wearing a garland of fresh tulasi, (surrounded by) Narada and hosts of sages, protector of the earth, Gopala praised by Guruguha.

songs.title: tyAgarAja yOga vaibhavam
songs.summary: On the yogic splendour of Tyagaraja (Shiva) of Tiruvarur. The pallavi drops a syllable at each step (gopuchha yati); the madhyamakala builds back up (srotovaha yati).

lines.text: tyAgarAja yOga vaibhavam sadAshivam
lines.meaning: The yogic splendour of Tyagaraja (Shiva of Tiruvarur) — Sadashiva!

lines.text: tyAgarAja yOga vaibhavam sadAshrayAmi
lines.meaning: The yogic splendour of Tyagaraja — in him I always take refuge.

lines.text: tyAgarAja yOga vaibhavam
lines.meaning: The yogic splendour of Tyagaraja —

lines.text: agarAja yOga vaibhavam
lines.meaning: the splendour of the yoga of the king of mountains,

lines.text: rAja yOga vaibhavam
lines.meaning: the splendour of royal yoga,

lines.text: yOga vaibhavam
lines.meaning: the splendour of yoga,

lines.text: vaibhavam
lines.meaning: splendour,

lines.text: bhavam
lines.meaning: being,

lines.text: vam
lines.meaning: 'vam' (the seed syllable).

lines.text: nAgarAja vinuta padam nAdabindu kalAspadam
lines.meaning: Whose feet are praised by the king of serpents (Patanjali), abode of nada, bindu and kala,

lines.text: yOgirAja vidita padam yugapadbhOga mOkSapradam
lines.meaning: whose feet are known to the kings of yogis, who grants enjoyment and liberation together,

lines.text: yOgarUDha nAma rUpa vis'va srSTyAdikaraNam
lines.meaning: established in yoga, cause of the creation of the universe of names and forms,

lines.text: yugaparivrtyAbda mAsa dina ghaTikAdyAvaraNam
lines.meaning: veiled by the cycles of yugas, years, months, days and hours.

lines.text: srI guruguha guru sachitAnanda bhairavisham
lines.meaning: Lord of Anandabhairavi, guru of Sri Guruguha, existence-consciousness-bliss,

lines.text: shiva shaktyAdi sakala tatvA
lines.meaning: Shiva, Shakti and all the principles —

lines.text: swarUpa prakAsham
lines.meaning: the radiance of their very form,

lines.text: swa prakAsham
lines.meaning: self-radiant,

lines.text: swarUpa prakAsham
lines.meaning: the radiance of their very form,

lines.text: tatva swarUpa prakAsham
lines.meaning: the radiance of the form of the principles,

lines.text: sakala tatva swarUpa prakAsham
lines.meaning: the radiance of the form of all the principles,

lines.text: shiva shaktyAdi sakala tatvA swarUpa prakAsham
lines.meaning: the radiance of the form of all the principles beginning with Shiva and Shakti.

songs.title: mInAkSi mEmudam dEhi
songs.summary: Dikshitar asks Minakshi of Madurai, daughter of the Pandya king and beloved of Sundareshvara, to grant him joy.

lines.text: mInAkSi mE mudam dEhi mEcakAngi rAjamAtangi
lines.meaning: Minakshi, grant me joy, dark-limbed one, Rajamatangi,

lines.text: mAnamAtrumE mAyE marakata chAyE shivajAyE mInalOcani pAshamOcani mAnini kadamba vanavAsini
lines.meaning: Mother who is the measure of all, Maya, of emerald hue, Shiva's consort, fish-eyed one, releaser from bonds, noble one, dweller in the Kadamba forest,

lines.text: madurApuri nilayE maNivalayE malayadhvaja pANDya rAja tanayE
lines.meaning: dwelling in Madurai, wearing jewelled bangles, daughter of the Pandya king Malayadhvaja,

lines.text: vidhuviDambana vadanE vijayE vINAgAna dasha gamakakriyE
lines.meaning: whose face mocks the moon, victorious one, delighting in veena music with its ten gamakas,

lines.text: madhu mada mOdita hrdayE sadayE mahAdEva sundarEshapriyE
lines.meaning: whose heart is joyful in the intoxication of spring, compassionate, beloved of Mahadeva Sundareshvara,

lines.text: madhu suraripu sOdari shAtOdari vidhi guruguha vashankari shankari
lines.meaning: sister of Vishnu, slender-waisted, who captivates Brahma and Guruguha, Shankari.

songs.title: kancadaLAyadAkshI
songs.summary: A hymn to Kamakshi of Kanchipuram as Tripurasundari.

lines.text: kanjadaLAyatAkSi kAmAkSi kamalAmanOhari tripurasundari
lines.meaning: Lotus-petal-eyed Kamakshi, Kamalamanohari, Tripurasundari,

lines.text: kunjaragamanE maNimaNDita manjuLacaranE mAmavashiva panjarashuki paNkajamukhi guruguha ranjani duritabhanjani niranjani
lines.meaning: of elephant-like gait, with lovely feet adorned with gems, protect me, parrot in Shiva's cage, lotus-faced, delight of Guruguha, destroyer of sins, untainted one,

lines.text: rAkA shashivadanE suradanE rakSitamadanE ratnasadanE shrIkAncana vasanE surasanE
lines.meaning: with a face like the full moon, lovely teeth, protector of Manmatha, dwelling in a jewelled house, clad in gold, gracious one,

lines.text: shRNgArAshraya mandahasanE EkAnEkAkSari bhuvanEshvari EkAnandAmRtahari bhAsvari EkAgramanOlayakari shrIkari EkAmrEsha gRhEshvari shaNkari
lines.meaning: whose gentle smile is the home of love, Bhuvaneshvari of the one and many syllables, bringer of the nectar of bliss, radiant, who makes the mind one-pointed and absorbed, giver of good, queen of Ekamresha's house, Shankari.

songs.title: nIrajAkSi kAmAkSi
songs.summary: A prayer to lotus-eyed Kamakshi, the goddess of the nine enclosures of the Sri Chakra.

lines.text: nIrajAkSi kAmAkSi nIrada cikurE tripurE
lines.meaning: Lotus-eyed Kamakshi, with hair dark as rain clouds, Tripura,

lines.text: shAradA ramA nayanE sArasa candrAnanE vArijapAdE varadE tAraya mAm tatvapadE
lines.meaning: worshipped by Sharada and Lakshmi, with a face like the lotus and moon, lotus-footed, giver of boons — save me, O abode of truth,

lines.text: gaurI hindOLa dyuti hIra maNimayAbharaNE shauri virinci vinuta shiva shaktimaya navAvaraNE
lines.meaning: Gauri, radiant in Hindola, with ornaments of diamonds and gems, praised by Vishnu and Brahma, (dwelling in) the nine enclosures made of Shiva and Shakti,

lines.text: nArImaNyAdyarccita nava nAdAntah karaNE sUrijana samsEvita sundara guruguha karaNE
lines.meaning: worshipped by the jewels among women and others, whose inner being lies beyond nada, served by the wise, cause of beautiful Guruguha.

songs.title: raNgapura vihAra
songs.summary: A hymn to Ranganatha of Srirangam as Kodanda Rama, with the raga name woven in.

lines.text: raHNgapura vihAra jaya kOdaNDarAmAvatAra raghuvIra shrI
lines.meaning: O dweller in Srirangam, victory to you, incarnation as Kodanda Rama, hero of the Raghus,

lines.text: aHNgaja janaka dEva bRndAvana sAraHNgEndra varada ramAntaraHNga shyAma
lines.meaning: father of Manmatha, God, giver of boons to the elephant king, dwelling in Lakshmi's heart, dark one,

lines.text: lAHNga vihaHNga turaHNga sadayApAHNga satsaHNga
lines.meaning: whose steed is the bird Garuda, of compassionate glance, lover of good company,

lines.text: paHNkajAptakula jalanidhi sOma vara paHNkaja mukha paTTAbhirAma
lines.meaning: moon to the ocean of the Solar race, lotus-faced, Pattabhirama,

lines.text: padapaHNkaja jitakAma raghurAma vAmAHNka gata sItAvara
lines.meaning: whose lotus feet conquered Kama, Raghurama, Lord of Sita who sits at your left side,

lines.text: vESa shESAHNka shayana bhakta santOSa ENAHNkaravi nayana mRdutarabhASa
lines.meaning: reclining on Shesha, delight of devotees, with eyes of moon and sun, of gentle speech,

lines.text: akaLaHNka darpaNa kapOla vishESa munisankaTa
lines.meaning: with spotless mirror-like cheeks, remover of the sages' sorrows,

lines.text: haraNa gOvinda vENkaTa ramaNa mukunda saHNkarSaNa mUla kanda shaHNkara
lines.meaning: Govinda, Venkataramana, Mukunda, Sankarshana, root cause, Shankara,

lines.text: guruguhAnanda
lines.meaning: bliss of Guruguha.

songs.title: shrI krSNam bhaja mAnasa satatam
songs.summary: O mind, always worship Krishna — the child Gopala, lord of Guruvayur.

lines.text: shrI krSNam bhaja mAnasa satatam shritajana paripAlam gOpAlam bAlam
lines.meaning: O mind, always worship Sri Krishna, protector of those who seek refuge, the child Gopala,

lines.text: pAkashAsanAdi vinuta caraNam shOka mOha bhaya haraNam bhava taraNam
lines.meaning: whose feet are praised by Indra and others, remover of sorrow, delusion and fear, the crossing of worldly life,

lines.text: shanka cakra gadA padma vanamAlam vENugAna lOlam krpAlavAlam
lines.meaning: with conch, discus, mace, lotus and forest garland, delighting in the flute, abode of compassion,

lines.text: kankaNa kEyUra makuTa maNDita kamanIya kanakamaya cElam
lines.meaning: adorned with bracelets, armlets and crown, in lovely golden robes,

lines.text: pankajAsanAdi dEvamahitam shrI guruguha vihitam ramA sahitam
lines.meaning: revered by Brahma and the gods, worshipped by Sri Guruguha, with Lakshmi,

lines.text: pankajadaLa nayanam vaTa shayanam guru pavanapurAdhIsham lOkEsham
lines.meaning: lotus-petal-eyed, lying on the banyan leaf, lord of Guruvayur, lord of the worlds.

songs.title: bhajarE re citta
songs.summary: Worship Balambika of Vaitheeswarankoil, mother of Muttukumara, whose form is the sacred syllables of the Panchadashi mantra.

lines.text: bhajare re re citta bAlAmbikAM bhakta kalpalatikAM tAM
lines.meaning: Worship, O mind, Balambika, the wish-fulfilling creeper of devotees,

lines.text: nijarUpa dAna dakshhacaraNAM aruNAM nityAkalyANIM sharvANIM
lines.meaning: whose feet readily grant one's true form, the rosy one, eternally auspicious, Sharvani,

lines.text: shrI vAgbhava kUTa jAta catur-veda-svarUpiNIM
lines.meaning: born of the Vagbhava kuta, whose form is the four Vedas,

lines.text: shrngAra kAmarAjodbhava sakala vishva vyApiNIM
lines.meaning: born of the Kamaraja kuta of love, pervading the whole universe,

lines.text: devIM shaktibIjodbhava mAtrkArNa sharIriNIM
lines.meaning: the Goddess born of the Shakti seed, whose body is the letters of the alphabet,

lines.text: devanuta bhava roga hara vaidyapati hrdaya vihAriNIM
lines.meaning: praised by the gods, dwelling in the heart of Vaidyanatha, lord of physicians, healer of the disease of worldly life,

lines.text: bhAva rAga tALa modinIM bhaktAbhIshhTa pradAyinIM
lines.meaning: delighting in bhava, raga and tala, granter of devotees' desires,

lines.text: sevaka jana pAlana guruguha rUpa muttu kumAra jananIM
lines.meaning: protector of those who serve her, mother of Muttukumara, who is Guruguha.

songs.title: shrI nAthAdi guruguhO
songs.summary: Victory to Guruguha, first of the gurus; meditate always in the heart, 'I am Chidanandanatha'.

lines.text: shrI nAthAdi guruguhO jayati jayati shrI cidAnanda nAthOhamiti santatam hrdini bhaja
lines.meaning: Victory, victory to Guruguha, (first among) the gurus beginning with Sri Natha; worship always in your heart, thinking 'I am Chidanandanatha'.

lines.text: nAnAprapanca vicitrakarO namarUpa panca bhUtAkarO ajnAna dhvAnta pracaNDa bhAskarO jnAna pradAyakO mahEshvarO dInAvanOdyukta divyatarO divyaughAdi sakala dEha dharO mAnasAnandakara caturatarO mad guruvarO mangaLam karOtu
lines.meaning: Creator of the diverse universe of name, form and the five elements, a blazing sun to the darkness of ignorance, giver of knowledge, the great lord, most divine, eager to save the humble, who bears all bodies beginning with the divine lineage, delighting the mind, most skilled — may my noble guru grant auspiciousness.

lines.text: mAyAmaya vishvAdhiSThAnO mAtmaka kAdi matAnuSThAnO mAlinI maNDalAnta
lines.meaning: The basis of the universe made of maya, practiser of the 'kadi' tradition, (worshipped) within the Malini mandala

lines.text: vidhAnO mantrAdya japA hamsa dhyAnO mAyA kArya kalanA hInO mAmaka sahasra
lines.meaning: by rite, meditating on the Hamsa japa that begins the mantras, free of the workings of maya, seated on my thousand-petalled

lines.text: kamalAsInO mAdhurya gAnAmrta pAnO mAdhavAdya bhaya varapradAnO mAyA
lines.meaning: lotus, who drinks the nectar of sweet music, granter of fearlessness and boons to Vishnu and others, of the form of Brahman

lines.text: shabaLita brahma rUpO mArakOTi sundara svarUpO matimatAm hrdaya gOpura dIpO
lines.meaning: variegated by maya, beautiful as countless Manmathas, a lamp in the tower of the hearts of the wise,

lines.text: matta shUrAdi jayapratApO mAyAmALavagauLAdi dEsha mahIpati pUjita pada pradEsha
lines.meaning: whose valour conquered the proud Shura and others, whose feet are worshipped by kings of lands such as Mayamalavagaula,

lines.text: mAdhavAdyamara brnda prakAsha mahEshasya mahArthOpadEsha
lines.meaning: who illumines Vishnu and the hosts of gods, who taught Shiva the great meaning (of Om).

songs.title: shrI kAntimatIm
songs.summary: Salutations to Kantimati of Tirunelveli, Shankara's young consort and mother of Guruguha.

lines.text: shrI kAntimatIm shaHNkara yuvatIm shrI guruguhajananIm vandEham
lines.meaning: I salute Sri Kantimati, Shankara's young consort, mother of Sri Guruguha,

lines.text: hRImkAra bIjAkAra vadanAm
lines.meaning: whose face has the form of the seed syllable Hrim,

lines.text: hiraNya maNimaya shObhAsadanAm
lines.meaning: whose splendid home is of gold and gems,

lines.text: pAkashAsnAdi dEva vintuAm
lines.meaning: praised by Indra and the gods,

lines.text: parashurAmanata himashailasutAm
lines.meaning: daughter of the snow mountain, to whom Parashurama bowed,

lines.text: shuka shaunakAdi sadArAdhitAm shuddha
lines.meaning: always worshipped by Shuka, Shaunaka and others, pure,

lines.text: tAmraparNItaTasthitAm shaHNkhA dyaSTOttara sahasra
lines.meaning: dwelling on the banks of the Tamraparni, delighting in the conch and a thousand and eight

lines.text: kalashAbhiSEkAmOdAmsurahitAm
lines.meaning: pots of sacred ablution, beneficent to the gods.

songs.title: shrI varalakshmi namastubhyam
songs.summary: A hymn to Varalakshmi, sung for the Varalakshmi vrata on the Friday before the full moon of Shravana.

lines.text: shree varalakshmee nama-
lines.meaning: Salutations to Sri Varalakshmi —

lines.text: stubhyam vasupradE
lines.meaning: to you, giver of wealth,

lines.text: shree saarasapadE rasapa-
lines.meaning: lotus-footed one, abode of delight,

lines.text: dE sapadE padE padE
lines.meaning: at once, at every step.

lines.text: bhaavaja janaka praaNa
lines.meaning: Beloved of Vishnu, father of Manmatha,

lines.text: vallabhE suvarNaabhE
lines.meaning: of golden radiance,

lines.text: bhaannukOTi samaana pra-
lines.meaning: radiant as ten million suns,

lines.text: bhE bhakta sulabhE
lines.meaning: easily reached by devotees,

lines.text: sEvakajana paalinyai
lines.meaning: protector of those who serve you,

lines.text: shrita pankaja maalinyai
lines.meaning: wearing a lotus garland,

lines.text: kEvalaguNashaalinyai
lines.meaning: endowed with pure virtues,

lines.text: kEshava hrt khElinyai
lines.meaning: who plays in Keshava's heart.

lines.text: shraavaNa powrNamee poorvastha shukravaarE
lines.meaning: On the Friday before the full moon of Shravana,

lines.text: caarumatee prabhrtibhih poojitaakaarE
lines.meaning: whose form is worshipped by Charumati and others,

lines.text: dEvaadi guruguha samarpita maNimayahaarE
lines.meaning: wearing a jewelled necklace offered by the gods and Guruguha,

lines.text: deenajana samrakshaNanipuNa kanaka dhaarE
lines.meaning: showering gold, skilled in protecting the humble,

lines.text: bhavanaa bhEdacaturE bhaaratee sannutavarE
lines.meaning: skilled in dispelling differences in contemplation, the best, praised by Sarasvati,

lines.text: kaivalyavitaraNaparE kaankshitaphalapradakarE
lines.meaning: intent on granting liberation, whose hands grant the fruits one desires.

songs.title: shrI satyanArAyaNam
songs.summary: We always worship Satyanarayana, made of truth, knowledge and bliss.

lines.text: shrI satyanArAyaNam upAsmahE nityam satya jnAnAnanda mayam sarvam viSNumayam
lines.meaning: We always worship Sri Satyanarayana, made of truth, knowledge and bliss — all is Vishnu,

lines.text: vAsavAdi pUjitam vara muni gaNa bhAvitam dAsajana paripAlitam bhAsamAna badarI sthitam
lines.meaning: worshipped by Indra and others, contemplated by hosts of great sages, protector of devotees, dwelling radiant in Badari,

lines.text: vaishya jAti kAraNam vaTu vESa dhAriNam kaliyuga prasannam vasu pradAna nipuNam
lines.meaning: the cause of the merchant's (story), who took the form of a Brahmin boy, gracious in the Kali age, skilled in granting wealth,

lines.text: matsya kUrma varAhAdi dashAvatAra prabhAvam shankha cakrAbja hastam guruguhanuta prasiddham
lines.meaning: glorious in the ten incarnations beginning with the fish, tortoise and boar, holding conch, discus and lotus, renowned, praised by Guruguha.

songs.title: hiraNmayIm lakSmIm
songs.summary: Dikshitar worships golden Lakshmi alone and renounces seeking help from lowly men.

lines.text: hiraNmayIm lakSmIm sadA bhajAmi hIna mAnavAshrayam tyajAmi
lines.meaning: I always worship golden Lakshmi; I give up seeking refuge in lowly men.

lines.text: ciratara sampatpradAm kSIrAmbudhi tanayAm hari vakSasthalAlayAm harinIm caraNa kisalayAm kara kamaladhrta kuvalayAm marakata maNi valayAm
lines.meaning: Giver of lasting wealth, daughter of the milk ocean, dwelling on Hari's chest, doe-like, with tender leaf-like feet, holding a lily in her lotus hand, with emerald bangles,

lines.text: shvEta dvIpa vAsinIm shrI kamalAmbikAm parAm bhUta bhavya vilAsinIm bhUsura pUjitAm varAm
lines.meaning: dwelling in Shvetadvipa, Sri Kamalambika, the supreme, delighting in all that was and will be, worshipped by Brahmins, the best,

lines.text: mAtaram abja mAlinIm mANikyAbharaNa dharAm gIta vAdya vinOdinIm girijAm tAm indirAm sIta
lines.meaning: the Mother wearing a lotus garland and ruby ornaments, delighting in song and instruments, (one with) Girija — that Indira,

lines.text: kiraNani bhavadanAm shrita cintAmaNi sadanAm pItavasanAm guruguha mAtula kAntAm lalitAm
lines.meaning: whose face is like the cool-rayed moon, dwelling in the wish-jewel house of those who seek refuge, clad in yellow, beloved of Guruguha's uncle (Vishnu), Lalita.

songs.title: sUryamUrttE namOstutE
songs.summary: The first of Dikshitar's Navagraha kritis, addressed to Surya, the Sun.

lines.text: sUryamUrtE namOstutE sundara chAyAdhi patE
lines.meaning: Salutations to you, O form of the Sun, lord of beautiful Chaya,

lines.text: kArya kAraNAtmaka jagatprakAsa simhA rAsyadhipatE
lines.meaning: light of the world of cause and effect, lord of the sign of Leo,

lines.text: AryavinutatEjasphUrtE ArogyAdiphaladakIrtE
lines.meaning: radiance praised by the noble, whose glory grants health and other blessings,

lines.text: sArasamitra mitra bhAnO sahasrakiraNa karNasUnO
lines.meaning: friend of the lotus, Mitra, Bhanu, thousand-rayed, father of Karna,

lines.text: krUra pApahara krusAnO guruguha modita svabhAnO
lines.meaning: fire that destroys cruel sins, delighting Guruguha, self-radiant,

lines.text: sUri janeDita sudinamaNE somAdi graha sikhAmaNE
lines.meaning: praised by the wise, jewel of the day, crest-jewel of the planets beginning with the Moon,

lines.text: dhIrArcita karma sAkSiNE divyatara saptAsva rathinE
lines.meaning: witness of actions, worshipped by the steadfast, rider of the divine seven-horsed chariot,

lines.text: saurAshTrArNa mantrAtmanE sauvarNa svarUpAtmanE
lines.meaning: whose essence is the Saurashtra (seed) mantra, of golden form,

lines.text: bhAratIsa hariharAtmanE bhukti mukti vitaraNAtmanE
lines.meaning: the self of Brahma, Hari and Hara, granter of enjoyment and liberation.

songs.title: mAmava paTTAbhirAma
songs.summary: A prayer to Rama at his coronation (Pattabhirama), seated with Sita in the jewelled pavilion, served by his brothers and allies.

lines.text: mAmava paTTAbhirAma jaya mAruti sannuta nAma (rama)
lines.meaning: Protect me, Pattabhirama — victory! — whose name Hanuman praises,

lines.text: kOmalatara pallava pada kOdanDarAma ghana-
lines.meaning: with tender leaf-like feet, Kodanda Rama, rain-cloud

lines.text: zyAmala vigrahAbJanayana saMpUrNa-
lines.meaning: dark in form, lotus-eyed, all-fulfilled,

lines.text: kAma raghurAma kalyANarAma rAma
lines.meaning: beloved Raghurama, Kalyanarama, Rama.

lines.text: chatracAmara karadhRta bharata lakSmaNa
lines.meaning: As Bharata holds the umbrella and chamara, as Lakshmana,

lines.text: zatrughna vibhISaNa sugrIva pramukhAdi sEvita
lines.meaning: Shatrughna, Vibhishana, Sugriva and the chief ones serve you,

lines.text: atri vaziSTAdyanugraha pAtra dazaratha
lines.meaning: worthy of the grace of Atri, Vasishtha and others, son

lines.text: putra maNiraGgavallyAdalaGkRta nava-
lines.meaning: of Dasharatha, in the hall adorned with Maniranga creepers, the nine-

lines.text: ratna maNTapE vicitramaNimaya siMhAsanE
lines.meaning: gem pavilion, on the wondrous jewelled throne,

lines.text: sItayA saha saMsthita sucaritra parama pa-
lines.meaning: seated with Sita, of noble deeds, most

lines.text: vitra guruguha mitra paGkajamitra vaMsa-
lines.meaning: holy, friend of Guruguha, moon to the nectar ocean of the Solar race,

lines.text: sudhAMbudhicandra mEdinIpAla rAmacandra
lines.meaning: ruler of the earth, Ramachandra.

songs.title: rAmacandram bhAvayAmi
songs.summary: Dikshitar meditates on Ramachandra, jewel of the Raghu race, lord of Sita.

lines.text: rAmacandram bhAvayAmi raghukulatilakam upEndram
lines.meaning: I meditate on Ramachandra, jewel of the Raghu race, Upendra,

lines.text: bhUmijAnAyakam bhuktimuktidAyakam nAmakIrtanatArakam naravaram gatamAyikam
lines.meaning: Lord of the Earth's daughter, giver of enjoyment and liberation, whose name and kirtana save, best of men, beyond illusion,

lines.text: sAkEtanagarE nivasantam sAmrAjyaprada hanumantam
lines.meaning: dwelling in the city of Saketa, granter of sovereignty, (served by) Hanuman,

lines.text: rAkEnduvadanam bhagavantam ramaNIya kalyANa guNavantam
lines.meaning: with a face like the full moon, the Lord, endowed with lovely auspicious qualities,

lines.text: kAkustham dhImantam kamalAkSam shrImantam
lines.meaning: Kakutstha, wise, lotus-eyed, glorious,

lines.text: nAgEshanutamanantam naraguruguha viharantam
lines.meaning: endless, praised by Shiva, sporting with Guruguha among men.

songs.title: rAmanAtham bhajEham
songs.summary: A hymn to Ramanatha of Rameshvaram, the Shiva worshipped by Rama.

lines.text: rAmanAtham bhajEham rAmacandra pUjitam
lines.meaning: I worship Ramanatha, worshipped by Ramachandra,

lines.text: kAmita phalaprada dEvam kOTi tIrttha prabhAvam kumAra guruguha viditam kapi brndAdi sannutam
lines.meaning: the god who grants desired fruits, whose power equals ten million holy waters, known to Kumara Guruguha, praised by hosts of monkeys and others,

lines.text: sEtu madhya gandhamAdana parvata vihAram sadA parvata varddhinI manOllAsakaram
lines.meaning: who roams on Gandhamadana hill by the bridge, ever delighting the heart of Parvatavardhini,

lines.text: hastAmalaka natavaram hATakamaya hAradharam hatyAdi pApaharam hamsasOhAkAram
lines.meaning: as plain as a gooseberry in the hand, the best, wearing golden necklaces, remover of sins like murder, of the form of 'Hamsa — So'ham'.

songs.title: annapUrNE vishAlAkSi
songs.summary: A prayer to Annapurna of Kashi, consort of Vishveshvara, who holds a vessel of payasam and a golden ladle.

lines.text: annapUrNE vishAlAkSi akhilabhuvana sAkSi kaTAkSi rakSi
lines.meaning: Annapurne, wide-eyed one, witness of all the worlds, protect me with your glance,

lines.text: unnata garta tIra vihAriNi OmkAriNi duritAdi nivAriNi pannagAbharaNa rAjnI purANi paramEshvara vishvEshvara bhAsvari
lines.meaning: who roams on the banks of the deep Ganga, embodiment of Om, remover of sins, queen adorned with serpents, ancient one, radiant consort of Vishveshvara, the supreme Lord,

lines.text: pAyasAnna pUrita mANikya pAtra hEmadarvI vidhtakarE
lines.meaning: whose hands hold a ruby vessel filled with payasam and a golden ladle,

lines.text: kAyajAdi rakaSaNa nipuNatarE kAncanamaya bhUSaNambaradharE
lines.meaning: most skilled in protecting Manmatha and others, wearing golden ornaments and garments,

lines.text: tOyajAsanAdi sEvitaparE tumburu nArsdAdi nutavarE
lines.meaning: the supreme one, served by Brahma and others, praised by Tumburu, Narada and others,

lines.text: trayAtIta mOkSaprada caturE tripada shObhita guruguha sAdarE
lines.meaning: skilled in granting liberation beyond the three gunas, radiant in three words, loving to Guruguha.

songs.title: bAlasubrahmanyam bhajEham
songs.summary: Dikshitar worships the young Subrahmanya, son of Shiva and Parashakti, who rides the peacock.

lines.text: bAlasubrahmaNyam bhajEham bhakta kalpa bhUruham shrI
lines.meaning: I worship Balasubrahmanya, the wish-fulfilling tree for devotees,

lines.text: nIlakaNTha hrdAnandakaram nitya shuddha buddha muktAmbaram
lines.meaning: who delights the heart of blue-throated Shiva, eternal, pure, awakened, free, sky-clad,

lines.text: vElAyudha dharam sundaram vEdAntArtha bOdha caturam phAlAkSa guruguha
lines.meaning: bearing the spear, beautiful, skilled in teaching the meaning of Vedanta, Guruguha incarnate (son) of the fire-eyed one,

lines.text: avatAram parAshakti sukumAram dhIram pAlita gIrvANAdi samUham panca bhUtamaya
lines.meaning: Parashakti's tender son, steadfast, protector of the hosts of gods, (beyond) the illusion of the five elements,

lines.text: mAyAmOham nIlakaNTha vAham sudEham niratishayAnanda pravAham
lines.meaning: rider of the blue-throated peacock, of beautiful body, a stream of unsurpassed bliss.

songs.title: shrI rAjagOpAla
songs.summary: A hymn to Rajagopala of Mannargudi (Dakshina Dvaraka), with Rukmini and Satyabhama at his sides.

lines.text: shrI rAjagOpAla bAla shrngAra lIla shritajana pAla
lines.meaning: Sri Rajagopala, child sporting in love, protector of those who seek refuge,

lines.text: dhIrAgragaNya dIna sharaNya cAru campakAraNya dakSiNa dvArakApurI nilaya vishiStAdvaitA-dvaitAlaya mAm pAlaya
lines.meaning: foremost of the steadfast, refuge of the humble, dwelling in lovely Champakaranya, Dakshina Dvaraka, abode of Vishishtadvaita and Advaita — protect me.

lines.text: smErAnana sEvaka caturAnana nArAyaNa tAraka divya nAma pArAyaNa krta
lines.meaning: Smiling-faced, whom four-faced Brahma serves, whose divine saving name Narayana is recited by

lines.text: nAradAdinuta sArasapAda sadAmOda nArI vESadhara vAma bhAga murArE shrI vidyArAja harE
lines.meaning: Narada and others, lotus-footed, ever joyful, who took a woman's form, Murari, Hari, king of Sri Vidya,

lines.text: shrI rukmiNI satyabhAmAshrita pArshva yugaLa kambu jayagaLa nIra sampUrNa haridrAnadI tIra
lines.meaning: with Rukmini and Satyabhama at either side, whose neck surpasses the conch, on the banks of the brimming Haridra river,

lines.text: mahOtsava vaibhava mAdhava mArajanaka nata shuka sanaka janaka vIra guruguha mahita ramA sahita
lines.meaning: Madhava of the great festival, father of Manmatha, bowed to by Shuka, Sanaka and Janaka, valiant, honoured by Guruguha, with Lakshmi.

songs.title: mAmava mInAkSI rAjamAtangi
songs.summary: Protect me, Minakshi, who holds a ruby veena and whose braid is dark as a swarm of bees.

lines.text: mAmava mInAkSI rAjamAtangi mANikya vallakIpANi madhuravANi varALi vENi
lines.meaning: Protect me, Minakshi, Rajamatangi, holding a ruby veena, of sweet speech, whose braid is like a swarm of bees,

lines.text: sOma sundarEshvara sukha sphUrti rUpiNi shyAmE shankari digvijaya praTApini
lines.meaning: embodiment of the joyous spirit of Somasundareshvara, dark one, Shankari, glorious conqueror of the directions,

lines.text: hEma ratnAbharaNa bhUSaNi Isha guruguha hrdAgAriNi kAmitArtha vitaraNa dhOraNi
lines.meaning: adorned with gold and gem ornaments, dwelling in the heart of Isha and Guruguha, a stream that grants desired things,

lines.text: kArunyAmrta paripUraNi kAma krOdhadi nivAriNi kadamba kAnana vihAriNi
lines.meaning: full of the nectar of compassion, remover of desire, anger and the rest, roaming in the Kadamba forest.

songs.title: shrI guruguhasya
songs.summary: Dikshitar's first kriti, composed at Tiruttani: 'I am the servant of Guruguha — or else, I am Guruguha himself.'

lines.text: shrI guruguhasya dAsOham nOcEt cidguruguha EvAham
lines.meaning: I am the servant of Sri Guruguha — if not, I am Guruguha, pure consciousness, myself;

lines.text: bhOga mOkSAtmaka caraNasya bhUpurAdi navAvaraNasya yOgi brndAntah-karaNasya yOga pIThAdi kAraNasya
lines.meaning: (servant) of him whose feet are enjoyment and liberation, of the nine enclosures beginning with the earth-square, of the inner minds of hosts of yogis, cause of the yoga seat and all else;

lines.text: sanakAdi pUrvIka munigaNa sannutAnanda vigrahasya vanajabhavAdi sakala sumanO
lines.meaning: whose blissful form is praised by Sanaka and the ancient sages, who grants Brahma and all the gods

lines.text: vAnchitarthAnugrahasya jananalayAdi rUpa prapanca ajnAna kArya nigrahasya manana
lines.meaning: their desires, who destroys the works of ignorance — the world of birth and death —

lines.text: dhyAna samAdhi niSTha mahAnubhAva hrd grhasya dinakara kOTi vibhAsvarasya
lines.meaning: whose home is the hearts of great souls steadfast in reflection, meditation and samadhi, radiant as ten million suns,

lines.text: tEjOmaya jagadIshvarasya janaranjanakarasya varasya sarvatmAtparasya harasya
lines.meaning: the luminous lord of the world, who delights people, the best, higher than all, Hara.

songs.title: dEvi brOva samayAmidE
songs.summary: Syama Sastri pleads with Kamakshi of Kanchipuram: this is the time to protect me — don't say 'tomorrow'.

lines.text: Devi brova samayamidhe
lines.meaning: Devi, this is the time to protect me.

lines.text: Athi vegame vachchi naa vedhalu theerchi
lines.meaning: Come very quickly and end my sorrows —

lines.text: karunimchave Shankari Kamakshi
lines.meaning: have compassion, Shankari, Kamakshi.

lines.text: Loka Janani naa pai daya ledha
lines.meaning: Mother of the world, have you no mercy on me?

lines.text: nee daasudu kaadha Sri Kanchi Vihaarini Kalyani
lines.meaning: Am I not your servant, O dweller in Kanchi, Kalyani?

lines.text: Ekamreshvaruni priya bhamayi yunna neeku
lines.meaning: For you, the beloved of Ekamreshvara,

lines.text: enamma entho bhaaramaa vinumaa thalli
lines.meaning: why, Mother, is this such a burden? Listen, Mother.

lines.text: Syam Krishnuni sodhari kaumari Bimbaadhari Gowri
lines.meaning: Sister of Shyama Krishna, Kaumari, with lips red as bimba fruit, Gauri,

lines.text: Hemapaangi Lalitha paradevatha
lines.meaning: golden-limbed, Lalita, supreme goddess,

lines.text: Kamakshi ninnu vinaa bhoomilo prematho
lines.meaning: Kamakshi, apart from you, on this earth, with love

lines.text: kaappaadevaarevaru unnaarammaa thalli
lines.meaning: who is there to protect me, Mother?

lines.text: rEpu mApani jeppithE nE vinanu ika thALanu n-Enu
lines.meaning: If you say 'tomorrow, the day after', I won't listen; I cannot bear it any more;

lines.text: I proththu dhayasEyavE krupa jUdavE
lines.meaning: show compassion this very day; look on me with grace.

lines.text: nI pAdApjamula mathilO sadAyenjci n-I
lines.meaning: Ever holding your lotus feet in my mind,

lines.text: prapEkOri yunnA namma mOthamuthO n-annu
lines.meaning: I have longed for your protection, Mother — (protect) me with joy.

songs.title: marivErE gati
songs.summary: What other refuge is there? Syama Sastri trusts Minakshi of Madurai alone.

lines.text: marivErE gati evarammA mahilO nannu brOcuTaku
lines.meaning: What other refuge is there on earth, Mother, to protect me?

lines.text: sharaNAgata rakSaki nIvEyani sadA nammiti nammiti mInAkSI
lines.meaning: I have always trusted, trusted, that you alone protect those who surrender, Minakshi.

lines.text: madurApuri nilayA vANI ramA sEvita padakamalA
lines.meaning: Dwelling in Madurai, whose lotus feet are served by Sarasvati and Lakshmi,

lines.text: madhukaitabha bhanjanI kAtyAyanI marALagamanA nigamAnta vAsini
lines.meaning: destroyer of Madhu and Kaitabha, Katyayani, of swan-like gait, dwelling at the end of the Vedas,

lines.text: varamicci tIvramE brOvu shivA ambA idi nIku baruvA
lines.meaning: grant me a boon and protect me quickly, Shiva's consort, Mother — is this a burden to you?

lines.text: nera dAtavu nIvugadA shankarI sarOja bhavAdi nIvE rakSimpa
lines.meaning: Are you not the great giver, Shankari? Even Brahma and the others are protected by you.

lines.text: shuka shyAmaLA ghana shyAmakrSNa sOdari kaumArI
lines.meaning: Holding a parrot, dark one, sister of cloud-dark Krishna, Kaumari,

lines.text: akaLanka kaLAdharI bimbAdharI apAra krpAnidhi nIvE rakSimpa
lines.meaning: bearing the spotless crescent, with bimba-red lips, boundless treasure of grace — protect me.

lines.text: pAda yugamu madilO dalaci kOriti vinamu madagaja gamanA
lines.meaning: Holding your two feet in my heart I have prayed; listen, you of stately elephant gait.

lines.text: parulu nutimpaganE varamosagu satatamu ninumati maruvakanE
lines.meaning: Even when others praise you, you grant boons; always, never forgetting you in my mind,

lines.text: madana ripu sati nanu hrdayamulO gatiyani dalaci stuti salipitE
lines.meaning: O wife of Manmatha's enemy, if I praise you, holding you in my heart as my refuge,

lines.text: mudamutO phalamosaguguTaku dharalO natAvana kutUhala nIvEga
lines.meaning: to joyfully grant the fruit — on earth, you alone delight in protecting those who bow.

songs.title: sarOjadaLa nEtri
songs.summary: Syama Sastri tells Minakshi he has always trusted her lotus feet, and asks why she delays.

lines.text: sarojadaLa nEtri himagiri putri nee
lines.meaning: Lotus-petal-eyed daughter of the snow mountain, your

lines.text: padaambhujamulE
lines.meaning: lotus feet

lines.text: sadaanamminaanamma shubhamimma shree meenaakshamma
lines.meaning: I have always trusted, Mother; grant me good, Sri Minakshamma.

lines.text: paraakusEyaka varadaayakini valEdaivamulokamulo
lines.meaning: Without delay, giver of boons — is there another god in the world like you?

lines.text: galadaa
lines.meaning: Is there?

lines.text: puraaNi sukhapaani madhukaravENi sadaashivuniki
lines.meaning: Ancient one, holding a parrot, with a braid dark as bees, Sadashiva's

lines.text: raaNi
lines.meaning: queen.

lines.text: korivaccina vaarikellanu korkalosage birudugadaa
lines.meaning: Is it not your very title that you fulfil the wishes of all who come to you?

lines.text: adibhaarama
lines.meaning: Is this a burden?

lines.text: nannubrova talli kripaalavaalanE taalajaalanE
lines.meaning: Protect me, Mother, abode of compassion; I cannot bear it any longer.

lines.text: indu muki karunincumani ninnendOveDu konTini naa
lines.meaning: O moon-faced one, how much I have pleaded with you to show compassion;

lines.text: yantu jaagElanamma mariyaada kaadu dayaavati neevu
lines.meaning: why such delay, Mother? It is not proper — you are compassionate.

lines.text: saamagaana vinodini gunadaama shyaamakrishNanutE (amba)
lines.meaning: Delighting in Sama music, abode of virtues, praised by Shyama Krishna (Mother),

lines.text: sukha
lines.meaning: (giver of) happiness,

lines.text: shyaamaLaam devi neeve gatirati kaamakaamyada
lines.meaning: dark Goddess, you alone are my refuge, granter of all desires —

lines.text: kaavavE nannu
lines.meaning: protect me.

songs.title: pAlincu kAmAkshi
songs.summary: Protect me, Kamakshi; Syama Sastri marvels at her radiant form and feels his life fulfilled by seeing her feet.

lines.text: pAlincu kAmAkSi pAvani pApa shamani
lines.meaning: Protect me, Kamakshi, holy one, destroyer of sin.

lines.text: cAla bahu vidhamugA ninu sadA vEDukonaDina endEla iLAgu sEvu veta harincavE vEgamE nanu
lines.meaning: Though I have always pleaded with you in many ways, why do you act like this? Remove my sorrow quickly.

lines.text: swara saahitya
lines.meaning: (svara-sahitya passage)

lines.text: kanaka giri sadana lalita ninu bhajana santatamu jEya nijanuDana vinumu nikhila bhuvana janavini ipuDu mA duritamu dIrcci varAlicci
lines.meaning: O Lalita, dwelling on the golden mountain, I who constantly worship you am your own; hear me, O you hailed by all the worlds; now end our sins and grant boons.

lines.text: svAntambulOna ninnE dalacE sujanula kellanE vELa santOSamu
lines.meaning: To good people who think of you in their hearts, at all times, joy

lines.text: losagEvani nIvu manOratha phaladAyinivani kAntamagu pEru ponditivi
lines.meaning: you grant; that you fulfil the heart's desires — you have earned that lovely name.

lines.text: kAruNya mUrti vaijagamu kApADina talli gadA nEnu nIdu biTTanu lAlinci
lines.meaning: Embodiment of compassion, Mother who protected the world — am I not your child? Cherish me.

lines.text: I mUrti inta tEjOmayamai iTuvale kIrti visphUrti viTalAnaya guNa
lines.meaning: Such a form, so radiant, such fame and splendour, embodiment of virtues —

lines.text: mUrti trilOkamulO jUcindaina galadA Emi toli nOmu nOcitinO nI pAda
lines.meaning: even searching the three worlds, is there another? What penance did I do in a past life, that your

lines.text: padma darshanamu vEmAru labhinci krtArtuDainati nA manaviyAlinci
lines.meaning: lotus feet I have seen again and again and am fulfilled? Listen to my plea.

lines.text: rAjAdhirAja rAjanmakuTI taTamaNi rAj abhAjAla nija sannidhi
lines.meaning: Your presence shines with the jewels at the edge of the crowns of kings of kings,

lines.text: dEvi samasta janula kella varadA rAjamukhi shyAmakrSNanuta
lines.meaning: Goddess, giver of boons to all people, moon-faced, praised by Shyama Krishna,

lines.text: kAnci purIshvari vikaca rAjIva daLAkAi jagat sAkSiyau prasanna parAshakti
lines.meaning: queen of Kanchipura, with eyes like blooming lotus petals, witness of the world, gracious Parashakti.

songs.title: kanaka shaila
songs.summary: A Sanskrit prayer to Kamakshi, who roams on the golden mountain, the ferry across worldly life.

lines.text: kanaka s'aila vihAriNI ambA kAmakOTi bAlE sus'IlE
lines.meaning: Mother who roams on the golden mountain, young Kamakoti, of noble character,

lines.text: vanaja bhava hari nutE dEvi hima girijE lalitE satatam
lines.meaning: praised by Brahma and Hari, Goddess, daughter of the snow mountain, Lalita — always

lines.text: vinatam mAm paripAlaya s'ankara vanitE satimahA tripura sundari
lines.meaning: protect me who bows to you, consort of Shankara, chaste one, great Tripurasundari,

lines.text: s'AmalAmbikE bhavAbdi taraNE s'Amakrishna paripAlini jananI
lines.meaning: Shyamalambika, ferry across the ocean of worldly life, protector of Shyama Krishna, Mother,

lines.text: kAmitArtha phala dAyaki kAmAkshi sakala lOka sAkshi
lines.meaning: giver of the fruits one desires, Kamakshi, witness of all worlds.

songs.title: himAdri sutE
songs.summary: A Sanskrit prayer to Kamakshi, daughter of the snow mountain, dwelling at the centre of Meru.

lines.text: himAdrisutE pAhimAm
lines.meaning: Daughter of the snow mountain, protect me,

lines.text: varadE paradEvatE
lines.meaning: giver of boons, supreme goddess,

lines.text: sumErumaddhya vAsini (amba)
lines.meaning: dwelling at the centre of Sumeru (Mother),

lines.text: shrI kAmAkSI
lines.meaning: Sri Kamakshi.

lines.text: hEmagAtri paNkajanEtri
lines.meaning: Golden-limbed, lotus-eyed,

lines.text: mataNgAtma-
lines.meaning: daughter of Matanga,

lines.text: jE sarOjabhava harIsha
lines.meaning: praised by Brahma, Hari and Shiva,

lines.text: sura munIndranutE
lines.meaning: the gods and great sages,

lines.text: ambujAri nibhavadanE
lines.meaning: with a face like the moon,

lines.text: mauktikamaNi-
lines.meaning: with a neck shining with

lines.text: hArahObhamAna gaLE
lines.meaning: a necklace of pearls and gems,

lines.text: bhakta kalpa latE
lines.meaning: wish-fulfilling creeper of devotees,

lines.text: shyAmakRSNa sOdari gauri
lines.meaning: sister of Shyama Krishna, Gauri,

lines.text: paramEshvari giri-
lines.meaning: Supreme Goddess, daughter of the

lines.text: jAla nIlavENi kIra-
lines.meaning: mountain, with a dark braid, with

lines.text: vANi shrI lalitE
lines.meaning: a parrot's sweet speech, Sri Lalita.

songs.title: O jagadamba nanu
songs.summary: O Mother of the world, protect me quickly; Syama Sastri asks Kamakshi to forgive his faults.

lines.text: O jagadamba nanu (amba) nIvu javamuna brOvu amba
lines.meaning: O Mother of the world, protect me quickly, Mother.

lines.text: I jagati gatiyena janulaku mari tEjamuna rAja vinutayau
lines.meaning: In this world, who else is people's refuge? Radiant one, praised by kings,

lines.text: rAjamukhI sarOja nayana suguNa rAjarAjita kAmAkSi
lines.meaning: moon-faced, lotus-eyed, shining with virtues, Kamakshi.

lines.text: kanna talli nAdu centaninta kannaDa salupaga tagunA ninnu nE nammiyunna
lines.meaning: My own mother — is it fitting to ignore me, so close to you? Am I not one who trusts you?

lines.text: vADugadA nannokani brOcuTa karudA anni bhuvanambulu gAcEvu prasanna mUrti
lines.meaning: Is protecting one like me so rare? You protect all the worlds, gracious one,

lines.text: annapUra varadA vinnapampu vinnavinci sannidhi vipanna bhaya vimOcana daurEya
lines.meaning: Annapurna, giver of boons, hear my plea and grant your presence, remover of the fear of the distressed;

lines.text: jAlamEla shailabAla tALajAlanu jananI ninnuvinA pAlanArthamuga vErE
lines.meaning: why delay, daughter of the mountain? I cannot bear it, Mother; apart from you, for protection,

lines.text: deivamula lOlamatiyai nammitinA nIlanutA shIlamu nE neccaTanainagAna gAnalOla
lines.meaning: did I fickly trust other gods? Wherever I am, my nature (is devoted to you), O lover of music,

lines.text: hrdayA nIlakaNTha rANI ninnu nammitni nijambuga balikEdi dayacEsi
lines.meaning: delight of the heart, queen of the blue-throated one — I trusted you; truly, have mercy;

lines.text: cancalAtmuDEnu Emi pUrva sancitamula salipitinO kanci kAmAkSi nEnu
lines.meaning: I am fickle-minded; what past deeds have I brought with me? O Kamakshi of Kanchi, I

lines.text: ninnu poDakAncitini sharaNu sharaNu nIvincukA cancalagati nA dEsanuncavammA
lines.meaning: have praised you; refuge, refuge — grant it; fickle as I am, keep me in your care, Mother.

lines.text: shyAmakrSNa vinutA manci kIrti niccunaTTi dEvI manninci nAdaparAdhamula sahinci
lines.meaning: Praised by Shyama Krishna, Goddess who grants good fame, forgive and bear my faults,

lines.text: varasitagiri nilayuni priya praNayini parAshakti manavini vinumA
lines.meaning: beloved of the lord of the noble white mountain, Parashakti, listen to my plea.

lines.text: mariyAda lerugani duSprabhulu kOri vinutimpaga varambosagi
lines.meaning: (Is it fair) to grant boons to wicked rulers who know no propriety when they praise you?

songs.title: pArvati ninnu nE
songs.summary: Parvati, I have trusted you completely — why delay in protecting me?

lines.text: pArvathi ninnu nE neranammithi sukapAni brOchutaku parAkikanEla suseele
lines.meaning: Parvati, I have trusted you completely; why delay in protecting me, you with a parrot in hand, of noble character?

lines.text: geervANa vanditha padasArasa sangeethalOle suguNajAle jAlamEla kAmAkShi
lines.meaning: Whose lotus feet are worshipped by the gods, lover of music, abode of virtues — why delay, Kamakshi?

lines.text: syAmakrishNa sOdharI sivasenkari gowri guNaDhAma kAma peeThavAsini sAmbhavi mruDAni
lines.meaning: Sister of Shyama Krishna, Shivashankari, Gauri, abode of virtues, dweller in Kamapitha, Shambhavi, Mrdani.

songs.title: nannu brOva lalitA
songs.summary: Protect me quickly, Lalita: I have wasted my time praising wicked men for money.

lines.text: nannu brOva lalitA vEgamE cAla ninnu neranammiyunna vADugadA bhakta kalpaka latA
lines.meaning: Protect me quickly, Lalita; I am one who has trusted you completely, creeper that fulfils devotees' wishes.

lines.text: ninnuvinA evarunnAru mA gati jananI mA jananI ati vEgamE
lines.meaning: Apart from you, who is our refuge, Mother? Our Mother — very quickly

lines.text: parAku sEyakanE vacci krpasalupa rAdA moravinavA
lines.meaning: come without delay and show compassion; won't you hear my cry?

lines.text: parAshaktI gIrvANa vanditapadA nI bhaktuDanammA santatamu
lines.meaning: Parashakti, whose feet the gods worship, I am your devotee, always.

lines.text: sarOja bhava kamala nAtha shankara surEndranuta caritA
lines.meaning: Whose story is praised by Brahma, Vishnu, Shankara and Indra,

lines.text: purANI vANI indrANI vandita rANI ahibhUSa Nuni rANI
lines.meaning: ancient one, worshipped by Vani and Indrani, queen of the one adorned with serpents,

lines.text: madAtmulaina durAtma janulanu kathalanu pogaDi pogaDi
lines.meaning: praising again and again the stories of arrogant, wicked people,

lines.text: sadA nE varAla cuTTi tirigiti vetalanella dIrcci varamosagi
lines.meaning: I always wandered after them for money; remove all my sorrows and grant a boon,

lines.text: sumEru madhya nilayE shyAmakrSNuni sOdari kaumArI
lines.meaning: dwelling at the centre of Sumeru, sister of Shyama Krishna, Kaumari,

lines.text: umA mInAkSammA shankarI O mahARajnI rakSincuTakidi samayamu
lines.meaning: Uma, Mother Minakshi, Shankari, O great queen — this is the time to protect me.

songs.title: shankari shamkuru
songs.summary: A prayer to Akhilandeshvari of Tiruvanaikaval (Jambukeshvaram) to grant good.

lines.text: shankari shamkuru candramukhi akhilANDEshvari shAmbhavi sarasija bhava vanditE gauri amba
lines.meaning: Shankari, grant good, moon-faced Akhilandeshvari, Shambhavi, worshipped by Brahma, Gauri, Mother,

lines.text: sankaTa hAriNi ripu vidAriNi kalyANi sadA nata phaladAyikE haranAyikE jagatjanani
lines.meaning: remover of distress, destroyer of foes, Kalyani, ever granting fruits to those who bow, Hara's consort, Mother of the world,

lines.text: jambupati vilAsini jagadavannOlAsini kambukandharE bhavAni kapAladhAriNi shUlini
lines.meaning: delighting with the lord of Jambu, joyful in protecting the world, conch-necked Bhavani, bearer of the skull, wielder of the trident,

lines.text: angaja ripu tOSiNi akhila bhuvana pOSiNi mangaLa pradE mrDAni marALa sannibha gamani
lines.meaning: delighting Manmatha's enemy, nourisher of all worlds, giver of auspiciousness, Mridani, of swan-like gait,

lines.text: shyAmakrSNa sOdari shyAmaLE shAtOdari sAmagAna lOlE bAlE sadArthi bhanjana shIlE
lines.meaning: sister of Shyama Krishna, dark one, slender-waisted, delighting in Sama music, young one, ever inclined to destroy sorrow.

songs.title: durusugA
songs.summary: Syama Sastri asks Tripurasundari for health and a sound body. (The karnatik.com text of this song is irregular; meanings of some lines are approximate.)

lines.text: durusugaa kripaa jooci santata
lines.meaning: Quickly, looking on me with grace, always

lines.text: maarOga driDa shareera mukha saloopoonann
lines.meaning: (grant me) health, a sturdy body — grant me,

lines.text: noo saloopoonannoo saloopoonannoo
lines.meaning: grant me, grant me, grant me.

lines.text: paramapaavanee kripaa vaneeveenuta
lines.meaning: Most holy one, compassionate one, I praise you;

lines.text: paramapaavanee kripaa vaneeveenuta
lines.meaning: most holy one, compassionate one, I praise you,

lines.text: padasarOja praNataarti haru raaNee
lines.meaning: whose lotus feet (I worship), queen of the remover of the sorrows of those who bow,

lines.text: paraaku darmasam vatta nee bahu
lines.meaning: why this indifference? (I trust) your great

lines.text: paraa kamala guNaa tripura sundaree
lines.meaning: lotus-like virtues, Tripurasundari.

lines.text: ciTTaswaram saahityam (to same swaras):
lines.meaning: (Chittaswaram, sung to the same svaras:)

lines.text: sarOja nayaNa natajana paaleeni
lines.meaning: Lotus-eyed one, protector of those who bow,

lines.text: vaneevedamulu moralitakaa
lines.meaning: the Vedas cry out to you —

lines.text: sarOja nayaNa natajana paaleeni
lines.meaning: lotus-eyed one, protector of those who bow,

lines.text: vaneevedamulu moralitakaa
lines.meaning: the Vedas cry out to you —

lines.text: nee sarulevaru manavi vinu kripaa salupoo
lines.meaning: who is your equal? Hear my plea and show compassion;

lines.text: paraakucalu para diganee vipudu
lines.meaning: now let the indifference end.

lines.text: daaraa daravinee lakacalashee
lines.meaning: With lovely tresses dark as clouds,

lines.text: thaa sarasa kavitaa nichita
lines.meaning: praised in rich, fine poetry,

lines.text: saaragaNa saarasita dharahaa
lines.meaning: with a gracious smile,

lines.text: seethaa aaa
lines.meaning: (sung vowels)

lines.text: vaariruha vaarivada nOcita
lines.meaning: with a face lovely as the lotus,

lines.text: vaageesha vinuta dritaka taa
lines.meaning: praised by Brahma, the lord of speech,

lines.text: naaraayaNee shyaama krishna vinu
lines.meaning: Narayani — listen to Shyama Krishna,

lines.text: thaa manavini vinugiree suta
lines.meaning: hear my plea, daughter of the mountain.

songs.title: birAna varAlicci
songs.summary: Grant boons quickly and protect me, Kamakshi; why turn away?

lines.text: birAna varAlicci brOvumu ninnu nera nammiti
lines.meaning: Grant boons quickly and protect me; I have trusted you completely,

lines.text: purAri manOhAriNI srI kAmAkSi
lines.meaning: enchantress of Shiva, Sri Kamakshi.

lines.text: tAmasambu sEyaka nIvu karuNAnidhi gAvA parAmukhamika nEla vinu sarOjamukhi
lines.meaning: Without delay — are you not the treasury of compassion? Why turn away now? Listen, lotus-faced one.

lines.text: kAmitArtha phaladAyakI dEvI nata kalpalatikA purANi madhura vANi sivuniki rANi
lines.meaning: Granter of desired fruits, Goddess, wish-creeper to those who bow, ancient one, of sweet speech, queen of Shiva,

lines.text: syAmakrSNa sOdari gaurI paramEshvari girijA anAtha rakSaNambu salupaga rAvE
lines.meaning: sister of Shyama Krishna, Gauri, Supreme Goddess, Girija — won't you come to protect the helpless?

songs.title: bhOgInDra shAyinAm
songs.summary: Swati Tirunal's hymn to Padmanabha of Thiruvananthapuram, describing his form, his legend with the sage Divakara, and the temple's festivals.

lines.text: bhOgIndra ShAyinam purukucaladAyinam
lines.meaning: I meditate on the one reclining on the king of serpents, the giver of the four aims of life,

lines.text: purusham ShAsvatam kalayE
lines.meaning: the eternal Person,

lines.text: vAgISha gaurISha vAsavAdya marapari
lines.meaning: whose feet are worshipped by Brahma, Shiva, Indra and the gods

lines.text: vArAbhi vanditapadam padmanAbham
lines.meaning: and the celestials — Padmanabha;

lines.text: kSIra vArAnnidhish-vEdAntarIpa bhava citramaNi saudhAsthitam
lines.meaning: dwelling in a wondrous jewelled palace on an island in the milk ocean,

lines.text: nAradAtyakhila muni divya pArSada vihaga nAyaka sadArAdhitam
lines.meaning: ever worshipped by Narada and all the sages, the divine attendants and the king of birds,

lines.text: sura bhAsura sudarshana nandaka pramukha shObhanAyudha sEvitam
lines.meaning: served by shining weapons such as the radiant Sudarshana and Nandaka,

lines.text: shrI rasAkara sarOjAmrudita pAda vandArujana bharaNOtyatam padmanAbham
lines.meaning: intent on supporting those who bow at his feet, caressed by Lakshmi's lotus hands — Padmanabha;

lines.text: parama bhaktOttama divAkara yatIndra krtaguru puNya vasudhAgatam
lines.meaning: who came to earth through the merit of the great devotee, the ascetic Divakara,

lines.text: surucirAdbhuta bAlavESa sAkSAtkAra paritOSa shira lALitam
lines.meaning: whose head was fondled with delight on beholding his lovely, wondrous child form,

lines.text: paripUjanArtha sALagrAma haraNAttatatara yOgi karavAritam
lines.meaning: who was prevented by the yogi's hand from snatching the salagrama meant for worship,

lines.text: tvaritAnuyAta yati karuNA kulAnandapara pAdhyAsitam padmanAbham
lines.meaning: who settled at the feet of the ascetic who followed swiftly, intent on compassion and joy — Padmanabha;

lines.text: kalitanuta sanyAsi bhajanAnu guNavihita
lines.meaning: pleased by the worship of the ascetics who praise him,

lines.text: kalushara parisarOjavala padma tIrthAdi
lines.meaning: whose Padma tirtha and other waters, clear as lotuses, removing impurity,

lines.text: khaNDitAShEshaduritam
lines.meaning: destroy all sins,

lines.text: kalaShOtbhavAn vita mahEndra trikUTavara
lines.meaning: praised by Agastya, Mahendra, Trikuta and the best of

lines.text: malayAcalEndra vinutam
lines.meaning: the Malaya mountains,

lines.text: kaladamana va~NJci mArtANDavar mAkalita kA~NJcana
lines.meaning: (honoured by) Martanda Varma of Vanchi, shining in the golden

lines.text: vimAnalasitam
lines.meaning: vimana —

lines.text: padmanAbham
lines.meaning: Padmanabha;

lines.text: aruNAbhamaNi makuTa makara kuNDala dhAra hAra kaustbha bhUSitam
lines.meaning: adorned with a crown of ruby-red gems, makara earrings, necklaces and the Kaustubha,

lines.text: parivIta pItAmbarAkalita kAncikAvaravanya mAlAncitam
lines.meaning: wrapped in yellow silk, adorned with a girdle and a fine forest garland,

lines.text: niravadya vancIsha sakrta lakSadIpAdi nityOtsavAnanditam
lines.meaning: delighting in the daily festivals such as the lakshadipam offered by the faultless king of Vanchi,

lines.text: sarasIruhOdara palAshAyatAkSi puTa paripUrNa karuNamrtam
lines.meaning: his eyes, long as the petals of the lotus from his navel, brimming with the nectar of compassion —

lines.text: padmanAbham
lines.meaning: Padmanabha.

songs.title: dEva dEva kalayAmi
songs.summary: O God of gods, I contemplate the service of your lotus feet — Swati Tirunal's prayer to Padmanabha.

lines.text: dEva dEva kalayAmi tE caraNAmbuja sEvanam
lines.meaning: O God of gods, I contemplate the service of your lotus feet.

lines.text: bhuvanatraya nAyaka bhUri karuNayA mama
lines.meaning: Lord of the three worlds, with abundant compassion, my

lines.text: bhavatApamAkhilam vAraya ramA kAnta
lines.meaning: worldly anguish, all of it, remove, beloved of Lakshmi.

lines.text: parama hamsALigEya pavitratara ghOra duraita carita dinamanu shravaNa nirata-
lines.meaning: Sung by the hosts of great ascetics, whose holy story destroys terrible sins, for those devoted to hearing it daily,

lines.text: pari jananikara kAmitArtha paripUraNa lOlupa bhUri manOjnapAnga
lines.meaning: eager to fulfil the desires of such people, with a most charming glance,

lines.text: vAraNa dussahAryi vAraNa bahu nipuNa puruhutAmara pUjita bhavya caraNayuga
lines.meaning: most skilled in removing the elephant's unbearable foe, whose blessed feet are worshipped by Indra and the gods,

lines.text: viracaya shubhamayi vishadanAbhijAta bhAratisha krtanuti
lines.meaning: grant good; praised by Brahma, born of your lotus navel, and Sarasvati,

lines.text: parama tuSta bhagavAn
lines.meaning: supremely pleased Lord,

lines.text: jAtarUpa nibhacEla janmArcitam mamAkhila pAtaka sancayamiha vAraya karuNaya
lines.meaning: clad in garments like gold, worshipped since birth — remove here all the heap of my sins, with compassion,

lines.text: ditijALi vidaLana dInabandhO mAmava shrta vibudha sAla shrI
lines.meaning: destroyer of the hosts of demons, friend of the humble, protect me, wish-tree to the wise who seek refuge, Sri

lines.text: padmanAbha shaurE
lines.meaning: Padmanabha, Shauri.

songs.title: krpayA pAlaya
songs.summary: Protect me with compassion, Shauri (Padmanabha), ship across the ocean of worldly life.

lines.text: krpayA pAlaya shaurE karuNA rasAvAsa kaluSArtti virAma
lines.meaning: Protect me with compassion, Shauri, abode of the essence of mercy, ender of sin and suffering,

lines.text: tapanIya nibhacEla tuhinAmshu su-vadana shrI padmanAbha sarasija lOcana
lines.meaning: clad in gold, with a fair moon-like face, Sri Padmanabha, lotus-eyed,

lines.text: amara nikara cAru hEma mauLi rAjita tAmarasa ghana mada dAraNa caNa pAda
lines.meaning: whose lotus feet shine with the lovely golden crowns of the gods, skilled in crushing great pride,

lines.text: vimala bhakti lOlupa sama sEvakAkhila kAma dAna nirata kamanIya tarApAnga
lines.meaning: eager for pure devotion, ever ready to grant every desire to all who serve alike, with a most lovely glance,

lines.text: kunda dyuti lasita mandahAsa ruci nandita nuti para brndAraka sancaya
lines.meaning: with a gentle smile shining like jasmine, delighting the hosts of gods intent on praise,

lines.text: vandAru samudaya mandAra paramAravinda sAyaka sama sundarAnga bhAsita
lines.meaning: wish-tree to those who bow, of a form as beautiful as Manmatha's,

lines.text: kuru mE kushalam mudA kuruvinda nibha danta nirupama samsAra nIradhi varapOta
lines.meaning: grant me well-being joyfully, with teeth like rubies, the fine ship across the matchless ocean of worldly life,

lines.text: nArada mukha muni nikara gEya carita vAraya mamAkhila pApajAtam bhagavan
lines.meaning: whose story is sung by Narada and hosts of sages — remove all my sins, Lord.

songs.title: sAramaina
songs.summary: A padam in which the heroine teases her lord: enough of your sweet words!

lines.text: sAramaina mATalanda cAlu cAlu rA
lines.meaning: Enough, enough of all these sweet-sounding words!

lines.text: sArasAkSa mImentO santOSamu mElu
lines.meaning: Lotus-eyed one, how pleased you are — how fine!

lines.text: sOmuDu daya mAyanEmi sudatiki mahA bhAgya mAyanE kAmakOTi
lines.meaning: Has the moon turned kind? It has become great fortune for that woman, O lovely one;

lines.text: sundara mA bhAgya miTulAyanE
lines.meaning: so this is how our fortune has turned out, handsome one!

lines.text: manavi vinara sAmi ninnu nammiyunnAnu marEmi ghanuDaina
lines.meaning: Listen to my plea, Lord; I have trusted you; what more, O great one

lines.text: shESuNivai velayu shrI padmanAbha
lines.meaning: who shines on Shesha, Sri Padmanabha?

songs.title: alarshara paritApam (mp)
songs.summary: A Malayalam padam: a heroine tells her friend of the torment of love as evening falls and her beloved Padmanabha does not come.

lines.text: alarshara paritApam colvatin-nalivEni pANi bAlE
lines.meaning: Friend with curling hair, how can I tell you the anguish caused by the flower-arrowed (Kama)?

lines.text: jalaja bandhuvumiha jaladhiyilaNa yunnu malayamArutamETTu mama manamatitarAm bata vivashamAyi sakhi
lines.meaning: The sun has sunk into the ocean; the Malaya breeze — alas, my mind is utterly overwhelmed, friend.

lines.text: valarunnu hrdi mOhennOmalE taLarunnu mama dEham kaLamoLi
lines.meaning: Longing grows in my heart; my body grows weak, O sweet-voiced one;

lines.text: kusuma vATikayatiluLa vAyoraLi kulAravamatiha kELpatu madhi kAmadhini dAnamayi sakhi
lines.meaning: in the flower garden, the humming of the bees — hearing it, desire grows in my mind, friend.

lines.text: shashyum cenkanalAyi samprati sUna sharaNummE ripuvAyi shashadharanErmukhi
lines.meaning: Even the moon has now become burning embers; the flower-arrowed one has become my enemy, O moon-faced one;

lines.text: sarasanODini melle bhrshAtayatAmmAm akhila shucamAyE kathayAshu sudati nI
lines.meaning: the chatter of the parrot pains me greatly — tell me quickly, lovely one,

lines.text: jaladhara sadrsha sObhanenkAntan shrI jalajAkSanabja nAbhan kalayati kimu kOpam
lines.meaning: is my beloved, beautiful as a rain cloud, lotus-eyed, lotus-navelled, angry with me?

lines.text: kAruNya veTinjnyuLLilamalam bata tAmasEna kimiha jAvanmama sAdhayEpsitam
lines.meaning: Alas, his heart is full of compassion — why this coolness now? Fulfil my wish quickly.

songs.title: shankara shrIgiri
songs.summary: A Hindi song describing Shiva, lord of Srigiri, dancing in the hall to the sound of drums.

lines.text: shankara shrIgiri nAtha prabhukE nrtta virAjita citrasa bhAmE
lines.meaning: Shankara, lord of Srigiri, the Lord, shining in dance in the wondrous hall,

lines.text: bhasma trinEtra khalE ruNDamAlA bhUtanakE sanga nAcata bhrngI
lines.meaning: smeared with ash, three-eyed, wearing a garland of skulls; with him dance Bhringi and the ganas.

lines.text: tvanana tanana nanana ghumgu bAjE dEva munI sabha gagana virAjE
lines.meaning: 'tvanana tanana nanana' sound the drums; the gods and sages shine in assembly in the sky;

lines.text: dhrukuTaddhIm tadhIm tAdhIdhrunna bAjE kOTamayanajA
lines.meaning: 'dhrukuta dhim tadhim' resound the drums;

lines.text: tA tai takiTa taka shruti gati rAjE padmanAbha mana kamala virAjE
lines.meaning: 'ta tai takita taka' — the rhythm shines in the beat; he shines in the lotus of Padmanabha's heart.

songs.title: mAmavasadA jananI
songs.summary: Protect me always, Mother, slayer of Mahishasura, younger sister of Padmanabha.

lines.text: mAmava sadA janani mahiSAsura sUdani (amba) caraNam 1 caraNam 2 caraNam 3
lines.meaning: Protect me always, Mother, slayer of Mahishasura.

lines.text: sOma bimba manOhara sumukhi sEvakAkhila kAma dAna nirata kaTAkSa vilAsini (amba)
lines.meaning: Lovely as the moon's orb, fair-faced, ever granting all desires to those who serve, with playful glance (Mother),

lines.text: pura vimata vadana pankEruha madhupE nArada mukha maunI nikara gEya caritE
lines.meaning: bee to the lotus face of Shiva, whose story is sung by Narada and hosts of sages,

lines.text: SarasIruhAsanAdi sura samudaya maNi cAru mauLi virAjita caraNAmbuja yugaLE
lines.meaning: whose lotus feet shine with the lovely jewelled crowns of Brahma and the hosts of gods,

lines.text: kanaka bhAsura divya kalApa rAjita gAtri vanaruha daLa darpa vibhanjana ruci nEtri
lines.meaning: whose body shines with radiant gold and divine ornaments, whose eyes humble the pride of lotus petals,

lines.text: munigaNa sammOhana mAnanIya mrduhAsE vinata jana kalpakavallari giri sutE
lines.meaning: with a gentle, gracious smile that enchants the sages, wish-creeper to those who bow, daughter of the mountain,

lines.text: kuru mE kushalam sadA kamalanAbhAnujE niravadhi bhava khEda nivAraNa niratE
lines.meaning: grant me well-being always, younger sister of Padmanabha, ever intent on removing the sorrows of worldly life,

lines.text: cArunUtana ghana sadrusha rAjita vENi dAruNa danujALi dAraNa paTucaritE
lines.meaning: with a braid lovely as a fresh rain cloud, skilled in destroying the hosts of fierce demons.

songs.title: vishvEshvara darshana
songs.summary: A Hindi song on the darshan of Vishveshvara at Kashi, where the Ganga flows like milk.

lines.text: vishvEshvara darsan jab kInhO bahu prEma sahit
lines.meaning: When I had the darshan of Vishveshvara with great love,

lines.text: kATi karuNa nidhAn janan maraNa phAsI
lines.meaning: the treasure of compassion cut the noose of birth and death.

lines.text: bahtI jinkI purI mO gangA pay kE samAn vA kE taT ghAt ghAt bhar rahE sanyAsI
lines.meaning: In his city flows the Ganga, like milk; on its banks, at every ghat, sannyasins throng.

lines.text: bhasma ang bhuj trishUl ur mE lasE nAg mAl girijA ardhang dharE tribhuvan jin dAsI
lines.meaning: Ash on his limbs, trident in hand, a garland of serpents shining on his chest, Girija as half his body — the three worlds are his servants.

lines.text: padmanAbh kamalanayan trinayan shambhu mahEsh bhaj lE in dO svarUp rahiyE avinAshI
lines.meaning: Lotus-navelled, lotus-eyed (Vishnu), and three-eyed Shambhu Mahesha — worship these two forms and become immortal.

songs.title: rAma rAma guNasImA
songs.summary: Rama, boundary of all virtues — dwell always in my heart.

lines.text: rAma rAma guNasImA rAma hrdayAbhirAma sitA
lines.meaning: Rama, Rama, boundary of virtues, Rama, delight of the heart, (Lord of) Sita,

lines.text: sOmAnana ghanashyAma hEmAmbarAri virAma
lines.meaning: moon-faced, dark as a cloud, clad in gold, slayer of enemies,

lines.text: vAsava mukha dEva vandyamAna caraNa vasa mE hrdi sadA vAraNa mOhanagatE
lines.meaning: whose feet are worshipped by Indra and the gods, dwell always in my heart, with enchanting elephant-like gait,

lines.text: bhASita hEmakalpa pATita khalATOpa nAshita samsAra tApa nayana bharita krpa
lines.meaning: who broke the pride of the wicked, destroyer of the anguish of worldly life, with eyes full of compassion,

lines.text: pLavaga samudAya parivrta kalaya vibhO mama kushalam dinamanu
lines.meaning: surrounded by hosts of monkeys, Lord, grant me well-being every day,

lines.text: nav amaNimaya hAra nIradhi madahara bhavasaridIshapAra bhUsuri sundarAkAra
lines.meaning: with a necklace of new gems, who humbled the ocean's pride, who crossed the ocean, of beautiful form,

lines.text: dInabandhO mAmava dashamukha vidaLana vinata kalpatarO vArija nAbha rUpa
lines.meaning: friend of the humble, protect me, destroyer of the ten-headed one, wish-tree to those who bow, in the form of Padmanabha,

lines.text: muni mAnasa dhAma mrgamada sulalAma vanijApAnga sudAma vaidEhi sakAma
lines.meaning: dwelling in the hearts of sages, with a lovely musk tilaka, with a forest garland, beloved of Vaidehi.

songs.title: shrI kumAra nagarAlayE
songs.summary: A hymn to the goddess of Kumarakoil (Sri Kumaranagara), describing her beauty.

lines.text: shrI kumAra nagarAlayE karuNAlayE kamalAlayE
lines.meaning: O dweller in Sri Kumaranagara, abode of compassion, abode of Lakshmi,

lines.text: shrtajana kalpaka pAdapE shrI padmanAbha vadanAmbuja madhupE
lines.meaning: wish-tree to those who seek refuge, bee to the lotus face of Sri Padmanabha,

lines.text: manju ramaNita nUpurE karashincita kankaNa bhAsurE
lines.meaning: with lovely tinkling anklets, radiant with jingling bracelets on your hands,

lines.text: manjuLAnana sudhAkarE nava kanjadaLa kalita vilasita cikurE
lines.meaning: with a lovely moon-like face, with hair adorned with fresh lotus petals,

lines.text: anjanAncita drugancala bhanjita ganjanad-vidya manjimapunjE
lines.meaning: whose kohl-dark glances are a mass of beauty,

lines.text: niranjanAshaya nikunja kELi rasikE ava mrgamada tilakE
lines.meaning: pure-hearted one, delighting in play in the bower, protect me, with a musk tilaka,

lines.text: kambu vara sadrsha kandarE jagadamba pAlita vasundharE
lines.meaning: with a neck like the noble conch, Mother of the world, protector of the earth,

lines.text: bimba phala rucirAdharE lOlambajAla ruci vilasita cikurE
lines.meaning: with lips lovely as bimba fruit, with hair shining like swarms of bees,

lines.text: amba kaccavi viTambita daLada sitAmbuja dyuti kadamba kaDambarE
lines.meaning: Mother, whose radiance mocks clusters of white lotuses,

lines.text: shambarAri hari shambarArcitapadE pada natajana shubhadE
lines.meaning: whose feet are worshipped by Shiva, Vishnu and Manmatha, giver of good to those who bow at your feet,

lines.text: manda gamana jita vAraNE susura vrndavairi vinivAraNE
lines.meaning: whose slow gait outdoes the elephant, who repels the enemies of the gods,

lines.text: indirE bhuvana kAraNE kuruvinda danti kisalaya mrdu caraNE
lines.meaning: Indira, cause of the worlds, with teeth like rubies, with tender sprout-like feet,

lines.text: manda hAsa ruci ninditEndu kara kunda vrnda makaranda bindu
lines.meaning: whose gentle smile shames the moon's rays, lovely as clusters of jasmine and drops of honey,

lines.text: sandOha samvalita sundarAmbujajAsyE jagadupAsyE
lines.meaning: lotus-faced, worshipped by the world.

songs.title: dEvi jagajjanani
songs.summary: A hymn to Sarasvati, Mother of the world, holding the veena and book — sung during Navaratri.

lines.text: dEvi jagajjanai dEvi krpayAmama tAvaka caraNa bhaktim
lines.meaning: Goddess, Mother of the world, Goddess, grant me with grace devotion to your feet,

lines.text: dEva makuTamaNI dEdipyamAnapAdE kEvalAnandapUrNE kIrasuvANi vANi
lines.meaning: whose feet shine with the jewels of the gods' crowns, full of pure bliss, with a parrot's sweet speech, Vani,

lines.text: vINA pustakaranjita karatalaviha sitakanjavarEmbikE
lines.meaning: whose palms shine with the veena and book, seated on a fine white lotus, Mother,

lines.text: vENI manjimapunjavi nirjita vitataghana ghanamAlikE
lines.meaning: whose lovely braid surpasses the spreading rain clouds,

lines.text: ENImadavini vAraNa nipuNa tArEkSaNa hrtana tapAtakE
lines.meaning: with eyes like a doe's, skilled in removing (suffering), who takes away the sins of those who bow,

lines.text: shAnOllIDa mahAmaNi bhUSaNa shAlini budhajana pAlikE
lines.meaning: shining with great jewelled ornaments, protector of the wise,

lines.text: prINitamuni druhiNajAyE paramamEye nirapAyE
lines.meaning: consort of Brahma, pleasing the sages, supreme, beyond measure, imperishable,

lines.text: sakala kalAlaya shAradA himakara sadrsha vilAsayutAnanE
lines.meaning: abode of all arts, Sharada, with a face lovely as the moon,

lines.text: makara varAnka sharAsana maurvi mahita tarALaka mOhanE
lines.meaning: enchanting with brows like Manmatha's bow and its string,

lines.text: shuka sanakAdi munIshvara viracita sundara padayuga pUjanE
lines.meaning: whose beautiful feet are worshipped by Shuka, Sanaka and the great sages,

lines.text: vikaTa jaTAlasitEnDu kalApini vimala sarOja varAsanE
lines.meaning: wearing the moon on matted locks, seated on a pure lotus,

lines.text: vikaca kamalapAdE vihatabhEdE nihatakhEdE
lines.meaning: with feet like blooming lotuses, beyond difference, who has destroyed sorrow,

lines.text: jyOtirmaya navahArAyita sajjyOti shatantra vibhUSitE
lines.meaning: adorned with luminous new necklaces and a girdle of a hundred strands of light,

lines.text: mAtarmEdura mImAmsAgamAmam silitOruyugAncitE
lines.meaning: Mother, adorned by the Mimamsa and the Agamas,

lines.text: cEtOharatara shabda gamakAnci latikA gunashObhitE
lines.meaning: shining with the virtues of the creeper of captivating sound and gamaka,

lines.text: pAtakahara padmAdi purANapADitapaNi virajitE
lines.meaning: shining with the Padma and other Puranas, praised in song,

lines.text: vItashamala hrdyE kalita vidyE trijagadAdyE nIravAdyE
lines.meaning: pure-hearted, possessed of knowledge, first of the three worlds, faultless,

lines.text: aruNa tarAdhara parlia sadati mrduha sitadyutIpaTalOjvalE
lines.meaning: with lips redder than coral, shining with a gentle white smile,

lines.text: sharaNa samAgata jana paripAlana satatOdyata karuNAkulE
lines.meaning: full of compassion, ever ready to protect those who come for refuge,

lines.text: parijana viracita nava ratrOtsava paritOSita hrdayEmalE
lines.meaning: whose heart is delighted by the Navaratri festival performed by devotees, pure one,

lines.text: kuru kAruNyamayi bhajanaparE mayi kunda mukuLaradanEtulE
lines.meaning: show compassion to me who worship you, with teeth like jasmine buds,

lines.text: bhUri shubhakarANi aghaha rANi nutiparANi karavANi
lines.meaning: giver of abundant good, queen who removes sin, delighting in praise.

songs.title: jagadOddhAraNA
songs.summary: Purandaradasa marvels that Yashoda played with the uplifter of the world as her own child.

lines.text: jagadOddhAraNa ADisidaLe yashOde
lines.meaning: Yashoda played with the uplifter of the world.

lines.text: jagadOddhAraNa maganendu tiLiyuta suguNAnta ranganA AdisidaLe yashOde
lines.meaning: Thinking him her son, Yashoda played with the uplifter of the world, the abode of virtues, Ranga.

lines.text: nigamakE silukada agaNita mahimana magugaLa mANikyana ADisidaLa yashOde
lines.meaning: Yashoda played with the one of countless glories whom even the Vedas cannot grasp, the ruby among children.

lines.text: aNOraNIyana mahatO mahImana apramEyana na ADisidaLa yashOde
lines.meaning: Yashoda played with the one subtler than the atom, greater than the great, immeasurable.

lines.text: parama puruSana paravAsudEvana purandara viThalana ADisidaLu yashOde
lines.meaning: Yashoda played with the Supreme Person, Paravasudeva, Purandara Vitthala.

songs.title: bhAgyada lakSmI
songs.summary: Purandaradasa invites Lakshmi, goddess of fortune, to come with tinkling anklets into the homes of devotees.

lines.text: bhAgyada lakSmI bAramma nammamma nI saubhAgyada lakSmI bAramma
lines.meaning: Come, Lakshmi of fortune, our Mother; come, Lakshmi of good fortune.

lines.text: hejjaya mElE hejya nikkuda gejje kAlgaLa dhvaniya mADuda
lines.meaning: Step by step, with your anklet bells ringing,

lines.text: sajjana sAdhu pUjeya vELake majjigeyoLagiNa beNNeyante
lines.meaning: at the time of worship by good and saintly people, like butter rising from buttermilk,

lines.text: kanaka vrSTiya kareyuta bArE manake mAnava siddiyu tOre
lines.meaning: come showering gold; reveal fulfilment to people's minds,

lines.text: dinakara kOTi tEjati hoLeyuva janaka rAyana kumAri bEga
lines.meaning: shining with the radiance of ten million suns, daughter of King Janaka — come quickly.

lines.text: attittagalade bhaktara maneyali nitya mahOtsava nitya sumaNgaLa
lines.meaning: Without leaving, (stay) in the homes of devotees — daily great festivals, daily auspiciousness;

lines.text: satyava tOruva sAdhu sajjanara cittadi hoLeyuva puttaLi bombe
lines.meaning: doll who shines in the minds of true and saintly people,

lines.text: sankhyeyillada bhAgyava koTTu kankaNa kayya tiruvuta bAre
lines.meaning: giving countless fortunes, come turning the bangles on your hands,
