lines.text: kunkumAnkite pankaja lOcana venkaTaramaNana binkada rANi
lines.meaning: marked with kumkum, lotus-eyed, proud queen of Venkataramana,

lines.text: sakkare tuppa kAluve harisi shukra vArada pUjeya vELage
lines.meaning: making rivers of sugar and ghee flow, at the time of the Friday worship,

lines.text: akkaravuLLa aLagiri rangana sokka purandara viTTana rANi
lines.meaning: beloved of Alagiri Ranga, queen of beautiful Purandara Vitthala.

songs.title: gajavadanA bEDuvE
songs.summary: Purandaradasa prays to Ganesha, son of Gauri, for the grace to always remember Vitthala.

lines.text: gajavadhanaa bEduvE gowri thanaya
lines.meaning: Elephant-faced one, I pray to you, son of Gauri,

lines.text: trijaga vanditanE sujanara porevanE
lines.meaning: worshipped by the three worlds, protector of good people,

lines.text: pAshAnkushadhara parama pavitra
lines.meaning: bearer of the noose and goad, supremely holy,

lines.text: mooshikavAhana munijanaprEmA
lines.meaning: rider of the mouse, beloved of the sages.

lines.text: mOdadi ninnaya pAdava tOrO
lines.meaning: Joyfully show me your feet,

lines.text: sAdhu vanditane Adaradindali
lines.meaning: O one worshipped by the good, with affection;

lines.text: sarsijanAbha shri purandara vithalana
lines.meaning: bless me so that I always remember Purandara Vitthala,

lines.text: niruta neneyuvante daya mADO
lines.meaning: the lotus-navelled Lord — have mercy.

songs.title: venkaTAcalanilayam
songs.summary: A hymn to Venkateshvara of Tirumala, recalling his deeds as Krishna and Rama.

lines.text: vEnkaTAcala nilayam vaikuNTha puravAsam
lines.meaning: (I worship) the dweller on Venkatachala, the dweller in Vaikuntha,

lines.text: pankaja nEtram parama pavitram shankha cakradhara cinmaya rUpam (venkaTAcala)
lines.meaning: lotus-eyed, supremely holy, holding conch and discus, of the form of pure consciousness,

lines.text: ambujOtbhava vinutam agaNita guNanAmam
lines.meaning: praised by lotus-born Brahma, of countless virtues and names,

lines.text: tumburu nArada gAnavilOlam ambudhi shayanam AtmAbhirAmam
lines.meaning: who delights in the music of Tumburu and Narada, who reclines on the ocean, delight of the soul,

lines.text: pAhi pANDava pakSam kaurava madaharaNam bAhu
lines.meaning: who took the Pandavas' side, destroyer of the Kauravas' pride, whose arms'

lines.text: parAkrama pUrNam ahalyA shApa bhaya nivAranam
lines.meaning: valour is complete, who removed the fear of Ahalya's curse,

lines.text: sakala vEda vicAram sarva jIva nikaram
lines.meaning: the essence of all the Vedas, (dwelling in) all living beings,

lines.text: makara kuNDaladhara madana gOpAlam
lines.meaning: wearing makara earrings, Madana Gopala,

lines.text: bhakta pOSaka shrI purandara viTTalam
lines.meaning: nurturer of devotees, Sri Purandara Vitthala.

songs.title: rAma mantrava (version 2)
songs.summary: Chant the Rama mantra — it is the essence of the Vedas and the root of the path to liberation.

lines.text: rAma mantrava japiso hE manuja
lines.meaning: Chant the Rama mantra, O man.

lines.text: A mantra I mantra necci nI keDabEDa sOmashEkhara tanna bhAmini korediha
lines.meaning: Don't ruin yourself trusting this mantra and that; it is the one Shiva taught his wife.

lines.text: snAna maunangaLige sdhanada mantra mAnvaru manadi dhyAniya mantra
lines.meaning: The mantra that perfects bathing and silence; the mantra men meditate on in their minds;

lines.text: hIna guNangaLa hiskisutiha mantra Enembe vibhISaNage sAravinibha mantra
lines.meaning: the mantra that drives away base qualities; what to say — the mantra that was the essence for Vibhishana;

lines.text: sakala vEdagaLige sAravinibha mantra mukuti mArgakke idE mUla mantra
lines.meaning: the mantra that is the essence of all the Vedas, the root mantra on the path to liberation,

lines.text: bhakuti rasage ommebaTTe tOruva mantra sukhanidhi purandara viTTalana mahA mantra
lines.meaning: the mantra that at once reveals the taste of devotion, the great mantra of Purandara Vitthala, treasure of bliss.

songs.title: tambUri mITTidava
songs.summary: Purandaradasa on the power of music: whoever plays, keeps time and sings reaches Hari.

lines.text: tambUri mITTidava bhavAdi dATTidava tALava taTTidava suraroLu sEridava
lines.meaning: He who plucked the tambura crossed the ocean of worldly life; he who kept the tala joined the gods;

lines.text: gejjaya kaTTidava kaLaredeya meTTidava gAyana pADidava harimUruti nODidava
lines.meaning: he who tied on the ankle bells trampled sin; he who sang beheld the form of Hari;

lines.text: viThalana nODidava (purandara) vaikuNThake ODidava
lines.meaning: he who saw Purandara Vitthala ran straight to Vaikuntha.

songs.title: nArAyaNA ninna nAmada
songs.summary: Purandaradasa prays that the nectar of Narayana's name be on his tongue in every state of life — and above all at the final moment.

lines.text: nArAyaNA ninna nAmada smaraNeya sArAmrtavenna nAligege barali
lines.meaning: Narayana, may the nectar of remembering your name come to my tongue,

lines.text: kUDuvAgali nintADuvAgali matte hADuvAgali haridAguvAgali
lines.meaning: whether sitting or standing, singing or lying down,

lines.text: khOTi vinOdadi nOdade nA balu mADida pApa biTTOTi hOgO hAge
lines.meaning: so that the heaps of sins I have committed run away —

lines.text: UrigE hOgali UroLagirali kAraNArtangaLella kAdirali
lines.meaning: whether I go to another village or stay in my own, whatever my needs may be,

lines.text: vArija nAbha nara sArathi sannuta sAri sArigE nA bEsaradhAge
lines.meaning: O lotus-navelled one, charioteer of Arjuna, praised by all — so that I never tire of it, time after time;

lines.text: hasividdAgali hasivilladAgali rasakasi irali haruSirali
lines.meaning: whether hungry or not, whether in delight or in joy,

lines.text: vasudEvAtmaka shishupAlakSaya asurAntaka ninna hesaru mareyadhAgE
lines.meaning: O Vasudeva, destroyer of Shishupala, slayer of demons — so that I never forget your name;

lines.text: kaSTadallirali utkrSTadallirali eSTAdare matikeTTirali
lines.meaning: whether in hardship or in prosperity, however confused my mind may be,

lines.text: krSna krSNa endu shiSyaru pELuva aSTAkSara mahA mantrada nAmava
lines.meaning: (the name) of the great eight-syllable mantra, as disciples say 'Krishna, Krishna';

lines.text: kanasiLoLAgali kanavaLikAgali manasu koTTirali munidirali
lines.meaning: whether dreaming or waking, whether my mind is willing or angry,

lines.text: janakajApati ninna caraNa kamalavanu manasiLoLage omme nenesikoLLO hAge
lines.meaning: Lord of Janaka's daughter, so that I remember your lotus feet in my mind at least once;

lines.text: jvara bandAgali caLi bandAgali maraLi maraLi mattE naDuguvAgAgali
lines.meaning: whether fever comes or cold, whether I shiver again and again,

lines.text: hari nArAyaNa durita nivAraNanendu iruLu hagalu ninna smarane mareyadhAge
lines.meaning: so that night and day I never forget to remember you as Hari Narayana, remover of sins;

lines.text: santata hari ninna sAsira nAmavu antarangada oLagirisi
lines.meaning: always keeping your thousand names, Hari, within my heart,

lines.text: entO purandara viTTala rAyane antya kAladalli cintisOhAgE
lines.meaning: O Purandara Vitthala, my king — so that I think of you at the final moment.

songs.title: bhAvamulOna
songs.summary: Annamacharya: within and without, worship Govinda — Hari's names are all the mantras, and Vishnu is everything.

lines.text: bhAvamulOna bAhyamulanduna gOvindA gOvindA ani koluvavO manasA
lines.meaning: Within your thoughts and outwardly, worship saying 'Govinda, Govinda', O mind.

lines.text: hari avatAramulE akhila dEvatalu hari lOni vE brahmANDambulu
lines.meaning: Hari's incarnations are all the gods; the universes are within Hari;

lines.text: hari nAmamulE anni mantramulu hari hari hari hari anavO manasA
lines.meaning: Hari's names are all the mantras — say 'Hari Hari Hari Hari', O mind.

lines.text: viSNuni mahimalE vihita karmamulu viSNuni pogaDeDi vEdambulu
lines.meaning: Vishnu's glories are the prescribed duties; the Vedas are what praise Vishnu;

lines.text: viSNudokkadE vishvAntarAdamuDu viSNuvu viSNuvani vedakavO manasA
lines.meaning: Vishnu alone is within the universe — seek 'Vishnu, Vishnu', O mind.

lines.text: acyutuDitadE Adiyu antyamu acyutudE asurAntakuDu
lines.meaning: Achyuta alone is the beginning and the end; Achyuta is the slayer of demons;

lines.text: acyutuDu shrI venkatAdri mIdanitE acyutA acyutA sharaNavO manasA
lines.meaning: Achyuta is on Sri Venkatadri — take refuge, saying 'Achyuta, Achyuta', O mind.

songs.title: nArAyaNa tE namO namO
songs.summary: Annamacharya's salutations to Narayana, the Lord of Venkata.

lines.text: nArayaNa tE namO namO (bhava)
lines.meaning: Narayana, salutations, salutations to you,

lines.text: nArada sannuta namO namO
lines.meaning: praised by Narada — salutations, salutations.

lines.text: murahara naghadhara mukunda mAdhava garuDa gamana pankaja nAbhA
lines.meaning: Slayer of Mura, bearer of the mountain, Mukunda, Madhava, rider of Garuda, lotus-navelled,

lines.text: parama puruSa bhava bandhanathE (namO) naramruka sharIra namO namO (namO)
lines.meaning: Supreme Person, releaser from worldly bonds — salutations; you who took the man-lion's form — salutations, salutations.

lines.text: jaladhi shayana ravicandra vilOcana jalaruha bhavanuta caraNayugA
lines.meaning: Reclining on the ocean, with sun and moon as eyes, whose feet are praised by lotus-born Brahma,

lines.text: bhali bandhana gOpavadhU vallabha nalinOttara tE namO namO (namO)
lines.meaning: binder of Bali, beloved of the cowherd women, lotus-eyed — salutations, salutations to you.

lines.text: Adi dEva sakalAgama pUjita yAdava kula mOhanarUpA
lines.meaning: First God, worshipped by all the Agamas, enchanting form of the Yadava clan,

lines.text: vEdOdhara tiru venkaTanAyaka nAda priya tE namO namO (namO) --
lines.meaning: rescuer of the Vedas, Lord of holy Venkata, lover of music — salutations, salutations to you.

songs.title: shrIman nArAyaNa
songs.summary: Annamacharya takes refuge at the holy feet of Sriman Narayana, the god of the Venkata hill.

lines.text: shrIman nArAyaNa shrIman nArAyaNa
lines.meaning: Sriman Narayana, Sriman Narayana,

lines.text: shrIman nArAyaNa nI shrIpAdame sharaNu
lines.meaning: Sriman Narayana, your holy feet are my refuge.

lines.text: kamalAsati mukhakamala kamalahita
lines.meaning: Sun to the lotus face of Lakshmi, friend of the lotus,

lines.text: kamalapriya kamalekShaNA
lines.meaning: dear to Lakshmi, lotus-eyed,

lines.text: kamalAsanahita garu.dagamana shrI
lines.meaning: dear to lotus-seated Brahma, rider of Garuda, Sri

lines.text: kamalanAbha nI padakamalame sharaNu
lines.meaning: lotus-navelled one — your lotus feet are my refuge.

lines.text: parama yogijana bhAgadheya shrI
lines.meaning: Fortune of the great yogis, Sri

lines.text: paramapuruShA parAtparA
lines.meaning: Supreme Person, higher than the highest,

lines.text: paramAtmA paramANurUpa shrI
lines.meaning: Supreme Self, subtle as the atom, Sri

lines.text: tiruveN^kaTagiridevA sharaNu
lines.meaning: God of holy Venkata hill — you are my refuge.

songs.title: adivO alladivO
songs.summary: Annamacharya points out the sacred Venkata hill: 'There it is — the abode of Hari!'

lines.text: adivO alladivO shree harivaasamu
lines.meaning: There it is, behold — the abode of Sri Hari,

lines.text: padivElu sEshula paDagalamayamu
lines.meaning: full of the hoods of the ten thousand Sheshas.

lines.text: ade vEnkaTaacala makhilOnnatamu
lines.meaning: That is Venkatachala, highest of all;

lines.text: adivO brahmaadula kapuroopamu
lines.meaning: there it is, the form (worshipped by) Brahma and the others;

lines.text: adivO nitya nivaasa makhila munulaku
lines.meaning: there it is, the eternal home of all sages —

lines.text: adhE cooDu DadE mokkuDaanandamayamu
lines.meaning: see it, bow to it; it is full of bliss.

lines.text: cengaTa nalladivO sEshaacalamu
lines.meaning: There nearby is Seshachala,

lines.text: ninginunna dEvatala nijavaasamu
lines.meaning: the true home of the gods in the sky;

lines.text: mungiTa nalladivO moolanunna dhanamu
lines.meaning: there in front is the treasure stored from the beginning,

lines.text: bhangaaru sikharaala bahu brahmmamayamu
lines.meaning: golden peaks, full of Brahman.

lines.text: kaivalyapadamu vEnkaTanaga madivO
lines.meaning: That Venkata mountain is the state of liberation,

lines.text: shree vEnkaTapatiki sirulainati
lines.meaning: the wealth of Sri Venkatapati;

lines.text: bhaavimpa sakala sampadaroopa madivO
lines.meaning: to contemplate, it is the form of all riches;

lines.text: paavanamula kella baavanamayamu
lines.meaning: it is the purest of all that purifies.

songs.title: muddugArE yashOda
songs.summary: Annamacharya describes the child Krishna as each of the nine gems.

lines.text: MuddugAre YasodA mungiti muthyamuvidu
lines.meaning: Yashoda's darling, the pearl in her front yard,

lines.text: DidderAni mahimala Devaki suthudu
lines.meaning: is Devaki's son, of unequalled glory;

lines.text: Anthanintha gollethala arachethi mAnikyamu
lines.meaning: the ruby in the palms of the cowherd women everywhere,

lines.text: PanthamAdey Kamsuni pAli vajramu
lines.meaning: the diamond against Kamsa, who held a grudge,

lines.text: KAnthula moodu lokAla Garudapachapoosa
lines.meaning: the emerald that lights the three worlds,

lines.text: Chenthala mAlonunna Chinni Krishnudu
lines.meaning: little Krishna who lives among us,

lines.text: ratikeli rukminiki rangumovi pagadamu
lines.meaning: the coral of Rukmini's lips in love-play,

lines.text: mithi gOvardhanapu Gomedikamu
lines.meaning: the hessonite of Govardhana hill,

lines.text: sathamye SankhachakrAla sandula vaidooryamu
lines.meaning: the cat's-eye between the conch and discus,

lines.text: gathiyai mammu gAche KamalAkshudu
lines.meaning: the lotus-eyed one who is our refuge and protects us,

lines.text: kAlinguni talapye gappina pushyarAgamu
lines.meaning: the topaz that pressed down on Kaliya's head,

lines.text: yelleti Sri VenkatAdri Indraneelamu
lines.meaning: the sapphire of Sri Venkatadri,

lines.text: pAlajalanidhilona bAyani Divya ratnamu
lines.meaning: the divine gem never parted from the milk ocean —

lines.text: bAluneevale dhrigi PadmanAbhudu
lines.meaning: Padmanabha, who looks just like a little boy.

songs.title: bhAvayAmi gOpAlabAlam
songs.summary: A Sanskrit song meditating on the child Gopala dancing with his bells and holding butter.

lines.text: bhAvayAmi gOpAlabAlam manas-sEvitam tatpadam cintayEyam sadA
lines.meaning: I meditate on the child Gopala, served by the mind; may I always contemplate his feet,

lines.text: ghaTi ghaTita mEkhalA kacitamaNi khaNDikA paTala nina dEna viprAjamAnam
lines.meaning: shining with the jingling of his belt of tiny bells and gem-studded ornaments,

lines.text: kuTila pada khaTita samkula simjitE natam caTula naTanA samujvala vilAsam
lines.meaning: bowing to the tinkle of his crooked steps, brilliant in his lively dance,

lines.text: niratakara kalita navanItam brahmAdi sura nikara bhAvanA shObhita padam
lines.meaning: with butter always in his hand, whose feet shine in the contemplation of Brahma and the gods,

lines.text: tiruvEnkaTAcala stitam anupam harim parama puruSam gOpAlabAlam
lines.meaning: dwelling on holy Venkatachala, the incomparable Hari, the Supreme Person, the child Gopala.

songs.title: alai pAyudE
songs.summary: A gopi describes how her mind sways like waves at the sound of Krishna's flute.

lines.text: alai pAyudE kaNNA en manam migha alai pAyudE
lines.meaning: My mind is swaying like waves, Kanna — swaying greatly,

lines.text: un Ananda mOhana vEnugAnamadil
lines.meaning: at the enchanting, blissful music of your flute.

lines.text: nilai peyarAdu shilai pOlavE ninra
lines.meaning: Unable to move, I stood still like a statue,

lines.text: nEramAvadariyAmalE migha vinOdamAna muralIdharA en manam (alai)
lines.meaning: not knowing how time passed, O wondrous flute-bearer; my mind (sways).

lines.text: teLinda nilavu paTTappaghal pOl eriyudE un dikkai nOkki enniru puruvam neriyudE
lines.meaning: Clear moonlight burns like broad daylight; looking toward you, my brows knit;

lines.text: kaninda un vENugAnam kATril varugudE kaNgaL shorugi oru vidham varugudE
lines.meaning: your ripe flute music comes on the breeze; my eyes droop, a strange feeling comes over me.

lines.text: kaditta manattil urutti padattai enakku aLittu magizhtta vA oru tanitta vanattil aNaittu enakku uNarcci
lines.meaning: Come, steady my anxious mind, give me your feet, and rejoice; in a lonely grove embrace me and stir my feelings,

lines.text: koDuTTu mugizhtta vA kalai kaDal alaiyinil kadiravan oLiyena iNaiyiru kazhal-enakkaLittavA
lines.meaning: come and fulfil me — you who gave me your two feet, like the sun's rays on the waves of the ocean of art.

lines.text: kadari manamuruga nAn azhaikkavO idara mAdaruDan nI kaLikkavO idu taghumO idu muraiyO
lines.meaning: Shall I cry out with melting heart? Will you sport with other women? Is this fitting? Is this proper?

lines.text: idu dharumam tAnO kuzhal UdiDum pozhudu AdiDum kuzhaigaL pOlavE manadu vEdanai mighavODu
lines.meaning: Is this righteous? When you play the flute, my mind aches, swaying like your earrings.

songs.title: swAgatam krishNA
songs.summary: Welcome, Krishna! A joyful greeting recounting Krishna's deeds.

lines.text: swaagatam krishNaa caraNaagatam krishNaa
lines.meaning: Welcome, Krishna; I have come to your feet, Krishna,

lines.text: madhuraapuri sadanaa mridu vadanaa madhusoodana iha
lines.meaning: dweller in Mathura, of gentle face, Madhusudana — here,

lines.text: bOga dapta sulabaa supushpa gandha kalaba
lines.meaning: easily reached, fragrant with fine flowers and sandal,

lines.text: kastoori tilaka mahiba mama kaanta nanda gOpa kandha
lines.meaning: with a musk tilaka, great one, my beloved, son of Nandagopa.

lines.text: mushTikaasoora caanoora malla malla vishaarada (madhusudanaa) kuvalaiyaapeeDa
lines.meaning: Expert wrestler who defeated Mushtika and Chanura, Madhusudana, slayer of Kuvalayapida,

lines.text: mardhana kaaLinga nardana gOkula rakshana sakala sulakshaNa dE-
lines.meaning: who danced on Kaliya, protector of Gokula, bearing every fine mark,

lines.text: vashisTha jana paala sankalpa kalpa kalpa sata kOTi asamaparabava
lines.meaning: protector of good people, whose resolve endures through countless aeons, unequalled,

lines.text: dheera muni jana vihaara madana sukumaara daitya samhaara dEvaa
lines.meaning: steadfast, roaming among sages, tender as Manmatha, destroyer of demons, O God,

lines.text: madhura madhura rati saahasa saahasa vrija yuvati jana manasa poojita
lines.meaning: sweet, so sweet, daring in love, worshipped in the hearts of the young women of Vraja.

songs.title: tAyE yasOdA
songs.summary: The gopis complain to Yashoda about little Krishna's mischief — and one ends by describing how he showed her all of Vaikuntha.

lines.text: tAyE yashOdE undan Ayarkulattuditta mAyan
lines.meaning: Mother Yashoda, hear of the tricks played by the magician born in your cowherd clan,

lines.text: gOpAlakriSNan seyyum jAlattai kELaDI (tAyE)
lines.meaning: Gopalakrishna — listen!

lines.text: tayalE kELaDi undan paiyannai pOlavE inda
lines.meaning: Listen, woman — a child like your son, in this

lines.text: vayyagattil oru piLLai ammamma nAn kaNDadillai (tAyE)
lines.meaning: world, ammamma, I have never seen.

lines.text: kAlinil shilambu konjak-kaivaLai kulunga muttu mAlaigaL asaiyat-teru vAsalil vandaan
lines.meaning: With anklets jingling on his feet, bangles tinkling on his hands, pearl garlands swaying, he came to our door,

lines.text: kAlashaiyum kaiyashaiyum tALAmODisaindu vara nIlavaNNak kaNNanivan narttanamaaDinaan
lines.meaning: swinging feet and hands in time to the tala, the blue-hued Kanna danced.

lines.text: bAlanenru tAvi aNaittEn aNaitta ennai mAlaiyiTTavan pOl vAyil muttamiTTaaNDi
lines.meaning: Thinking him a little boy I leapt and hugged him; as I hugged him, like a bridegroom he kissed me on the mouth, girl.

lines.text: bAlanallaDi un maghan jAlam migha seyyum kriSNan nAlu pErgal kETka colla nANamigha lAgudaDi
lines.meaning: He's no child, your son — Krishna who plays so many tricks; I'm too ashamed to say it for others to hear.

lines.text: anroru nAL inda vazhi vanda virundivarum ayarndu paDutturangum pOdinilE-kaNNan
lines.meaning: The other day, a guest who came this way lay tired and asleep — Kannan

lines.text: tinradu pOgak kaiyyil irunda vaNNaiyai anda virundinar vAyil niraittu maraindananE anda
lines.meaning: ate the butter, and the butter left in his hand he smeared in the guest's mouth and hid —

lines.text: nindai mighu pazhi ingE pAvamangE enrapaDi cintai migha nondiDavum seyya taghumO
lines.meaning: the blame fell here, the sin there; is it fitting to cause such grief?

lines.text: nanda gOparkkinda vidam anda mighu piLLai pera nalla tavam seidAraDi enna sheivOmaDi
lines.meaning: What great penance did Nandagopa do to get such a child? What shall we do, girl?

lines.text: veNNai veNNai tarum enrAn veNNai tandAl tinruviTTu peNNai tArum enru kETTu kaNNaDikkirAn
lines.meaning: He begged 'butter, butter'; when I gave him butter he ate it up, then winked and asked for a girl.

lines.text: vaNamAi niruttam Adi maNNinaip padattAl Etrik kaNNIlE iraittu viTTu kaLavADinAn
lines.meaning: Dancing gracefully, he kicked up dust with his feet, threw it in my eyes, and stole.

lines.text: paNNIshaiyum kuzhalUdinAn kETTU ninra paNBilE arugil vandu vambungaL sheidAn
lines.meaning: He played the flute so tunefully; as I stood listening, he came near and teased me.

lines.text: peNNinattukkenru vanda puNNiyangaL kOTIi kOTi eNNI unakkAghumaDi kaNNImaiyAip pOgudaDi
lines.meaning: All the merits of womankind, crores upon crores, seem to be yours, girl — and it is all slipping away from us.

lines.text: mundAnAL andi nErattil sondamuDan kittE vandu vindalgaL palavum sheidu viLaiyADinAn
lines.meaning: The other evening he came close, as if he were kin, and played many tricks;

lines.text: pandaLavAgilum veNNai tandAl viDuvEnenru mundukilai toTTizhuttup pOrADinAn
lines.meaning: saying 'I'll let go only if you give me a ball of butter', he pulled my saree end and fought.

lines.text: anda vAsudEvan ivan tAn aDi yashOdE maindanenat toTTizhuttu maDimEl vaittEn vaittAl
lines.meaning: This is that Vasudeva himself, Yashoda; thinking him a child I pulled him onto my lap —

lines.text: sundara mukhattai kaNDu cintai mayangunEram antara vaikuNTHamODu ellAm kATTinAn
lines.meaning: and as my mind swooned at his beautiful face, he showed me everything, Vaikuntha and all.

lines.text: ThottililE piLLai kiLLi vittathum avai alaRa
lines.meaning: He pinched the baby in the cradle, and as it wailed

lines.text: Vitta kaariyam agala veNNai thinRaan!
lines.meaning: he ate the butter while the mother left her work.

lines.text: Kattina kanRai avizhththu ettiyum oLiththu vittu
lines.meaning: He untied the tethered calf and, kicking, hid it,

lines.text: Mattilaath thumbai kazhuththil maattik koNdaan!
lines.meaning: and tied the rope around his own neck instead.

lines.text: Vittu vittu ammE enRaan kanRinaip pOlE
lines.meaning: Then he cried 'Amma!' like the calf,

lines.text: Attiyillaadha maadum ammaa enRathE!
lines.meaning: and the cow without her calf answered 'Amma!'

lines.text: Kittina kuvaLaiyOdum ettinaal un selva magan!
lines.meaning: With a lily in his hand, your precious son reached up

lines.text: Pattiyil kaRavaiyidam paalai ootturaan adee! (thaayE)
lines.meaning: and drinks the milk straight from the cow in the shed, girl!

lines.text: ChuRRi chuRRi ennai vanthu aththai veettu vazhi kEttaan
lines.meaning: Circling around me, he asked the way to his aunt's house;

lines.text: Siththaththukku ettum varaiyil solli ninREn
lines.meaning: I stood telling him until he understood;

lines.text: Aththudan vittaanO paarum aaththankarai vazhi kEttaan
lines.meaning: was he satisfied? He asked the way to the riverbank;

lines.text: Aththanaiyum sollivittu ninREn
lines.meaning: I stood telling him all that too;

lines.text: Viththagamaai onRu kEttaan - naaNamaaguthE!
lines.meaning: cleverly he asked one more thing — I'm ashamed!

lines.text: Muththaththukku vazhi kEttu saththam ittaaNdee
lines.meaning: He asked the way to a kiss, and made a fuss, girl!

lines.text: Aththanai idam koduththu meththavum vaLarththu vittaai!
lines.meaning: You've given him so much freedom and raised him so softly;

lines.text: Iththanai avanaich chollak kuththam illaiyeyadee! (thaayE)
lines.meaning: it's no fault to tell you all this about him, girl!

songs.title: kuzhalUdi manamellAm
songs.summary: A gopi says that even after Krishna stole her heart with his flute, she has no complaint — and describes him dancing in the moonlight.

lines.text: kuzhalUdi manamellAm koLLi koNDa pinnum kurai Edu enakkEdaDI tOzhi
lines.meaning: Even after he played the flute and stole my whole heart, what complaint can I have, friend?

lines.text: azhagAna mayil Adavum (miga)
lines.meaning: As the lovely peacock dances,

lines.text: kATril ashaindADum koDi pOlavum
lines.meaning: and like a creeper swaying in the breeze,

lines.text: agamagizhindilagum nilavoLi tanilE tanai marandu puLLinam kUva
lines.meaning: in the shining moonlight that delights the heart, flocks of birds call, forgetting themselves,

lines.text: ashaindADi miga ishandODi varum nalam kANa oru manam nADa
lines.meaning: my heart longing to see the beauty of him swaying and running joyfully,

lines.text: takumIdu ena oru padam pADa takiTa tadhimi ena naTam nADa
lines.meaning: singing a verse — 'this is fitting' — and dancing to 'takita tadhimi',

lines.text: kanru pashuvinavum ninru puDai shUzha enru malarumukha iraivan kanivODu
lines.meaning: with calves and cows standing around him, the Lord whose face blooms with love,

lines.text: makara kuNDalam Adavum adarkkErppa makuTam oLi vIshavum
lines.meaning: his makara earrings swaying and his crown shining to match,

lines.text: migavum ezhilAgavum kATril miLirum tugil Adavum
lines.meaning: most beautiful, his garment fluttering in the breeze.

songs.title: pAl vaDiyum mukham (version 2)
songs.summary: Wherever the devotee looks — the sky, a pond, a cuckoo's song — Krishna's face and flute appear.

lines.text: pAl vaDiyum mukham ninaindu ninaden uLLam paravasha migha vAgudE............kaNNA
lines.meaning: Thinking of your innocent face, dripping with milk, my heart is overwhelmed, Kanna.

lines.text: nIlak-kaDal pOlum nirattazhagA endan nenjam kuDi koNDa
lines.meaning: Beautiful one, dark as the blue sea, who made my heart his home,

lines.text: anru mudal inrum endap-poruL kaNDum cintanai shelA-dozhiyap-
lines.meaning: from that day until today, whatever I see, my thoughts never leave you.

lines.text: vAna mughaTTil shaTru manam vandu nOkkinum un mOhanamum vandu tONudE teLivAna
lines.meaning: Even if my mind looks up to the sky, your enchanting form appears; clearly,

lines.text: teNNIrt-taTattil en cintanai mArinum un shiritta mukham vandu kANudE shaTru
lines.meaning: even if my thoughts turn to a clear pond, your smiling face appears; a little,

lines.text: gAnak-kuyil kuralil karut-tamaittiDinum angu un gAnak-kuzhalOshai mayakkudE
lines.meaning: even if I listen to the cuckoo's song, the sound of your flute bewilders me there.

lines.text: karutta kuzhaloDu niratta mayilira shirukki amaitta tirtattilE gAna
lines.meaning: With your dark curls and a peacock feather tucked in, on the riverbank,

lines.text: mayiloDum mOnak-kuyil pADum nIla nadiyODum vAnattilE
lines.meaning: with the peacocks and the hushed cuckoos singing, by the blue river and in the sky,

lines.text: kural mudal ezhil ashai kuzhaiya varum ishaiyil kuzhaloDu miLir iLam karattilE
lines.meaning: in your young hand that shines with the flute, the music that makes voice, beauty and movement melt,

lines.text: kadirum matiyum ena nayana vizhigaL iru naLinamAna calanattilE
lines.meaning: in the play of your two lotus eyes, like the sun and moon,

lines.text: kALinga shirattilE kaditta padattilE en manattai irutti
lines.meaning: on Kaliya's head, on your stamping foot — fixing my mind there,

lines.text: kanavu nanavinoDu piravi piravi torum kaninduruga vandaruga param karuNaip-
lines.meaning: in dream and waking, birth after birth, melting in love — come near and grant your supreme compassion.

songs.title: krishnA nI bEganE bArO
songs.summary: Vyasaraja calls on the child Krishna of Udupi to come quickly, describing his ornaments.

lines.text: krishna nee bEganE baarO
lines.meaning: Krishna, come quickly.

lines.text: bEganE baarO mukhavannu tOrO
lines.meaning: Come quickly, show me your face.

lines.text: kaalaalandhugE gejje nIlada baavuli
lines.meaning: Anklet bells on your feet, a blue bracelet,

lines.text: nIlavarNane naaTya vaaduta baarO
lines.meaning: come dancing, blue-hued one.

lines.text: Udiyalli udigejje beraLalli ungura
lines.meaning: Little bells at your waist, rings on your fingers,

lines.text: koraLalli haakida vaijayantiya maalE
lines.meaning: the Vaijayanti garland around your neck,

lines.text: kaashi peethambara kaiyalli koLalu
lines.meaning: yellow Kashi silk, a flute in your hand,

lines.text: pUsida shreegandha mayyOLagamma!
lines.meaning: fragrant sandal paste smeared on your body!

lines.text: taayige baayalli jagavannu torida
lines.meaning: You who showed the whole world in your mouth to your mother,

lines.text: jagadhOddhaaraka namma uDupi shree krishna
lines.meaning: uplifter of the world, our Sri Krishna of Udupi.

songs.title: pibarE rAmarasam
songs.summary: Sadasiva Brahmendra urges the tongue to drink the nectar of Rama's name.

lines.text: pibarE rAmarasaM rasanE pibarE rAmarasam
lines.meaning: Drink the nectar of Rama, O tongue; drink the nectar of Rama.

lines.text: dUrIkrta pAtaka samsargaM pUrita nAnAvidha phalavargam
lines.meaning: It drives away all contact with sin; it is full of every kind of reward;

lines.text: janana maraNa bhaya SOka vidUraM sakala SAstra nigamAgama sAram
lines.meaning: it removes the fear and sorrow of birth and death; it is the essence of all Shastras, Vedas and Agamas;

lines.text: paripAlita sarasija garbhANDaM parama pavitrIkrta pAshaNDam
lines.meaning: it protected the cosmic egg born of the lotus; it made even heretics supremely pure;

lines.text: Suddha paramahamsASrama gItaM Suka Saunaka kauSika mukha pItam
lines.meaning: it is sung in the pure order of the Paramahamsas; it was drunk by Shuka, Shaunaka, Kaushika and others.

songs.title: mAnasa sancararE
songs.summary: Sadasiva Brahmendra asks the mind to roam in Brahman — that is, in Krishna.

lines.text: mAnasa sancara rE brahmaNi mAnasa sancara rE
lines.meaning: Roam, O mind, in Brahman; roam, O mind —

lines.text: mada Sikhi pinchAlankrta cikurE mahanIya kapOla vijita mukurE
lines.meaning: (in him) whose hair is adorned with the feathers of the proud peacock, whose glorious cheeks outshine mirrors,

lines.text: SrI ramaNI kuca durga vihArE sEvaka jana mandira mandArE
lines.meaning: who sports in Lakshmi's embrace, the wish-tree in the homes of those who serve,

lines.text: paramahamsa mukha candra cakOrE paripUrita muraLI rava dharE
lines.meaning: the moon to the chakora birds that are the great ascetics, who fills (the world) with the sound of the flute.

songs.title: bhajarE gOpAlam
songs.summary: Worship Gopala, O mind — the friend of Kuchela, root of the three worlds.

lines.text: bhajarE gOpAlam mAnasa bhajarE gOpAlam
lines.meaning: Worship Gopala, O mind; worship Gopala.

lines.text: bhaja gOpAlam bhajita kucElam trijaganmUlam ditisutakAlam
lines.meaning: Worship Gopala, worshipped by Kuchela, root of the three worlds, death to the sons of Diti,

lines.text: AgamasAram yOgavicAram bhOga sharIram bhuvanAdhAram
lines.meaning: essence of the Agamas, the object of yogic contemplation, of beautiful body, support of the worlds,

lines.text: kadanakaThOram kaluSa vidUram madanakumAram madhusamhAram
lines.meaning: fierce in battle, far from impurity, lovely as Madana, slayer of Madhu,

lines.text: natamandAram nandakishOram hatacANUram hamsavihAram
lines.meaning: wish-tree to those who bow, son of Nanda, slayer of Chanura, the swan who roams (in pure hearts).

songs.title: khElati mama hridayE
songs.summary: Rama plays in my heart — the heart is Ayodhya, and peace is his Sita.

lines.text: khElati mama hrdayE rAmaH khElati mama hrdayE
lines.meaning: Rama plays in my heart; he plays in my heart —

lines.text: mOha mahArNava tArakakArI rAga dvESha mukhAsuramAriI
lines.meaning: the ferry across the great ocean of delusion, slayer of the demons of desire, hatred and the rest,

lines.text: shAnti vidEha sutA sahacArI daharAyOdhyA nagara vihArI
lines.meaning: companion of peace, the daughter of Videha, who roams in Ayodhya, the cave of the heart,

lines.text: paramahamsa sAmrAjyOddhArI satya jnAnAnandA sharIrI
lines.meaning: who upholds the empire of the Paramahamsa, whose body is truth, knowledge and bliss.

songs.title: brUhi mukundEti
songs.summary: Say 'Mukunda', O tongue — a litany of Krishna's names.

lines.text: brUhi mukundEti rasanE brUhi mukundEti rasanE (brUhi)
lines.meaning: Say 'Mukunda', O tongue; say 'Mukunda'.

lines.text: kEshava mAdhava gOvindEti krSNAnanda sadAnandEti (brUhi)
lines.meaning: Say 'Keshava, Madhava, Govinda', 'Krishna, bliss, eternal bliss';

lines.text: rAdhA ramaNa harE rAmEti rAjIvAkSa ghanashyAmEti (brUhi)
lines.meaning: say 'Radha's beloved, Hari, Rama', 'lotus-eyed, cloud-dark one';

lines.text: garuDa gamana nandaka hastEti khaNDita dashakandhara mastEti (brUhi)
lines.meaning: say 'rider of Garuda, holder of the Nandaka sword', 'who cut off the ten-headed one's heads';

lines.text: akrUra priya cakradharEti hamsa niranjana kamsa harEti (brUhi)
lines.meaning: say 'dear to Akrura, bearer of the discus', 'the swan, the stainless one, slayer of Kamsa'.

songs.title: sarvam brahmamayam
songs.summary: All is Brahman — so what is there to say or not say, to do or not do?

lines.text: sarvam brahmamayam rE rE
lines.meaning: All is Brahman, O!

lines.text: kim vacanIyam kima vacanIyam kim racanIyam kima racanIyam
lines.meaning: What is to be said, what is not to be said? What is to be made, what is not to be made?

lines.text: kim paThanIyam kima paThanIyam kim bhajanIyam kima bhajanIyam
lines.meaning: What is to be read, what is not to be read? What is to be worshipped, what is not to be worshipped?

lines.text: kim bOddhavyam kima bOddhavyam kim bhOktavyam kima bhOktavyam
lines.meaning: What is to be known, what is not to be known? What is to be enjoyed, what is not to be enjoyed?

lines.text: sarvatra sadA hamsa dhyAnam kArtavyam bhO mukti nidAnam
lines.meaning: Everywhere and always, practise meditation on the Self (Hamsa) — it is the source of liberation.

songs.title: ADikkoNDAr anda
songs.summary: Muttu Tandavar's vivid description of Nataraja dancing in the golden hall of Chidambaram — would two eyes be enough to see it?

lines.text: ADikkoNDAr anda vEDikkaik-kANak-kaN Ayiram vENDAmO
lines.meaning: He danced! To see that spectacle, shouldn't one have a thousand eyes?

lines.text: nADit-tudippavar pangil uRaibavar nambar tirucchem ponnambalavANar
lines.meaning: He who dwells beside those who seek and praise him, our Lord of the holy golden hall —

lines.text: pangaya pAda silambasaindADap-pAda salangaigaL kiN kiNNenRADap-
lines.meaning: as the anklets on his lotus feet swayed and the bells on his feet rang 'kin kin',

lines.text: pongamuDanE urittu daritta pulittOl asaindADa
lines.meaning: as the tiger skin he flayed and wore swayed proudly,

lines.text: sengaiyil Endiya mAn mazhuvADa sem-poR-kuzhaikaL muyalaganADa
lines.meaning: as the deer and axe in his red hands swayed, as the dwarf Muyalagan and his red-gold earrings swayed,

lines.text: gangai iLampiRai senchaDaiyADak-kanaka sabhai tanilE
lines.meaning: as the Ganga and the young crescent in his red matted hair swayed, in the golden hall —

lines.text: Ara navamaNi mAlaigaLADa Adum aravam paDam virittADa
lines.meaning: as garlands of nine gems swayed, as the dancing serpent spread its hood and swayed,

lines.text: sIraNi konrai malart-toDaiyADac-cidambarattOr ADa
lines.meaning: as the lovely garland of konrai flowers swayed, as the people of Chidambaram danced,

lines.text: pEraNi vEdiyar tillai mUvAyiram pErgaLum pUjittuk-koNDu ninrADak
lines.meaning: as the three thousand great Vedic Brahmins of Tillai worshipped and danced,

lines.text: kAraNi kALi edirttu ninRADak-kanaka sabhai tanilE
lines.meaning: as dark Kali danced facing him, in the golden hall —

lines.text: nirtta gaNapati vElar ninrADa ninrayan mAluDan indiran ADa
lines.meaning: as dancing Ganapati and Velan (Murugan) danced, as Brahma with Vishnu and Indra danced,

lines.text: muppattu mukkOTi dEvarkaLuDanE munivarum ninrADa
lines.meaning: as the thirty-three crore gods danced, and the sages too,

lines.text: meippatti mEvum patanjali ADa vyAgrama pAdarum nandiyumADa
lines.meaning: as Patanjali of true devotion danced, and Vyaghrapada and Nandi danced,

lines.text: koppuTra kAdAL sivakAmiyammaiyum kUDavE ninrADa
lines.meaning: as Sivakami Amma, with her lovely ears, danced along with him.

songs.title: sabA patikku
songs.summary: Gopalakrishna Bharati: is any god equal to Sabhapati (Nataraja) of Chidambaram? Saying 'Shiva Chidambaram' once is enough.

lines.text: sabhApatikku vEru deivam samAnamAgumA tillai
lines.meaning: Is any other god equal to Sabhapati of Tillai?

lines.text: kripAnidhi ivaraippOla kiDaikkumO inda daraNi tanilE
lines.meaning: Can one find on this earth a treasure of compassion like him?

lines.text: oru daram siva cidambaran enDru uraittAl pOdumE
lines.meaning: If one says even once 'Shiva Chidambaram', it is enough;

lines.text: paragatikku vEru puNNiyam paNNa vENDumA?
lines.meaning: need one perform any other merit for liberation?

lines.text: Ariyar pulavar mUvar pAdam aDaindAr enDrE purANam
lines.meaning: The Purana tells how the three great saint-poets attained his feet;

lines.text: arindu solla kETTOm gOpAlakrishnan pAdum tillai
lines.meaning: we have heard it told — so sings Gopalakrishna of Tillai.

songs.title: varugalAmO
songs.summary: From Nandanar Charitram: the outcaste devotee Nandanar asks Nataraja whether he may come near to see his dance.

lines.text: varugalAMO ayya undan arugil ninru koNDADavum pADavum nAn
lines.meaning: May I come, sir, near you, to stand and celebrate you and sing?

lines.text: parama krpAnidhi allavO inda parayan upacAram shollavO
lines.meaning: Aren't you the supreme treasure of compassion? Should this outcaste need to speak words of courtesy?

lines.text: undan paramAnanda tANDavam pArkkavE nAnangE
lines.meaning: There, to see your supremely blissful dance, I —

lines.text: bhUmiyil pulaiyanAi pirandE nAn puNNiyam sheyyAmal irundEnE
lines.meaning: born an outcaste on this earth, I lived without doing any merit;

lines.text: sAmi un sannidhi vandEnE bhavasAgarattaiyum izhandEnE karai
lines.meaning: Lord, I have come to your presence; I have lost the ocean of births; the shore

lines.text: kaDandEnE sharaNam aDaindEnE tillai varadA paritApamum pApamum tIrvE
lines.meaning: I have reached, I have taken refuge; O giver of boons of Tillai, remove my suffering and sins.

songs.title: Ananda naTam ADuvAr
songs.summary: Nilakanta Sivan's description of Nataraja dancing the dance of bliss in Chidambaram.

lines.text: Ananda naTam ADuvAr tillai ambalam tannil aDi
lines.meaning: He dances the dance of bliss in the hall of Tillai —

lines.text: paNIbavark-kapajayam illai
lines.meaning: for those who bow at his feet there is no defeat.

lines.text: vancakam illAda aDiyAr kuvikka vAnavar munivar Anavar tudikka cancala vizhi
lines.meaning: As faithful devotees join their palms, as gods and sages praise him, as the restless-eyed

lines.text: mAdumaiyAL madikkat-takkiTa tarikiTa tongiTa dhittimi dhimi taka tatingiNa takatOm
lines.meaning: Uma watches in delight — 'takita tarikita tongita dhittimi dhimi taka tatingina takatom' —

lines.text: bhAgya muyalagan mIdoru kAl tAkkip bhaktar tozha maTra oTraikkAlum tUkki
lines.meaning: pressing one foot on fortunate Muyalagan, lifting the other foot as devotees worship,

lines.text: Akki aLippOrai mELakArar Akki ambara nAtha cidambara shambhu sadAshiva sundara
lines.meaning: making the creators and protectors his drummers — Lord of space, Chidambara Shambhu, Sadashiva, the beautiful one —

lines.text: Arai maNi shala shalavena aNi paNi khala khala vena
lines.meaning: as the gem-bells at his waist jingle and the serpent ornaments clink,

lines.text: pAdi madi jyOti phaLir phaLIr enna pAda shilamboli ghalIr ghalIr enna
lines.meaning: as the crescent moon's light flashes and his anklets ring 'ghalir ghalir',

lines.text: Adi karai uNDa nIlakNTham minna arapura hara shiva sundara aruL gurupara shiva shankara
lines.meaning: as the blue throat that swallowed the poison shines — destroyer of the cities, beautiful Shiva, gracious supreme guru, Shiva Shankara —

lines.text: ANdamum piNDamum AdiDa eNdishaiyum pugazh pAda
lines.meaning: as the cosmos and the body dance, as the eight directions sing his praise.

songs.title: brOcEvArevarurA
songs.summary: Who but Rama will protect me? I cannot let go of his lotus feet.

lines.text: brOcEvArevarurA ninnu vina raghuvarA nanu nI caraNAmbujamunu nE viDajAla karuNAlavAla
lines.meaning: Who is there to protect me other than you, Raghuvara? I cannot leave your lotus feet, abode of compassion.

lines.text: O caturananAdi vandita nIdu parAkElanayya nI caritamulu
lines.meaning: O you worshipped by four-faced Brahma and others, why this indifference? Your deeds

lines.text: pogaDa lEdu cinta dIrccavaramulicci vEgamE nanu
lines.meaning: I have not tired of praising; end my worries, grant me boons, and quickly (protect) me.

lines.text: sItApatE nApai nIkabhimAnamu lEdA vAtAtmajArcita pAda nAmoralanu vinarAdA
lines.meaning: Lord of Sita, have you no affection for me? You whose feet Hanuman worships, won't you hear my cries?

lines.text: Aturamuga karirAjuni brOcina vAsudEvuDE nIvu gadA pAdakamella pOgoTTi gaTTiga cei baTTi viDuvaga nanu
lines.meaning: Aren't you the Vasudeva who rushed to save the elephant king? Drive away all my sins, hold my hand firmly, and never let me go.

songs.title: raghuvamsha sudhAmbudhi
songs.summary: A brisk hymn to Rama, moon to the ocean of the Raghu race, identified with Venkateshvara.

lines.text: raghuvamsha sudhAmbudhi candra shrI rAma rAja rAjEshvara
lines.meaning: Moon to the ocean of nectar of the Raghu race, Sri Rama, king of kings,

lines.text: agha mEgha mAruta shrIkara asurEndra mrgEndra vara jagannAtha
lines.meaning: wind to the clouds of sin, giver of good, lion to the demon kings, noble lord of the world,

lines.text: jamadagnija garva khaNDana jaya rudrAdi vismita bhaNDana
lines.meaning: who crushed the pride of Parashurama, victorious one, at whose battles Rudra and others marvelled,

lines.text: kamalAp-tAnvaya maNDana agaNita arputa shurya shrI venkatEsha
lines.meaning: ornament of the Solar race, of countless wondrous valour, Sri Venkatesha,

lines.text: bhrgunandanA kavibhanjanA brndArakA brndAhitA
lines.meaning: who humbled Bhrigu's son and broke the monkey king's pride, friend of the hosts of gods,

lines.text: nigamAntava su-budhAvanA nIrajAkSa shrI venkaTEshvara
lines.meaning: protector of the wise who know the Vedanta, lotus-eyed Sri Venkateshvara,

lines.text: jamadagnija garvakhaNDana jaya rudrAdi vismita bhaNDana
lines.meaning: who crushed the pride of Parashurama, victorious one, at whose battles Rudra and others marvelled,

lines.text: kamalAptAnvaya maNDana agaNitArbhuta shurya shrI venkaTEshvara
lines.meaning: ornament of the Solar race, of countless wondrous valour, Sri Venkateshvara.

songs.title: sudhAmayi sudhAnidhi
songs.summary: A hymn to the Goddess, full of nectar, who holds the sugarcane bow — in Amritavarshini, the raga said to bring rain.

lines.text: sudhAmayi sudhAnidhi sumacarEkSu kOdaNDE
lines.meaning: Full of nectar, treasury of nectar, holder of the sugarcane bow with flower arrows,

lines.text: vidhIndranuta vimalE salahau vEdasArE vijayAmbikE
lines.meaning: praised by Brahma and Indra, pure one, (protect me) always, essence of the Vedas, Vijayambika,

lines.text: sarasijAkSi jaganmOhini sarasarAga maNibhUSaNi harikEsha priya kAmini AnandAmrtakarSaNi
lines.meaning: lotus-eyed, enchantress of the world, adorned with gems of melodious ragas, beloved of Harikesha, who draws out the nectar of bliss.

songs.title: bhuvanEshwariyA
songs.summary: A Kannada song: remember Bhuvaneshvari, O mind — she frees one from the fear of worldly bonds.

lines.text: bhuvanEshvariya nene mAnasavE bhava bandhagaLa bhItiya biDuvE
lines.meaning: Remember Bhuvaneshvari, O mind; she frees you from the fear of worldly bonds.

lines.text: bhavadali baridE navEyadE nOyadE tavE suvilAsadE taNiyuvE sukhisuvE
lines.meaning: With her, in this world, one is never empty, never weary, never in pain; she cools and comforts with grace.

lines.text: vrjinangaLanu vidaLipamAtEya trijagajjananiya triguNAtIteya
lines.meaning: (Remember) the mother who destroys sins, Mother of the three worlds, beyond the three gunas,

lines.text: nija bhaktAvana suravara surabhiya aja sannutE shrI harikEshAngiya
lines.meaning: the noble divine cow who protects her own devotees, praised by Brahma, beloved of Sri Harikesha.

songs.title: ninnu kOriyunnAnurA (varNam)
songs.summary: A varnam: the heroine longs for Lord Srinivasa and asks him to protect her.

lines.text: ninnu kOriyunnanurA nikhila lOka nAyaka
lines.meaning: I have longed for you, Lord of all the worlds.

lines.text: nannu pAlimpa samayamurA nAmIda krpa jUDarA
lines.meaning: This is the time to protect me; look on me with grace,

lines.text: sannutAnga shrInivAsa
lines.meaning: O one of praised form, Srinivasa.

songs.title: evari bOdhana (varNam)
songs.summary: A varnam: on whose advice is Venkatesha acting so coldly? The heroine cannot bear Manmatha's arrows.

lines.text: evari bOdhanavini IlAgu jEsEvurA
lines.meaning: On whose advice do you act like this?

lines.text: javamuga nannElarA shESAcalEndra shrI venkaTEshA
lines.meaning: Take me as yours quickly, Sri Venkatesha, lord of the Seshachala hills.

lines.text: mArubAri kOrvajAlanurA
lines.meaning: I cannot bear the arrows of Manmatha.

songs.title: sAmi ninnE kOri (varNam)
songs.summary: A varnam: the heroine, infatuated with Lord Kumara (Murugan), asks him to come to her.

lines.text: sAmi ninnE kOri cAla marulu konnadirA
lines.meaning: Lord, longing for you, I have become greatly infatuated.

lines.text: tAmasamu sEyaka dayajUDarA kumArA
lines.meaning: Without delay, look on me with compassion, Kumara.

lines.text: nIrajAkSipai nIpai
lines.meaning: This lotus-eyed one, on you —

lines.text: nIrajAkSi nIpai nenarunci rEyi maruni kELikUDi manninca rArA kumArA
lines.meaning: this lotus-eyed one has fallen in love with you; come to her tonight for love's play, and honour her, Kumara.
